```
    96→    const newShot = shots?.find((s) => s.id === newShotId);
    97→    const existingNonVideoCount = (newShot?.images || []).filter((img) => !isVideoGeneration(img)).length;
    98→    const remainingExpectedImages = Math.max(0, expectedImages - existingNonVideoCount);
    99→
   100→    setNewlyCreatedShotId(newShotId);
   101→    setNewlyCreatedShotExpectedImages(remainingExpectedImages);
   102→    setNewlyCreatedShotBaselineNonVideoCount(existingNonVideoCount);
   103→
   104→    clearPendingNewShot();
   105→  }, [currentShotIds, currentShotIdsKey, shots, clearPendingNewShot]);
   106→
   107→  const pendingSkeletonShot = useMemo(() => {
   108→    if (!baselineShotIdsRef.current) return null;
   109→    const baseline = baselineShotIdsRef.current;
   110→    const newShotAlreadyInData = currentShotIds.some((id) => !baseline.has(id));
   111→    if (newShotAlreadyInData) return null;
   112→    return { imageCount: pendingNewShotCountRef.current };
   113→  }, [currentShotIds, currentShotIdsKey]);
   114→
   115→  useEffect(() => {
   116→    if (onSkeletonSetupReady) {
   117→      onSkeletonSetupReady(setupPendingNewShot, clearPendingNewShot);
   118→    }
   119→  }, [onSkeletonSetupReady, setupPendingNewShot, clearPendingNewShot]);
   120→
   121→  const handlePendingCreate = useCallback(
   122→    (detail: { imageCount: number }) => {
   123→      setupPendingNewShot(detail.imageCount);
   124→    },
   125→    [setupPendingNewShot],
   126→  );
   127→
   128→  const handlePendingCreateClear = useCallback(() => {
   129→    clearPendingNewShot();
   130→  }, [clearPendingNewShot]);
   131→
   132→  useAppEventListener('shot-pending-create', handlePendingCreate);
   133→  useAppEventListener('shot-pending-create-clear', handlePendingCreateClear);
   134→
   135→  const handleNewShotDragEnter = useCallback(
   136→    (e: React.DragEvent) => {
   137→      const dragType = getDragType(e);
   138→      if (dragType !== 'none' && (onGenerationDropForNewShot || onFilesDropForNewShot)) {
   139→        e.preventDefault();
   140→        e.stopPropagation();
   141→        setIsNewShotDropTarget(true);
   142→        setNewShotDropType(dragType);
   143→      }
   144→    },
   145→    [onGenerationDropForNewShot, onFilesDropForNewShot],
   146→  );
   147→
   148→  const handleNewShotDragOver = useCallback(
   149→    (e: React.DragEvent) => {
   150→      const dragType = getDragType(e);
   151→      if (dragType !== 'none' && (onGenerationDropForNewShot || onFilesDropForNewShot)) {
   152→        e.preventDefault();
   153→        e.stopPropagation();
   154→        e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy';
   155→        setIsNewShotDropTarget(true);
   156→        setNewShotDropType(dragType);
   157→      }
   158→    },
   159→    [onGenerationDropForNewShot, onFilesDropForNewShot],
   160→  );
   161→
   162→  const handleNewShotDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
   163→    if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node)) {
   164→      setIsNewShotDropTarget(false);
   165→      setNewShotDropType('none');
   166→    }
   167→  }, []);
   168→
   169→  const handleNewShotDrop = useCallback(
   170→    async (e: React.DragEvent) => {
   171→      e.preventDefault();
   172→      e.stopPropagation();
   173→      setIsNewShotDropTarget(false);
   174→      setNewShotDropType('none');
   175→
   176→      const generationData = getGenerationDropData(e);
   177→      if (generationData && onGenerationDropForNewShot) {
   178→        setupPendingNewShot(1);
   179→        try {
   180→          await onGenerationDropForNewShot(generationData);
   181→        } catch (error) {
   182→          normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'ShotDrop', toastTitle: 'Failed to create shot' });
   183→          clearPendingNewShot();
   184→        }
   185→        return;
   186→      }
   187→
   188→      if (isFileDrag(e) && onFilesDropForNewShot) {
   189→        const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files);
   190→        const validImageTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp', 'image/jpg'];
   191→        const validFiles = files.filter((file) => validImageTypes.includes(file.type));
   192→
   193→        if (validFiles.length === 0) {
   194→          toast.error('No valid image files. Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP are supported.');
   195→          return;
   196→        }
   197→
   198→        setupPendingNewShot(validFiles.length);
   199→        try {
   200→          await onFilesDropForNewShot(validFiles);
   201→        } catch (error) {
   202→          normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'ShotDrop', toastTitle: 'Failed to create shot' });
   203→          clearPendingNewShot();
   204→        }
   205→      }
   206→    },
   207→    [
   208→      onGenerationDropForNewShot,
   209→      onFilesDropForNewShot,
   210→      setupPendingNewShot,
   211→      clearPendingNewShot,
   212→    ],
   213→  );
   214→
   215→  const clearNewlyCreatedShot = useCallback(() => {
   216→    setNewlyCreatedShotId(null);
   217→    setNewlyCreatedShotExpectedImages(0);
   218→    setNewlyCreatedShotBaselineNonVideoCount(0);
   219→  }, []);
   220→
   221→  return {
   222→    isNewShotDropTarget,
   223→    newShotDropType,
   224→    isNewShotProcessing: false,
   225→    pendingSkeletonShot,
   226→    newlyCreatedShotId,
   227→    newlyCreatedShotExpectedImages,
   228→    newlyCreatedShotBaselineNonVideoCount,
   229→    clearNewlyCreatedShot,
   230→    handleNewShotDragEnter,
   231→    handleNewShotDragOver,
   232→    handleNewShotDragLeave,
   233→    handleNewShotDrop,
   234→  };
   235→}
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * useTimelinePositions - Single Source of Truth for Timeline Positions
     3→ *
     4→ * This hook serves the TIMELINE DRAG path: the user drags a node on the
     5→ * timeline ruler and positions update optimistically while the RPC runs.
     6→ *
     7→ * The BATCH EDITOR path (drag-to-reorder in the image grid) is handled
     8→ * separately by useTimelineFrameUpdates, which does a DB-first write and
     9→ * relies on the React Query cache refetch to update the UI. The two paths
    10→ * share the same serialization queue (runSerializedTimelineWrite) and the
    11→ * same RPC (persistTimelineFrameBatch) so their writes are ordered correctly.
    12→ *
    13→ * State machine:
    14→ * - ONE positions map (no displayPositions, stablePositions, framePositions confusion)
    15→ * - Optimistic updates with rollback on error
    16→ * - pendingUpdatesRef protects optimistic state across async DB syncs
    17→ * - Batch database operations for performance
    18→ */
    19→
    20→import {
    21→  useState,
    22→  useCallback,
    23→  useRef,
    24→  useEffect
    25→} from 'react';
    26→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    27→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';

    31→import { useInvalidateGenerations } from '@/shared/hooks/invalidation/useGenerationInvalidation';
    32→import {
    33→  isTimelineWriteActive,
    34→} from '@/shared/lib/timelineWriteQueue';
    35→import { persistTimelineFrameBatch } from '@/shared/lib/timelineFrameBatchPersist';
    36→import {
    37→  buildServerPositions,
    38→  createPositionsSyncKey,
    39→  detectPositionChanges,
    40→  hasDuplicatePositionValues,
    41→  mergePendingUpdates,
    42→  type PendingUpdate,
    43→} from './timelinePositionCalc';
    44→import {
    45→  clearTrailingEndpointFrame,
    46→  setTrailingEndpointFrame,
    47→} from '../segment/timelineTrailingEndpointPersistence';
    48→
    49→// ============================================================================
    50→// TYPES
    51→// ============================================================================
    52→
    53→/**
    54→ * State machine for position management

    56→type PositionStatus =
```

```
    27→
    28→  if (explicit === 'throw') {

    32→    return 'warn';
    33→  }
    34→

    37→  }
    38→
```

### BUG (must fix)

**`VideoGenerationModal.tsx` — `DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG` is used but not imported**

Line 220:
```tsx
const finalPhaseConfig = advancedMode ? (settings.phaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG) : basicPhaseConfig;
```

`DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG` is not in the file's import list. `VideoGenerationModalSections.tsx` imports it (line 10), but that does not help the parent. This will throw a `ReferenceError` at runtime whenever `advancedMode` is `true`.

Fix: add `DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG` to the import from `@/tools/travel-between-images/settings` in `VideoGenerationModal.tsx`. That import already exists on line 10 of the sections file, so this is a one-line omission.

---

### Dead code (should clean)

**`ShotImageManagerDesktop.tsx` — passthrough `useCallback` with no body**

Lines 95–97:
```tsx
const setShowTickForSecondaryImageId = useCallback((id: string | null) => {
  setShowTickForSecondaryImageIdInternal(id);
}, []);
```

The comment above this says "Wrapper to log when setter is called" but the log was never written (or was removed). The wrapper adds a new `useCallback` allocation on every render for zero benefit. Either add the log back or remove the wrapper and rename `setShowTickForSecondaryImageIdInternal` to `setShowTickForSecondaryImageId`.

---

**`TimelineTrack` — two props declared in interface but never destructured or used**

`hasNoImages: boolean` (interface line 9) and `containerWidth: number` (interface line 18) are accepted from the caller but are not in the component's destructuring and do not appear anywhere in the JSX or logic. They are silently discarded. Remove them from the interface (and from `TimelineContainer`'s call site where they are passed in).

---

### Minor / low priority

**`useVideoLightboxRenderModel.tsx` — spurious dependency in `workflowBar` memo**

`editModel.variantBadges` appears in the `workflowBar` `useMemo` dependency array but `workflowBar` does not use it — `variantBadges` is consumed in the `lightboxVariants` memo above. This causes `workflowBar` to recompute when badge counts change even though nothing in it changed. Remove it from the `workflowBar` deps.

---

**`GenerationsPane.tsx` — comment says "3 rows" but constant is 2**

`const PANE_ROWS = 2` (line 34), but the comment on line 68 says "3 rows instead of 9" and the nearby comment references `PANE_ROWS=3`. Update the comments to match the actual value.

```
1→import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
     2→import type { Database } from '@/integrations/supabase/types';
     3→import { createSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/bootstrap/createSupabaseClient';
     4→import { initializeSupabaseRuntime } from '@/integrations/supabase/bootstrap/initializeSupabaseRuntime';
     5→
     6→type SupabaseClientInstance = SupabaseClient<Database>;
     7→const SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE =
     8→  'Supabase runtime is not initialized. Call initializeSupabaseClientRuntime() during app bootstrap.';
     9→
    10→let runtimeClient: SupabaseClientInstance | null = null;
    11→let runtimeError: Error | null = null;
    12→
    13→export type SupabaseClientAccessResult =
    14→  | { ok: true; client: SupabaseClientInstance }
    15→  | { ok: false; error: Error };
    16→
    17→export function normalizeSupabaseError(error: unknown): Error {
    18→  return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseClientRuntime(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    22→  if (runtimeClient) {
    23→    return runtimeClient;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  try {
    27→    const client = createSupabaseClient();
    28→    initializeSupabaseRuntime(client);
    29→    runtimeClient = client;
    30→    runtimeError = null;
    31→    return client;
    32→  } catch (error) {
    33→    const normalized = normalizeSupabaseError(error);
    34→    runtimeClient = null;
    35→    runtimeError = normalized;
    36→    throw normalized;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    41→  if (runtimeClient) {
    42→    return { ok: true, client: runtimeClient };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  if (runtimeError) {
    46→    return { ok: false, error: runtimeError };
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    ok: false,
    51→    error: new Error(SUPABASE_RUNTIME_NOT_INITIALIZED_MESSAGE),
    52→  };
    53→}
    54→
    55→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClient(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    56→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    57→  if (!result.ok) {
    58→    throw result.error;
    59→  }
    60→  return result.client;
    61→}
```

```
1→import { __CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__, __REALTIME_DOWN_FIX_ENABLED__ } from '@/integrations/supabase/config/env';
     2→import { captureRealtimeSnapshot } from '@/integrations/supabase/utils/snapshot';
     3→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     4→import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
     5→import {
     6→  getCorruptionTimelineSnapshot,
     7→  recordRealtimeCorruptionEvent,
     8→  reportRealtimeCorruption,
     9→} from './diagnosticReporters';
    10→import { installRealtimeReferencePatchers } from './referencePatchers';
    11→
    12→interface RealtimeClientWithInstrumentation {
    13→  socket: WebSocket | null;
    14→  conn?: { transport?: { ws?: WebSocket | null } };
    15→  __REFERENCE_TRACKING_INSTALLED__?: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function installRealtimeInstrumentation(supabase: SupabaseClient) {
    19→  if (!__CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__ && !__REALTIME_DOWN_FIX_ENABLED__) {
    20→    return;
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !supabase?.realtime) {
    24→    return;
    25→  }
    26→
    27→  const realtime = supabase.realtime as unknown as RealtimeClientWithInstrumentation;
    28→
    29→  try {
    30→    installRealtimeReferencePatchers({
    31→      realtime,
    32→      captureSnapshot: captureRealtimeSnapshot,
    33→      reportCorruption: reportRealtimeCorruption,
    34→      recordEvent: recordRealtimeCorruptionEvent,
    35→      getTimelineSnapshot: getCorruptionTimelineSnapshot,
    36→    });
    37→  } catch (error) {
    38→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    39→      context: 'RealtimeInstrumentation',
    40→      showToast: false,
    41→    });
    42→  }
    43→
    44→  // Reconnect requests are emitted from explicit realtime failure paths
    45→  // (RealtimeConnection / auth lifecycle) rather than global console interception.
    46→}
    47→
```

```
     6→  collectUnhandledRejectionInfo,

     8→  isKnownSupabaseSourceLine,
     9→  isSupabaseRealtimeRelated,
    10→  parsePhoenixMessage,
    11→} from './eventCollectors';
    12→import {
    13→  installGlobalErrorPatchers,
    14→  installWebSocketProbe,
    15→  type InstrumentedWindow,
    16→} from './globalPatchers';
    17→
    18→function installCorruptionTracePatchers(instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow): void {
    19→  installGlobalErrorPatchers({
    20→    instrumentedWindow,
    21→    onWindowError: (message, source, lineno, colno, error) => {
    22→      const errorInfo = collectWindowErrorInfo({
    23→        message,
    24→        source,
    25→        lineno,
    26→        colno,
    27→        error: error ?? null,
    28→      });
    29→
    30→      if (isKnownSupabaseSourceLine(source, lineno)) {
    31→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('[RealtimeCorruptionTrace] Supabase error captured'), {
    32→          context: 'WindowInstrumentation',
    33→          showToast: false,
    34→          logData: {
    35→            ...errorInfo,
    36→            realtimeSnapshot: captureRealtimeSnapshot(),
    37→            corruptionTimeline: [...__CORRUPTION_TIMELINE__],
    38→          },
    39→        });
    40→        addCorruptionEvent('SUPABASE_ERROR_2372', errorInfo);
    41→      } else if (isSupabaseRealtimeRelated(message)) {
    42→        addCorruptionEvent('RELATED_ERROR', errorInfo);
    43→      }
    44→    },
    45→    onUnhandledRejection: (event) => {
    46→      const rejectionInfo = collectUnhandledRejectionInfo(event);
    47→      if (isSupabaseRealtimeRelated(event.reason)) {
    48→        addCorruptionEvent('UNHANDLED_REJECTION', rejectionInfo);
    49→      }
    50→    },
    51→  });
    52→}
    53→
    54→function installWebSocketInstrumentation(instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow): void {
    55→  installWebSocketProbe({
    56→    instrumentedWindow,
    57→    onTrackedSocketMessage: ({ event }) => {
    58→      try {
    59→        const parsed = parsePhoenixMessage(event.data);
    60→        if (parsed) {
    61→          addCorruptionEvent('PHOENIX_MESSAGE', parsed);
    62→        }
    63→
    64→        const snapshot = instrumentedWindow.__REALTIME_SNAPSHOT__ || {};
    65→        instrumentedWindow.__REALTIME_SNAPSHOT__ = {
    66→          ...snapshot,
    67→          lastPhoenixMsgAt: Date.now(),
    68→        };
    69→      } catch {
    70→        // Ignore instrumentation parse failures so realtime flow remains unaffected.
    71→      }
    72→    },
    73→  });
    74→}
    75→
    76→export function installWindowOnlyInstrumentation() {
    77→  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    78→    return;
    79→  }
    80→
    81→  const instrumentedWindow = window as InstrumentedWindow;
    82→
    83→  if (__CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__) {

    85→  }
    86→
    87→  if (__WS_INSTRUMENTATION_ENABLED__) {
    88→    installWebSocketInstrumentation(instrumentedWindow);
    89→  }
    90→}
```

```
1→/** Shape of a Phoenix channel message received over WebSocket */
     2→interface PhoenixMessage {
     3→  event?: string;
     4→  topic?: string;
     5→  ref?: string;
     6→  payload?: Record<string, unknown>;
     7→}
     8→
     9→export interface WindowErrorCaptureInput {
    10→  message: unknown;
    11→  source: unknown;
    12→  lineno?: number;
    13→  colno?: number;
    14→  error: Error | null;
    15→}
    16→
    17→export interface WindowErrorInfo {
    18→  message: string;
    19→  source: string;
    20→  lineno?: number;
    21→  colno?: number;
    22→  error: { name: string; message: string; stack: string | undefined } | null;
    23→  timestamp: number;
    24→  userAgent: string;
    25→}
    26→
    27→export interface UnhandledRejectionInfo {
    28→  reason: unknown;
    29→  promise: string;
    30→  timestamp: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→export interface PhoenixMessageInfo {
    34→  event: string;
    35→  topic?: string;
    36→  ref?: string;
    37→  payload: string[] | null;
    38→}
    39→
    40→export const SUPABASE_JS_KNOWN_ERROR_LINE = 2372;
    41→
    42→export function collectWindowErrorInfo({
    43→  message,
    44→  source,
    45→  lineno,
    46→  colno,
    47→  error,
    48→}: WindowErrorCaptureInput): WindowErrorInfo {
    49→  return {
    50→    message: String(message),
    51→    source: String(source),
    52→    lineno,
    53→    colno,
    54→    error: error
    55→      ? {
    56→        name: error.name,
    57→        message: error.message,
    58→        stack: error.stack,
    59→      }
    60→      : null,
    61→    timestamp: Date.now(),
    62→    userAgent: navigator.userAgent.slice(0, 100),
    63→  };
    64→}
    65→
    66→export function collectUnhandledRejectionInfo(event: PromiseRejectionEvent): UnhandledRejectionInfo {
    67→  return {
    68→    reason: event.reason,
    69→    promise: '[PROMISE_OBJECT]',
    70→    timestamp: Date.now(),
    71→  };
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function isKnownSupabaseSourceLine(source: unknown, lineno: number | undefined): boolean {
    75→  return typeof source === 'string'
    76→    && source.includes('supabase-js.js')
    77→    && lineno === SUPABASE_JS_KNOWN_ERROR_LINE;
    78→}
    79→
    80→export function isSupabaseRealtimeRelated(value: unknown): boolean {
    81→  const text = String(value ?? '').toLowerCase();
    82→  return text.includes('supabase') || text.includes('realtime') || text.includes('websocket');
    83→}
    84→
    85→export function isSupabaseRealtimeSocket(url: string): boolean {
    86→  return url.includes('supabase.co/realtime');
    87→}
    88→
    89→export function isSupabaseWebSocket(url: string): boolean {
    90→  return url.includes('supabase.co') && url.includes('websocket');
    91→}
    92→
    93→export function parsePhoenixMessage(data: unknown): PhoenixMessageInfo | null {
    94→  if (typeof data !== 'string') {
    95→    return null;
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  try {
    99→    const parsed = JSON.parse(data) as PhoenixMessage;
   100→    if (!parsed.event) {
   101→      return null;
   102→    }
   103→
   104→    return {
   105→      event: parsed.event,
   106→      topic: parsed.topic,
   107→      ref: parsed.ref,
   108→      payload: parsed.payload ? Object.keys(parsed.payload) : null,
   109→    };
   110→  } catch {
   111→    return null;
   112→  }
   113→}
   114→
```

```
    16→
    17→interface InstallGlobalErrorPatchersInput {
    18→  instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow;
    19→  onWindowError: OnWindowError;
    20→  onUnhandledRejection: (event: PromiseRejectionEvent) => void;
    21→}
    22→
    23→type OnWindowError = (
    24→  message: string | Event,
    25→  source?: string,
    26→  lineno?: number,
    27→  colno?: number,
    28→  error?: Error,
    29→) => boolean | void;
    30→
    31→export function installGlobalErrorPatchers({
    32→  instrumentedWindow,
    33→  onWindowError,
    34→  onUnhandledRejection,
    35→}: InstallGlobalErrorPatchersInput): void {
    36→  const originalOnError = instrumentedWindow.onerror;
    37→  const originalOnUnhandledRejection = instrumentedWindow.onunhandledrejection;
    38→
    39→  instrumentedWindow.onerror = function patchedOnError(message, source, lineno, colno, error) {
    40→    onWindowError(message, source, lineno, colno, error ?? undefined);
    41→    if (originalOnError) {
    42→      return originalOnError.call(this, message, source, lineno, colno, error);
    43→    }
    44→    return false;
    45→  };
    46→
    47→  instrumentedWindow.onunhandledrejection = function patchedUnhandledRejection(event: PromiseRejectionEvent) {
    48→    onUnhandledRejection(event);
    49→    if (originalOnUnhandledRejection) {
    50→      return originalOnUnhandledRejection.call(instrumentedWindow, event);
    51→    }
    52→  };
    53→}
    54→
    55→interface WebSocketMessageCapture {
    56→  wsId: number;
    57→  url: string;
    58→  protocols?: string | string[];
    59→  event: MessageEvent;
    60→}
    61→
    62→interface InstallWebSocketProbeInput {
    63→  instrumentedWindow: InstrumentedWindow;
    64→  onTrackedSocketMessage: (capture: WebSocketMessageCapture) => void;
    65→}
    66→
    67→export function installWebSocketProbe({
    68→  instrumentedWindow,
    69→  onTrackedSocketMessage,
    70→}: InstallWebSocketProbeInput): void {
    71→  if (instrumentedWindow.__WS_PROBE_INSTALLED__) {
    72→    return;
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  instrumentedWindow.__WS_PROBE_INSTALLED__ = true;
    76→  const OriginalWebSocket = instrumentedWindow.WebSocket;
    77→  let wsCreationCount = 0;
    78→
    79→  instrumentedWindow.WebSocket = function patchedWebSocket(url: string, protocols?: string | string[]) {
    80→    wsCreationCount += 1;
    81→    const wsId = wsCreationCount;
    82→
    83→    const trackSocket = isSupabaseRealtimeSocket(url) || isSupabaseWebSocket(url);
    84→    const ws = protocols ? new OriginalWebSocket(url, protocols) : new OriginalWebSocket(url);
    85→
    86→    if (trackSocket) {
    87→      instrumentedWindow.__SUPABASE_WEBSOCKET_INSTANCES__ = instrumentedWindow.__SUPABASE_WEBSOCKET_INSTANCES__ || [];
    88→      instrumentedWindow.__SUPABASE_WEBSOCKET_INSTANCES__.push({
    89→        wsId,
    90→        url,
    91→        protocols,
    92→        createdAt: Date.now(),
    93→        websocketRef: ws,
    94→      });
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    ws.addEventListener('message', (event: MessageEvent) => {
    98→      if (!trackSocket) {
    99→        return;
   100→      }
   101→      onTrackedSocketMessage({
   102→        wsId,
   103→        url,
   104→        protocols,
   105→        event,
   106→      });
   107→    });
   108→
   109→    return ws as WebSocket;
   110→  } as unknown as typeof WebSocket;
   111→}
```

```
1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→
     3→export type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→export type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  throw new Error(`Invalid settings scope: ${String(scope)}`);
    17→}
    18→
    19→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    20→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    21→  return getSupabaseClient()
    22→    .from(tableName)
    23→    .select('settings')
    24→    .eq('id', id)
    25→    .single();
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
    29→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,
    30→  id: string,
    31→  toolId: string,
    32→  settings: Record<string, unknown>,
    33→) {
    34→  return getSupabaseClient().rpc('update_tool_settings_atomic', {
    35→    p_table_name: tableName,
    36→    p_id: id,
    37→    p_tool_id: toolId,
    38→    p_settings: settings,
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→
```

```
   382→  useEffect(() => {
```

```
    45→function createSupabaseHarness(options: SupabaseHarnessOptions = {}) {
    46→  const updateResults = [...(options.updateResults ?? [])];

    67→      single: selectSingle,
    68→    })),
    69→  }));
    70→
    71→  const update = vi.fn((payload: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    72→    updateCalls.push(payload);
    73→    const result = updateResults.shift() ?? { error: null, data: [{ id: 'orch-1' }] };
    74→    const inChain = {

    77→        error: result.error,
```

```
1→// Network status integration can be added later if needed
     2→
     3→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     4→import { dispatchAppEvent } from '@/shared/lib/typedEvents';
     5→import { registerDebugGlobal } from '@/shared/runtime/debugRegistry';
     6→
     7→/**
     8→ * ReconnectScheduler - Centralized manager for realtime reconnection intents
     9→ * 
    10→ * Prevents race conditions between multiple sources (AuthManager, warn interceptor, 
    11→ * visibility changes) by coalescing reconnection requests and enforcing debouncing.
    12→ */
    13→
    14→interface ReconnectIntent {
    15→  source: string;
    16→  reason: string;
    17→  timestamp: number;
    18→  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
    19→}
    20→
    21→export class ReconnectScheduler {
    22→  private pendingIntents: ReconnectIntent[] = [];
    23→  private lastReconnectAt = 0;
    24→  private debounceTimeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    25→  private isProcessing = false;
    26→  // Network status integration removed for simplicity
    27→
    28→  private readonly DEBOUNCE_MS = 1000; // 1 second debounce
    29→  private readonly MIN_INTERVAL_MS = 5000; // Minimum 5 seconds between reconnects
    30→
    31→  constructor() {
    32→    // Simple constructor - network status integration can be added later
    33→  }
    34→
    35→  /**
    36→   * Request a reconnection with specified intent
    37→   */
    38→  requestReconnect(intent: Omit<ReconnectIntent, 'timestamp'>) {
    39→    const fullIntent: ReconnectIntent = {
    40→      ...intent,
    41→      timestamp: Date.now()
    42→    };
    43→
    44→    // Add to pending intents
    45→    this.pendingIntents.push(fullIntent);
    46→
    47→    // Clear existing debounce timer
    48→    if (this.debounceTimeout) {
    49→      clearTimeout(this.debounceTimeout);
    50→    }
    51→
    52→    // Set new debounce timer
    53→    this.debounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    54→      this.processReconnectIntents();
    55→    }, this.DEBOUNCE_MS);
    56→    
    57→  }
    58→
    59→  private processReconnectIntents() {
    60→
    61→    if (this.isProcessing || this.pendingIntents.length === 0) {
    62→      return;
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    const now = Date.now();
    66→    const timeSinceLastReconnect = now - this.lastReconnectAt;
    67→
    68→    // Enforce minimum interval
    69→    if (timeSinceLastReconnect < this.MIN_INTERVAL_MS) {
    70→      const remainingWait = this.MIN_INTERVAL_MS - timeSinceLastReconnect;
    71→      
    72→      // Reschedule after the remaining wait time
    73→      this.debounceTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
    74→        this.processReconnectIntents();
    75→      }, remainingWait);
    76→      return;
    77→    }
    78→
    79→    this.isProcessing = true;
    80→
    81→    // Sort intents by priority and timestamp
    82→    const sortedIntents = [...this.pendingIntents].sort((a, b) => {
    83→      const priorityOrder = { high: 3, medium: 2, low: 1 };
    84→      const priorityDiff = priorityOrder[b.priority] - priorityOrder[a.priority];
    85→      if (priorityDiff !== 0) return priorityDiff;
    86→      return a.timestamp - b.timestamp; // Earlier timestamp first
    87→    });
    88→
    89→    const primaryIntent = sortedIntents[0];
    90→    const allSources = sortedIntents.map(intent => intent.source);
    91→    const allReasons = [...new Set(sortedIntents.map(intent => intent.reason))];
    92→
    93→    // Clear pending intents
    94→    this.pendingIntents = [];
    95→
    96→    // Update last reconnect time
    97→    this.lastReconnectAt = now;
    98→
    99→    try {
   100→      
   101→      // Dispatch the single, coalesced reconnect event
   102→      dispatchAppEvent('realtime:auth-heal', {
   103→        source: primaryIntent.source,
   104→        reason: primaryIntent.reason,
   105→        priority: primaryIntent.priority,
   106→        coalescedSources: allSources,
   107→        coalescedReasons: allReasons,
   108→        timestamp: now
   109→      });
   110→      
   111→    } catch (error) {
   112→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'ReconnectScheduler', showToast: false });
   113→    } finally {
   114→      this.isProcessing = false;
   115→    }
   116→  }
   117→
   118→  // Network status handling removed for simplicity
   119→
   120→  /**
   121→   * Clean up resources
   122→   */
   123→  destroy() {
   124→    if (this.debounceTimeout) {
   125→      clearTimeout(this.debounceTimeout);
   126→      this.debounceTimeout = null;
   127→    }
   128→    
   129→    // Network status cleanup removed
   130→    
   131→    this.pendingIntents = [];
   132→    this.isProcessing = false;
   133→  }
   134→
   135→  /**
   136→   * Get current scheduler state for debugging
   137→   */
   138→  getState() {
   139→    return {
   140→      pendingIntents: this.pendingIntents.length,
   141→      lastReconnectAt: this.lastReconnectAt,
   142→      isProcessing: this.isProcessing,
   143→      timeSinceLastReconnect: Date.now() - this.lastReconnectAt
   144→    };
   145→  }
   146→}
   147→
   148→// Global instance
   149→let reconnectScheduler: ReconnectScheduler | null = null;
   150→let cleanupReconnectSchedulerDebugGlobal: (() => void) | null = null;
   151→
   152→export function getReconnectScheduler(): ReconnectScheduler {
   153→  if (!reconnectScheduler) {
   154→    reconnectScheduler = new ReconnectScheduler();
   155→    
   156→    // Make it globally accessible for debugging (dev only)
   157→    if (import.meta.env.DEV && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
   158→      cleanupReconnectSchedulerDebugGlobal?.();
   159→      cleanupReconnectSchedulerDebugGlobal = registerDebugGlobal(
   160→        '__RECONNECT_SCHEDULER__',
   161→        reconnectScheduler,
   162→        'ReconnectScheduler',
   163→      );
   164→    }
   165→  }
   166→  
   167→  return reconnectScheduler;
   168→}
   169→
```

```
   273→

   275→  return (

   277→      {renderHeader()}
   278→
   279→      {/* Scrollable content area - contains both task details and variants */}
   280→      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto min-h-0 overscroll-none">
   281→        {renderTaskDetails()}
   282→        {renderVariants()}
```

```
1→import { useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import { getViewportLockRuntime } from '@/shared/runtime/viewportLockRuntime';
     3→import { acquireLightboxOpenState } from '@/features/lightbox/state/lightboxOpenState';
     4→
     5→interface UseLightboxViewportLockArgs {
     6→  isActuallyModal: boolean;
     7→}
     8→
     9→export function useLightboxViewportLock({ isActuallyModal }: UseLightboxViewportLockArgs): void {
    10→  useEffect(() => {
    11→    if (isActuallyModal) return;
    12→    const releaseLightboxOpen = acquireLightboxOpenState();
    13→    const unlockViewport = getViewportLockRuntime().lockLightboxViewport();
    14→
    15→    return () => {
    16→      unlockViewport();
    17→      releaseLightboxOpen();
    18→    };
    19→  }, [isActuallyModal]);
    20→}
    21→
```

```
    14→interface UseDeleteGenerationActionOptions {
    15→  projectId: string | null | undefined;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteGenerationAction({
    19→  projectId,
    20→}: UseDeleteGenerationActionOptions): UseDeleteGenerationActionResult {
    21→  const deleteGenerationMutation = useDeleteGeneration();
    22→  const [pendingDeleteId, setPendingDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    23→  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    24→
    25→  const requestDelete = useCallback((id: string) => {
    26→    setPendingDeleteId(id);
    27→  }, []);
    28→
    29→  const cancelDelete = useCallback(() => {
    30→    setPendingDeleteId(null);
    31→  }, []);
    32→
    33→  const confirmDelete = useCallback(async () => {
    34→    if (!pendingDeleteId || !projectId) {
    35→      setPendingDeleteId(null);
    36→      return;
    37→    }
    38→
    39→    const targetId = pendingDeleteId;
    40→    setDeletingId(targetId);
    41→    try {
    42→      await deleteGenerationMutation.mutateAsync({ id: targetId, projectId });
    43→      setPendingDeleteId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    44→    } catch (error) {
    45→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    46→        context: 'useDeleteGenerationAction.confirmDelete',
    47→        toastTitle: 'Delete failed',
    48→      });
    49→      // Keep the dialog open so users can retry or cancel after a failed delete.
    50→    } finally {
    51→      setDeletingId((current) => (current === targetId ? null : current));
    52→    }
    53→  }, [deleteGenerationMutation, pendingDeleteId, projectId]);
    54→
    55→  return {
    56→    pendingDeleteId,
    57→    deletingId,
    58→    isPending: deleteGenerationMutation.isPending,
    59→    requestDelete,
    60→    cancelDelete,
    61→    confirmDelete,
    62→  };
    63→}
    64→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Generation Mutations
     3→ * ====================
     4→ *
     5→ * Mutation hooks for creating, updating, deleting, and starring generations.
     6→ * Extracted from useProjectGenerations.ts to separate query and mutation concerns.
     7→ *
     8→ * ## Exports
     9→ * - `useDeleteGeneration` — Delete a generation
    10→ * - `useDeleteVariant` — Delete a variant from generation_variants
    11→ * - `useUpdateGenerationLocation` — Update a generation's location/thumbnail
    12→ * - `useCreateGeneration` — Create a new generation (external upload)
    13→ * - `useToggleGenerationStar` — Star/unstar with optimistic updates
    14→ *
    15→ * @module useGenerationMutations
    16→ */
    17→
    18→import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    19→import type { Json } from '@/integrations/supabase/types';
    20→import {
    21→  createGenerationPrimaryVariant,
    22→  createGenerationRecord,
    23→  deleteGenerationByScope,
    24→  deleteGenerationVariantByScope,
    25→  updateGenerationLocationByScope,
    26→  updateGenerationStarByScope,

    32→import { dispatchAppEvent } from '@/shared/lib/typedEvents';

    34→import {
    35→  applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate,

    44→// ===== Helper Functions (internal) =====
    45→
    46→interface ScopedGenerationInput {
    47→  id: string;
    48→  projectId: string;

    50→
    51→interface ScopedVariantInput {

    55→
    56→function ensureProjectScope(projectId: string | undefined, context: string): string {
    57→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    58→    return projectId;
    59→  }
    60→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('Mutation requires project scope'), {
    61→    context,
    62→    showToast: false,
    63→    logData: { reason: 'missing_project_scope' },
    64→  });
    65→}
    66→
    67→async function verifyGenerationScope(generationId: string, projectId: string, context: string): Promise<void> {
    68→  const scope = await resolveGenerationProjectScope(generationId, projectId);
    69→  if (scope.status === 'ok') {
    70→    return;
    71→  }
    72→
    73→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
    74→    new Error(`Generation scope validation failed (${scope.status})`),
    75→    {
    76→      context,
    77→      showToast: false,
    78→      logData: {
    79→        generationId,
    80→        projectId,
    81→        scopeStatus: scope.status,
    82→        queryError: scope.queryError,
    83→      },
    84→    },
    85→  );
    86→}
    87→
    88→async function verifyVariantScope(
    89→  variantId: string,
    90→  projectId: string,
    91→  context: string,
    92→): Promise<{ generationId: string }> {
    93→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
    94→  if (scope.status === 'ok' && scope.generationId) {
    95→    return { generationId: scope.generationId };
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
    99→    new Error(`Variant scope validation failed (${scope.status})`),
   100→    {
   101→      context,
   102→      showToast: false,
   103→      logData: {
   104→        variantId,
   105→        projectId,
   106→        generationId: scope.generationId,
   107→        scopeStatus: scope.status,
   108→        queryError: scope.queryError,
   109→      },
   110→    },
   111→  );
   112→}

   114→/**
   115→ * Update generation location using direct Supabase call.
   116→ * @internal Used by useUpdateGenerationLocation hook.
   117→ */
   118→async function updateGenerationLocation(
   119→  params: ScopedGenerationInput & { location: string; thumbUrl?: string },
   120→): Promise<void> {
   121→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   122→    params.projectId,
   123→    'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.projectScope',
   124→  );
   125→  await verifyGenerationScope(

   131→  const updateData: { location: string; thumbnail_url?: string } = { location: params.location };
   132→
   133→  // If thumbUrl is provided, update it as well (important for flipped images)
   134→  if (params.thumbUrl) {
   135→    updateData.thumbnail_url = params.thumbUrl;
   136→  }
   137→
   138→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationLocationByScope({
   139→    id: params.id,
   140→    projectId,
   141→    location: updateData.location,
   142→    thumbnailUrl: updateData.thumbnail_url,
   143→  });
   144→
   145→  if (error) {
   146→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   147→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation',
   148→      showToast: false,
   149→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   150→    });
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   154→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows updated while enforcing generation project scope'), {
   155→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.noRows',
   156→      showToast: false,
   157→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   158→    });
   159→  }
   160→}
   161→
   162→/**
   163→ * Create a new generation using direct Supabase call.
   164→ * @internal Used by useCreateGeneration hook.
   165→ */
   166→async function createGeneration(params: {
   167→  imageUrl: string;
   168→  fileName: string;
   169→  fileType: string;
   170→  fileSize: number;
   171→  projectId: string;
   172→  prompt: string;
   173→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   174→  /** Resolution in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g., "1920x1080") */
   175→  resolution?: string;
   176→  /** Standard aspect ratio (e.g., "16:9") */
   177→  aspectRatio?: string;
   178→}): Promise<GenerationRow> {
   179→  const generationParams: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {
   180→    prompt: params.prompt,
   181→    source: 'external_upload',
   182→    original_filename: params.fileName,
   183→    file_type: params.fileType,
   184→    file_size: params.fileSize,
   185→  };
   186→
   187→  // Add dimension params if provided
   188→  if (params.resolution) {
   189→    generationParams.resolution = params.resolution;
   190→  }
   191→  if (params.aspectRatio) {
   192→    generationParams.aspect_ratio = params.aspectRatio;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  const { data, error } = await createGenerationRecord({
   196→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   197→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   198→    fileType: params.fileType || 'image',
   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}
   229→
   230→/**
   231→ * Star/unstar a generation using direct Supabase call.
   232→ * @internal Used by useToggleGenerationStar hook.
   233→ */
   234→async function toggleGenerationStar(params: ScopedGenerationInput & { starred: boolean }): Promise<void> {
   235→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   236→    params.projectId,
   237→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.projectScope',
   238→  );
   239→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   240→    params.id,
   241→    projectId,
   242→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.scopeValidation',
   243→  );
   244→
   245→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationStarByScope({
   246→    id: params.id,
   247→    projectId,
   248→    starred: params.starred,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  if (error) {
   252→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   253→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar',
   254→      showToast: false,
   255→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   260→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
   261→      new Error('No rows updated while toggling generation star (possible RLS policy issue)'),
   262→      {
   263→        context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.noRows',
   264→        showToast: false,
   265→        logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   266→      },
   267→    );
   268→  }
   269→}
   270→
   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}
   350→
   351→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}
   354→
   355→/**
   356→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   357→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   358→ */
   359→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   360→  return useDeleteFromTable('generation_variants', 'variant');
   361→}
   362→
   363→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {
   364→  return useMutation({
   365→    mutationFn: ({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId }: { id: string; location: string; thumbUrl?: string; projectId: string }) => {
   366→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   367→    },
   368→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   369→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useUpdateGenerationLocation', toastTitle: 'Failed to update generation' });
   370→    },
   371→  });
   372→}
   373→
   374→export function useCreateGeneration() {
   375→  return useMutation({
   376→    mutationFn: createGeneration,
   377→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   378→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useCreateGeneration', toastTitle: 'Failed to create generation' });
   379→    },
   380→  });
   381→}
   382→
   383→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   384→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   385→
   386→  return useMutation({
   387→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   388→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   389→    },
   390→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   391→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   392→        generationId: id,
   393→        starred,
   394→        shotId,
   395→      });
   396→    },
   397→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   398→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   399→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   400→    },
   401→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
   402→      // Emit custom event so Timeline knows to refetch star data
   403→      if (variables.shotId) {
   404→        dispatchAppEvent('generation-star-updated', {
   405→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   406→        });
   407→      }
   408→    },
   409→  });
   410→}
   411→
```

```
1→import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type Listener = () => void;
     4→
     5→let openCount = 0;
     6→const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
     7→
     8→function notifyListeners(): void {
     9→  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
    10→}
    11→
    12→function getSnapshot(): boolean {
    13→  return openCount > 0;
    14→}
    15→
    16→function subscribe(listener: Listener): () => void {
    17→  listeners.add(listener);
    18→  return () => {
    19→    listeners.delete(listener);
    20→  };
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function acquireLightboxOpenState(): () => void {
    24→  openCount += 1;
    25→  notifyListeners();
    26→
    27→  let released = false;
    28→  return () => {
    29→    if (released) {
    30→      return;
    31→    }
    32→    released = true;
    33→    openCount = Math.max(0, openCount - 1);
    34→    notifyListeners();
    35→  };
    36→}
    37→
    38→export function useLightboxOpenState(): boolean {
    39→  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function __resetLightboxOpenStateForTests(): void {
    43→  openCount = 0;
    44→  notifyListeners();
    45→}
    46→
```

```
1→import type {

     8→
     9→type ParamsInput =
    10→  | PersistedGenerationParams
    11→  | GenerationParams
    12→  | Record<string, unknown>;
    13→
    14→type PrimitiveFieldType = 'string' | 'number';
    15→
    16→interface FieldMapping {
    17→  domainKey: keyof GenerationParams;
    18→  persistedKey: keyof PersistedGenerationParams;
    19→  type: PrimitiveFieldType;
    20→}
    21→
    22→const FIELD_MAPPINGS = [
    23→  { domainKey: 'prompt', persistedKey: 'prompt', type: 'string' },
    24→  { domainKey: 'basePrompt', persistedKey: 'base_prompt', type: 'string' },
    25→  { domainKey: 'negativePrompt', persistedKey: 'negative_prompt', type: 'string' },
    26→  { domainKey: 'seed', persistedKey: 'seed', type: 'number' },
    27→  { domainKey: 'guidanceScale', persistedKey: 'guidance_scale', type: 'number' },
    28→  { [REDACTED], [REDACTED], type: 'number' },
    29→  { domainKey: 'width', persistedKey: 'width', type: 'number' },
    30→  { domainKey: 'height', persistedKey: 'height', type: 'number' },
    31→  { domainKey: 'resolution', persistedKey: 'resolution', type: 'string' },
    32→  { domainKey: 'aspectRatio', persistedKey: 'aspect_ratio', type: 'string' },
    33→  { [REDACTED], [REDACTED], type: 'string' },
    34→  { domainKey: 'shotId', persistedKey: 'shot_id', type: 'string' },
    35→  { domainKey: 'sourceImagePath', [REDACTED], type: 'string' },
    36→  { domainKey: 'styleImagePath', [REDACTED], type: 'string' },
    37→] as const satisfies readonly FieldMapping[];
    38→
    39→const CONSUMED_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
    40→  ...FIELD_MAPPINGS.flatMap((mapping) => [mapping.domainKey, mapping.persistedKey]),
    41→  'originalParams',
    42→  'original_params',
    43→  'orchestratorDetails',
    44→  'orchestrator_details',
    45→  'extra',
    46→]);
    47→
    48→function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    49→  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
    50→}
    51→
    52→function isPresent(value: unknown): boolean {
    53→  return value !== undefined && value !== null;
    54→}
    55→
    56→function readPrimitive(value: unknown, type: PrimitiveFieldType): string | number | undefined {
    57→  if (type === 'string') {
    58→    return typeof value === 'string' ? value : undefined;
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
    62→}
    63→
    64→function reportMapperIssue(_context: string, _logData: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    65→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || import.meta.env.MODE === 'test') {

    69→  // Surface mapper diagnostics only in dev to avoid noisy production logs.

    72→
    73→function reportLegacyAliasUsage(
    74→  mapper: 'toGenerationParams' | 'toPersistedGenerationParams',
    75→  aliasKey: string,
    76→  canonicalKey: string,
    77→): void {
    78→  reportMapperIssue('Legacy alias key used as fallback', {
    79→    mapper,
    80→    aliasKey,

    84→
    85→function readMappedValue(
    86→  record: Record<string, unknown>,
    87→  key: string,
    88→  expectedType: PrimitiveFieldType,
    89→  direction: 'domain' | 'persisted',
    90→): string | number | undefined {
    91→  const raw = record[key];
    92→
    93→  if (!isPresent(raw)) {
    94→    return undefined;
    95→  }
    96→
    97→  const parsed = readPrimitive(raw, expectedType);
    98→  if (parsed !== undefined) {
    99→    return parsed;
   100→  }

   102→  reportMapperIssue('Dropping invalid mapped field value', {
   103→    key,
   104→    direction,
   105→    expectedType,

   107→  });

   109→}

   111→type PayloadDirection = 'domain' | 'persisted' | 'derived';

   113→type SanitizeFieldType = 'string' | 'nullable-string' | 'number';
   114→
   115→function isValidForType(value: unknown, fieldType: SanitizeFieldType): boolean {

   118→    case 'nullable-string': return value === null || typeof value === 'string';

   121→}
   122→
   123→function sanitizePayloadField(
   124→  payload: Record<string, unknown>,
   125→  key: string,
   126→  fieldType: SanitizeFieldType,
   127→  direction: PayloadDirection,
   128→  payloadType: 'orchestratorDetails' | 'extra',
   129→): void {

   131→  if (!isPresent(value) || isValidForType(value, fieldType)) {

   137→    direction,

   141→}
   142→
   143→function sanitizeAdditionalLoras(
   144→  payload: Record<string, unknown>,
   145→  direction: PayloadDirection,

   147→  const value = payload.additional_loras;
   148→  if (!isPresent(value)) {

   150→  }

   174→  payload.additional_loras = sanitized;
   175→}

   213→  sanitizePayloadField(payload, 'base_prompt', 'string', direction, 'orchestratorDetails');
   214→  sanitizePayloadField(payload, 'negative_prompt', 'string', direction, 'orchestratorDetails');
   215→  sanitizePayloadField(payload, 'model_name', 'string', direction, 'orchestratorDetails');
   216→  sanitizePayloadField(payload, 'parsed_resolution_wh', 'string', direction, 'orchestratorDetails');

   320→  }
   321→
   322→  const extra = validateGenerationExtraPayload(extractExtra(record), 'derived');
   323→  if (extra) {
   324→    out.extra = extra;
   325→  }
   326→
   327→  return out as GenerationParams;
   328→}
   329→
   330→/**
   331→ * Translate normalized domain params into persisted (snake_case) shape.
   332→ */
   333→export function toPersistedGenerationParams(
   334→  input: ParamsInput | null | undefined,
   335→): PersistedGenerationParams {
   336→  if (!isRecord(input)) {
   337→    if (isPresent(input)) {
   338→      reportMapperIssue('toPersistedGenerationParams received non-object input', {
   339→        receivedType: typeof input,
   340→      });
   341→    }
   342→    return {};
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  const record = input;
   346→  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   347→
   348→  for (const mapping of FIELD_MAPPINGS) {
   349→    const persistedValue = readMappedValue(record, mapping.persistedKey, mapping.type, 'persisted');
   350→    const domainValue = readMappedValue(record, mapping.domainKey, mapping.type, 'domain');
   351→    if (persistedValue !== undefined && domainValue === undefined) {
   352→      reportLegacyAliasUsage('toPersistedGenerationParams', mapping.persistedKey, mapping.domainKey);
   353→    }
   354→    const value = domainValue ?? persistedValue;
   355→
   356→    if (value !== undefined) {
   357→      out[mapping.persistedKey] = value;
   358→    }
   359→  }
   360→
   361→  if (isPresent(record.original_params) && !isPresent(record.originalParams)) {
   362→    reportLegacyAliasUsage('toPersistedGenerationParams', 'original_params', 'originalParams');
   363→  }
   364→  const originalParams = record.originalParams ?? record.original_params;
   365→  if (isPresent(originalParams)) {
   366→    out.original_params = originalParams;
   367→  }
   368→
   369→  const domainOrchestratorDetails = validateOrchestratorDetailsPayload(record.orchestratorDetails, 'domain');
   370→  const persistedOrchestratorDetails = validateOrchestratorDetailsPayload(record.orchestrator_details, 'persisted');
   371→  if (!domainOrchestratorDetails && persistedOrchestratorDetails) {
   372→    reportLegacyAliasUsage('toPersistedGenerationParams', 'orchestrator_details', 'orchestratorDetails');
   373→  }
   374→  const orchestratorDetails = domainOrchestratorDetails ?? persistedOrchestratorDetails;
   375→  if (orchestratorDetails) {
   376→    out.orchestrator_details = orchestratorDetails;
   377→  }
   378→
   379→  const extra = validateGenerationExtraPayload(extractExtra(record), 'derived');
   380→  if (extra !== undefined) {
   381→    out.extra = extra;
   382→  }
   383→
   384→  return out as PersistedGenerationParams;
   385→}
   386→
```

```
1→import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     3→import { processImageUrl } from '@/shared/lib/urlToFile';
     4→import {
     5→  Resource,
     6→  ResourceMetadata,
     7→  StyleReferenceMetadata,
     8→  StructureVideoMetadata,
     9→  useListPublicResources,
    10→  useListResources,
    11→  useUpdateResource,
    12→} from '@/shared/hooks/useResources';
    13→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    14→
    15→export type ResourceType = 'style-reference' | 'structure-video';
    16→
    17→interface UseResourceBrowserDataProps {
    18→  isOpen: boolean;
    19→  resourceType: ResourceType;
    20→  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
    21→  onImageSelect?: (files: File[]) => void;
    22→  onResourceSelect?: (resource: Resource) => void;
    23→}
    24→
    25→export interface ResourceBrowserData {
    26→  isVideoMode: boolean;
    27→  userId: string | null;
    28→  searchTerm: string;
    29→  currentPage: number;
    30→  processingResource: string | null;
    31→  isThumbnailLoaded: (id: string) => boolean;
    32→  markThumbnailLoaded: (id: string) => void;
    33→  showMyResourcesOnly: boolean;
    34→  toggleMyResourcesFilter: () => void;
    35→  clearMyResourcesFilter: () => void;
    36→  filteredResources: Resource[];
    37→  paginatedResources: Resource[];
    38→  totalPages: number;
    39→  loading: boolean;
    40→  handleSearch: (newSearchTerm: string) => void;
    41→  handlePageChange: (newPage: number) => void;
    42→  handleToggleVisibility: (resourceId: string, currentIsPublic: boolean) => Promise<void>;
    43→  handleResourceClick: (resource: Resource) => Promise<void>;
    44→  clearSearch: () => void;
    45→}
    46→
    47→const ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 16;
    48→
    49→export function useResourceBrowserData({
    50→  isOpen,
    51→  resourceType,
    52→  onOpenChange,
    53→  onImageSelect,
    54→  onResourceSelect,
    55→}: UseResourceBrowserDataProps): ResourceBrowserData {
    56→  const isVideoMode = resourceType === 'structure-video';
    57→
    58→  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
    59→  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
    60→  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
    61→  const [processingResource, setProcessingResource] = useState<string | null>(null);
    62→  const [loadedThumbnails, setLoadedThumbnails] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    63→  const [showMyResourcesOnly, setShowMyResourcesOnly] = useState(false);
    64→
    65→  // Reset to page 1 synchronously when filter changes (avoids extra render from useEffect+setState)
    66→  const prevShowMyResourcesOnlyRef = React.useRef(showMyResourcesOnly);
    67→  if (prevShowMyResourcesOnlyRef.current !== showMyResourcesOnly) {
    68→    prevShowMyResourcesOnlyRef.current = showMyResourcesOnly;
    69→    setCurrentPage(1);
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  useEffect(() => {
    73→    if (!isOpen) {
    74→      return;
    75→    }
    76→
    77→    const getUser = async () => {
    78→      const {
    79→        data: { session },
    80→      } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
    81→      setUserId(session?.user?.id || null);
    82→    };
    83→
    84→    void getUser();
    85→  }, [isOpen]);
    86→
    87→  useEffect(() => {
    88→    if (!isOpen) {
    89→      setProcessingResource(null);
    90→      setLoadedThumbnails(new Set());
    91→    }
    92→  }, [isOpen]);
    93→
    94→  const publicResources = useListPublicResources(resourceType);
    95→  const myResources = useListResources(resourceType);
    96→  const updateResource = useUpdateResource();
    97→
    98→  const allResources = useMemo(() => {
    99→    const publicRefs = (publicResources.data || []) as Resource[];
   100→    const ownRefs = (myResources.data || []) as Resource[];
   101→    const combined = [...publicRefs];
   102→    const publicIds = new Set(publicRefs.map((resource) => resource.id));
   103→
   104→    ownRefs.forEach((resource) => {
   105→      if (!publicIds.has(resource.id)) {
   106→        combined.push(resource);
   107→      }
   108→    });
   109→
   110→    return combined;
   111→  }, [myResources.data, publicResources.data]);
   112→
   113→  const getSearchableText = useCallback(
   114→    (resource: Resource): string => {
   115→      if (isVideoMode) {
   116→        const metadata = resource.metadata as StructureVideoMetadata;
   117→        return metadata.name?.toLowerCase() || '';
   118→      }
   119→
   120→      const metadata = resource.metadata as StyleReferenceMetadata;
   121→      return [metadata.name, metadata.subjectDescription, metadata.styleBoostTerms]
   122→        .filter(Boolean)
   123→        .join(' ')
   124→        .toLowerCase();
   125→    },
   126→    [isVideoMode]
   127→  );
   128→
   129→  const filteredResources = useMemo(() => {
   130→    const base = showMyResourcesOnly ? ((myResources.data || []) as Resource[]) : allResources;
   131→    if (!searchTerm.trim()) {
   132→      return base;
   133→    }
   134→
   135→    const lowerSearch = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
   136→    return base.filter((resource) => getSearchableText(resource).includes(lowerSearch));
   137→  }, [allResources, getSearchableText, myResources.data, searchTerm, showMyResourcesOnly]);
   138→
   139→  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredResources.length / ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
   140→
   141→  const paginatedResources = useMemo(() => {
   142→    const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
   143→    return filteredResources.slice(startIndex, startIndex + ITEMS_PER_PAGE);
   144→  }, [currentPage, filteredResources]);
   145→
   146→  const loading = publicResources.isLoading || myResources.isLoading;
   147→
   148→  const handleSearch = useCallback((newSearchTerm: string) => {
   149→    setSearchTerm(newSearchTerm);
   150→    setCurrentPage(1);
   151→  }, []);
   152→
   153→  const handlePageChange = useCallback((newPage: number) => {
   154→    setCurrentPage(newPage);
   155→  }, []);
   156→
   157→  const handleToggleVisibility = useCallback(
   158→    async (resourceId: string, currentIsPublic: boolean) => {
   159→      const resource = allResources.find((entry) => entry.id === resourceId);
   160→      if (!resource) {
   161→        console.error('[ResourceBrowser] Could not find resource:', resourceId);
   162→        return;
   163→      }
   164→
   165→      try {
   166→        const metadataObject =
   167→          typeof resource.metadata === 'object' &&
   168→          resource.metadata !== null &&
   169→          !Array.isArray(resource.metadata)
   170→            ? (resource.metadata as Record<string, unknown>)
   171→            : {};
   172→        const updatedMetadata = { ...metadataObject, is_public: !currentIsPublic };
   173→        await updateResource.mutateAsync({
   174→          id: resourceId,
   175→          type: resourceType,
   176→          metadata: updatedMetadata as ResourceMetadata,
   177→        });
   178→      } catch (error) {
   179→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   180→          context: 'ResourceBrowser',
   181→          toastTitle: 'Failed to update visibility',
   182→        });
   183→      }
   184→    },
   185→    [allResources, resourceType, updateResource]
   186→  );
   187→
   188→  const handleResourceClick = useCallback(
   189→    async (resource: Resource) => {
   190→      if (processingResource) {
   191→        return;
   192→      }
   193→
```

```
1→import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type Listener = () => void;
     4→
     5→let openCount = 0;
     6→const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
     7→
     8→function notifyListeners(): void {
     9→  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
    10→}
    11→
    12→function getSnapshot(): boolean {
    13→  return openCount > 0;
    14→}
    15→
    16→function subscribe(listener: Listener): () => void {
    17→  listeners.add(listener);
    18→  return () => {
    19→    listeners.delete(listener);
    20→  };
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function acquireLightboxOpenState(): () => void {
    24→  openCount += 1;
    25→  notifyListeners();
    26→
    27→  let released = false;
    28→  return () => {
    29→    if (released) {
    30→      return;
    31→    }
    32→    released = true;
    33→    openCount = Math.max(0, openCount - 1);
    34→    notifyListeners();
    35→  };
    36→}
    37→
    38→export function useLightboxOpenState(): boolean {
    39→  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function __resetLightboxOpenStateForTests(): void {
    43→  openCount = 0;
    44→  notifyListeners();
    45→}
    46→
```

```
     8→
```

```
    15→);
    16→
    17→const VisibilityToggleButton: React.FC<{

    23→    <Tooltip>

    28→            event.stopPropagation();
    29→            event.preventDefault();
    30→            onToggle(resourceId, isPublic);

    32→          className={`rounded-full p-1 transition-colors focus:outline-none ${
    33→            isPublic
    34→              ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/80'
    35→              : 'bg-muted-foreground/60 text-background hover:bg-muted-foreground/80'
    36→          }`}
    37→        >
    38→          {isPublic ? <Globe className="h-3 w-3" /> : <Lock className="h-3 w-3" />}
    39→        </button>

    42→        {isPublic

   217→          <ImageIcon className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />

   219→        <p className="text-muted-foreground">

   233→        {browsing.showMyResourcesOnly && (

   237→            </Button>

   239→        )}
   240→      </div>
   241→    );
   242→  }
   243→
   244→  return (
   245→    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   246→      {browsing.paginatedResources.map((resource) => {
   247→        const legacyOwnerId =
   248→          'user_id' in resource && typeof resource.user_id === 'string' ? resource.user_id : undefined;
   249→        const resourceOwnerId = resource.userId || legacyOwnerId;
   250→        const isOwner = browsing.userId && resourceOwnerId === browsing.userId;
   251→
   252→        const commonProps = {
   253→          key: resource.id,
   254→          resource,
   255→          isOwner: !!isOwner,
   256→          isProcessing: browsing.processingResource === resource.id,
   257→          isLoaded: browsing.isThumbnailLoaded(resource.id),
   258→          onLoaded: () => browsing.markThumbnailLoaded(resource.id),
   259→          onClick: () => {
   260→            void browsing.handleResourceClick(resource);
   261→          },
   262→          onToggleVisibility: isOwner ? browsing.handleToggleVisibility : undefined,
   263→        };
   264→
   265→        if (browsing.isVideoMode) {
   266→          return <VideoResourceItem {...commonProps} />;
   267→        }
   268→
   269→        return <ImageResourceItem {...commonProps} />;
   270→      })}
   271→    </div>
   272→  );
   273→};
```

```
   161→    return null;

   166→  return {
   167→    id: task.id,
   168→    task_type: task.task_type,
   169→    project_id: task.project_id,
   170→    params: task.params || {},
   171→    result_data: task.result_data,

   548→    logger.info("Task completed successfully", { 
   549→      task_id: taskIdString,
   550→      output_location: publicUrl,
   551→      has_thumbnail: !!thumbnailUrl,
   552→      follow_up_issue_count: completionFollowUpIssues.length,
   553→    });
   554→    await logger.flush();
   555→
   556→    return jsonResponse(responseData, 200);
   557→
   558→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   559→    const errMsg = error?.message || String(error);
   560→    logger.critical("Unexpected error", {
   561→      task_id: taskIdString,
   562→      error: errMsg,
   563→      stack: error?.stack?.substring(0, 500)
   564→    });
   565→    await markTaskFailed(supabaseAdmin, taskIdString, `Task completion failed: ${errMsg}`);
   566→    await logger.flush();
   567→    return completeTaskErrorResponse("Internal server error", 500);
   568→  }
   569→}
   570→
   571→// Some TS envs don't know about import.meta.main; Deno does.
   572→if ((import.meta as unknown).main) {
   573→  serve((req) => completeTaskHandler(req));
   574→}
```

```
   128→/**
   129→ * Check if all sibling segments are complete and mark orchestrator done if so
   130→ */
   131→export async function checkOrchestratorCompletion(
   132→  params: CheckOrchestratorCompletionParams,
   133→): Promise<void> {
   134→  const {
   135→    supabase,
   136→    taskIdString,
   137→    completedTask,
   138→    publicUrl,
   139→    supabaseUrl,
   140→    serviceKey,
   141→    logger,
   142→  } = params;
   143→  assertCompletionAuthContext(params.authContext, 'checkOrchestratorCompletion');
   144→  try {
   145→    const taskType = completedTask.task_type;
   146→    const config = taskType ? SEGMENT_TYPE_CONFIG[taskType] : null;
   147→
   148→    if (!config) {
   149→      return; // Not a segment task
   150→    }
   151→
   152→    const orchestratorTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskId(completedTask.params, 'OrchestratorComplete');
   153→    const orchestratorRunId = extractOrchestratorRunId(completedTask.params, 'OrchestratorComplete');
   154→
   155→    if (!orchestratorTaskId) {
   156→      return;
   157→    }
   158→
   159→    // FETCH: orchestrator task + sibling segments in parallel
   160→    const segmentTypeToQuery = config.isFinalStep
   161→      ? (config.billingSegmentType || config.segmentType)
   162→      : config.segmentType;
   163→
   164→    const orchPromise: Promise<{ data: OrchestratorTask | null; error: unknown }> =
   165→      supabase.from("tasks").select("id, status, params, result_data").eq("id", orchestratorTaskId).single();
   166→
   167→    const [orchResult, allSegments] = await Promise.all([
   168→      orchPromise,
   169→      findSiblingSegments(supabase, segmentTypeToQuery, completedTask.project_id, orchestratorTaskId, orchestratorRunId),
   170→    ]);
   171→
   172→    // VALIDATE: orchestrator exists and isn't already done
   173→    const { data: orchestratorTask, error: orchError } = orchResult;
   174→
   175→    if (orchError) {
   176→      throw new CompletionError({
   177→        code: 'orchestrator_fetch_failed',
   178→        context: 'checkOrchestratorCompletion',
   179→        recoverable: true,
   180→        message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Error fetching orchestrator task ${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   181→        metadata: {
   182→          orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   183→          fetch_error: orchError instanceof Error ? orchError.message : String(orchError),
   184→        },
   185→        cause: orchError,
   186→      });
   187→    }
   188→
   189→    if (!orchestratorTask) {
   190→      return;
   191→    }
   192→
   193→    if (orchestratorTask.status === 'Complete') {
   194→      return;
   195→    }
   196→
   197→    // FINAL STEP: tasks like join_final_stitch complete the orchestrator directly
   198→    if (config.isFinalStep) {
   199→
   200→      await markOrchestratorComplete(
   201→        {
   202→          supabase,
   203→          orchestratorTask,
   204→          orchestratorTaskId,
   205→          allSegments,
   206→          publicUrl,
   207→          isFinalStep: true,
   208→          supabaseUrl,
   209→          serviceKey,
   210→        },
   211→      );
   212→      return;
   213→    }
   214→
   215→    const expectedSegmentCountResolution = resolveExpectedSegmentCount(
   216→      taskType,
   217→      orchestratorTask.params,
   218→    );
   219→    if (expectedSegmentCountResolution.invalid) {
   220→      throw new CompletionError({
   221→        code: 'orchestrator_expected_segment_count_invalid',
   222→        context: 'checkOrchestratorCompletion',
   223→        recoverable: false,
   224→        message: `Invalid expected segment count contract for orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   225→        metadata: {
   226→          orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   227→          task_type: taskType,
   228→          source: expectedSegmentCountResolution.source ?? 'unknown',
   229→          raw_value: expectedSegmentCountResolution.raw ?? null,
   230→        },
   231→      });
   232→    }
   233→
   234→    const segmentStats = summarizeSegmentCompletion(allSegments);
   235→    const segmentGate = evaluateSegmentCompletionGate(
   236→      expectedSegmentCountResolution.value,
   237→      segmentStats,
   238→    );
   239→
   240→    if (segmentGate.kind === 'wait') {
   241→      return;
   242→    }
   243→
   244→    if (segmentGate.kind === 'fail') {
   245→      if (segmentGate.reason === 'segments_failed') {
   246→        await markOrchestratorFailed(
   247→          supabase,
   248→          orchestratorTaskId,
   249→          segmentGate.failedSegments,
   250→          segmentGate.foundSegments,
   251→          undefined,
   252→          logger,
   253→        );
   254→      } else {
   255→        await markOrchestratorFailed(
   256→          supabase,
   257→          orchestratorTaskId,
   258→          0,
   259→          segmentGate.expectedSegments,
   260→          `Only ${segmentGate.foundSegments} of ${segmentGate.expectedSegments} expected segments were found`,
   261→          logger,
   262→        );
   263→      }
   264→      return;
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    // WAIT: check if a final step task (like join_final_stitch) is still pending
   268→    if (config.waitForFinalStepType) {
   269→      const finalStitchStatus = await checkFinalStitchStatus(
   270→        supabase,
   271→        config.waitForFinalStepType,
   272→        completedTask.project_id,
   273→        orchestratorTaskId,
   274→        orchestratorRunId,
   275→      );
   276→
   277→      switch (finalStitchStatus) {
   278→        case 'pending':
   279→          return;
   280→        case 'failed':
   281→          await markOrchestratorFailed(supabase, orchestratorTaskId, 1, 1, undefined, logger);
   282→          return;
   283→        case 'unknown':
   284→          logger?.warn('Final-step status could not be classified; waiting before orchestrator completion', {
   285→            orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   286→            final_step_type: config.waitForFinalStepType,
   287→            orchestrator_run_id: orchestratorRunId,
   288→          });
   289→          return;
   290→        case 'complete':
   291→        case 'not_found':
   292→          break;
   293→      }
   294→
   295→    }
   296→
   297→    // COMPLETE: all segments done, no pending final step
   298→    await markOrchestratorComplete(
   299→      {
   300→        supabase,
   301→        orchestratorTask,
   302→        orchestratorTaskId,
   303→        allSegments,
   304→        publicUrl,
   305→        isFinalStep: false,
   306→        supabaseUrl,
   307→        serviceKey,
   308→        logger,
   309→      },
   310→    );
   311→  } catch (error) {
   312→    throw toCompletionError(error, {
   313→      code: 'orchestrator_completion_failed',
   314→      context: 'checkOrchestratorCompletion',
   315→      recoverable: true,
   316→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Completion flow failed for task ${taskIdString}`,
   317→      metadata: {
   318→        task_id: taskIdString,
   319→        task_type: completedTask.task_type,
   320→        project_id: completedTask.project_id,
   321→      },
   322→    });
   323→  }
   324→}
```
