   326→/**
   327→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)
   328→ */
   329→async function findSiblingSegments(
   330→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   331→  segmentType: string,
   332→  projectId: string,
   333→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   334→  orchestratorRunId: string | null
   335→): Promise<SegmentTask[]> {
   336→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   337→    const runIdRows = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   338→      supabase,
   339→      taskType: segmentType,
   340→      projectId,
   341→      select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   342→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   343→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   344→    });
   345→
   346→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   347→      return runIdRows;
   348→    }
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   352→    supabase,
   353→    taskType: segmentType,
   354→    projectId,
   355→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   356→    orchestratorTaskId,
   357→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   358→  });
   359→
   360→  return orchestratorRows;
   361→}
   362→
   363→/**
   364→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   365→ */
   366→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   367→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   368→  finalStepType: string,
   369→  projectId: string,
   370→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   371→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   372→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   373→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   374→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   375→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   376→      supabase,
   377→      taskType: finalStepType,
   378→      projectId,
   379→      select: "id, status",
   380→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   381→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→
   385→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   386→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   387→      supabase,
   388→      taskType: finalStepType,
   389→      projectId,
   390→      select: "id, status",
   391→      orchestratorTaskId,
   392→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   393→    });
   394→  }
   395→
   396→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   397→    return 'not_found';
   398→  }
   399→
   400→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   401→    return 'failed';
   402→  }
   403→
   404→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Complete')) {
   405→    return 'complete';
   406→  }
   407→
   408→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Queued' || task.status === 'In Progress')) {
   409→    return 'pending';
   410→  }
   411→
   412→  return 'unknown';
   413→}

   415→/**
   416→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   417→ */
   418→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   419→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   420→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   421→  failedSegments: number,
   422→  totalSegments: number,
   423→  errorMessage?: string,
   424→  logger?: {
   425→    warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   426→    error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   427→  },
   428→): Promise<void> {
   429→
   430→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   431→    .from("tasks")
   432→    .update({
   433→      status: "Failed",
   434→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   435→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   436→    })
   437→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   438→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   439→    .select('id');
   440→
   441→  if (updateOrchError) {
   442→    throw new CompletionError({
   443→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   444→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   445→      recoverable: true,
   446→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   447→      metadata: {
   448→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   449→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   450→          ? updateOrchError.message
   451→          : String(updateOrchError),
   452→      },
   453→      cause: updateOrchError,
   454→    });
   455→  }
   456→
   457→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   458→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   459→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   460→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   461→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   462→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   463→    });
   464→  }
   465→}

   467→/**
   468→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   469→ */
   470→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   471→  params: {
   472→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   473→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   474→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   475→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   476→    publicUrl: string;
   477→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   478→    supabaseUrl: string;
   479→    serviceKey: string;
   480→    logger?: {
   481→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   482→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   483→    };
   484→  },
   485→): Promise<void> {
   486→  const {
   487→    supabase,
   488→    orchestratorTask,
   489→    orchestratorTaskId,
   490→    allSegments,
   491→    publicUrl,
   492→    isFinalStep,
   493→    supabaseUrl,
   494→    serviceKey,
   495→    logger,
   496→  } = params;
   497→
   498→  // Find earliest sub-task start time for billing
   499→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   500→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   501→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   502→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   503→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   504→      }
   505→    }
   506→  }
   507→
   508→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   509→    status: "Complete",
   510→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   511→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   512→  };
   513→
   514→  // Only set output_location for final step tasks (e.g. join_final_stitch)
   515→  // where publicUrl is the actual stitched output. For segment completions,
   516→  // publicUrl is an arbitrary segment URL that shouldn't be the orchestrator's output.
   517→  if (isFinalStep) {
   518→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   519→  }
   520→
   521→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   522→    .from("tasks")
   523→    .update(updateData)
   524→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   525→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   526→    .select('id');
   527→
   528→  if (updateOrchError) {
   529→    throw new CompletionError({
   530→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   531→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   532→      recoverable: true,
   533→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   534→      metadata: {
   535→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   536→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   537→          ? updateOrchError.message
   538→          : String(updateOrchError),
   539→      },
   540→      cause: updateOrchError,
   541→    });
   542→  }
   543→
   544→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   545→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   546→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   547→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   548→    });
   549→    return;
   550→  }
   551→
   552→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   553→    supabaseUrl,
   554→    serviceKey,
   555→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   556→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   557→  });
   558→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   559→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   560→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   561→
   562→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   563→    supabase,
   564→    orchestratorTaskId,
   565→    existingResultData,
   566→    billingOutcome,
   567→    billingDecision,
   568→    logger,
   569→  );
   570→
   571→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   572→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   573→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   574→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   575→      billing_result: billingResult,
   576→    });
   577→  }
   578→}
   579→

1→/**
     2→ * Core generation CRUD operations
     3→ * Basic database operations for generations and variants
     4→ */
     5→
     6→import type { SupabaseClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.7';
     7→
     8→type ExistingGenerationLookupErrorCode =
     9→  | 'existing_generation_lookup_failed'
    10→  | 'existing_generation_lookup_duplicate';
    11→
    12→export class ExistingGenerationLookupError extends Error {
    13→  readonly code: ExistingGenerationLookupErrorCode;
    14→  readonly details?: Record<string, unknown>;
    15→
    16→  constructor(
    17→    code: ExistingGenerationLookupErrorCode,
    18→    message: string,
    19→    details?: Record<string, unknown>,
    20→  ) {
    21→    super(message);
    22→    this.name = 'ExistingGenerationLookupError';
    23→    this.code = code;
    24→    this.details = details;
    25→  }
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ===== HELPERS =====
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Helper to safely extract value from array by index
    32→ */
    33→export function extractFromArray(arr: unknown[], index: number): unknown | undefined {
    34→  if (Array.isArray(arr) && index >= 0 && index < arr.length) {
    35→    return arr[index];
    36→  }
    37→  return undefined;
    38→}
    39→
    40→// ===== GENERATION LOOKUP =====
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Check for existing generation referencing this task_id
    44→ */
    45→export async function findExistingGeneration(supabase: SupabaseClient, taskId: string): Promise<unknown | null> {
    46→  try {
    47→    const { data, error } = await supabase
    48→      .from('generations')
    49→      .select('*')
    50→      .contains('tasks', JSON.stringify([taskId]))
    51→      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    52→      .limit(2);
    53→
    54→    if (error) {
    55→      throw new ExistingGenerationLookupError(
    56→        'existing_generation_lookup_failed',
    57→        `Failed to lookup existing generation for task ${taskId}: ${error.message}`,
    58→        {
    59→          taskId,
    60→          errorCode: error.code,
    61→          errorMessage: error.message,
    62→        },
    63→      );
    64→    }
    65→
    66→    if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
    67→      return null;
    68→    }
    69→
    70→    if (data.length > 1) {
    71→      const generationIds = data
    72→        .map((row) => (typeof row === 'object' && row !== null && 'id' in row ? String((row as { id: unknown }).id) : null))
    73→        .filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id));
    74→
    75→      throw new ExistingGenerationLookupError(
    76→        'existing_generation_lookup_duplicate',
    77→        `Multiple existing generations found for task ${taskId}`,
    78→        {
    79→          taskId,
    80→          generationIds,
    81→        },
    82→      );
    83→    }
    84→
    85→    return data[0];
    86→  } catch (error) {
    87→    if (error instanceof ExistingGenerationLookupError) {
    88→      throw error;
    89→    }
    90→    throw new ExistingGenerationLookupError(
    91→      'existing_generation_lookup_failed',
    92→      `Exception while looking up existing generation for task ${taskId}`,
    93→      {
    94→        taskId,
    95→        cause: String(error),
    96→      },
    97→    );
    98→  }
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Find source generation by image URL (for magic edit tracking)
   103→ */
   104→export async function findSourceGenerationByImageUrl(supabase: SupabaseClient, imageUrl: string): Promise<string | null> {
   105→  if (!imageUrl) return null;
   106→
   107→  try {
   108→    const { data, error } = await supabase
   109→      .from('generations')
   110→      .select('id')
   111→      .eq('location', imageUrl)
   112→      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
   113→      .limit(1)
   114→      .maybeSingle();
   115→
   116→    if (error) {
   117→      console.error(`[BasedOn] Error finding source generation:`, error);
   118→      return null;
   119→    }
   120→
   121→    if (data) {
   122→      return data.id;
   123→    }
   124→
   125→    return null;
   126→  } catch (error) {
   127→    console.error(`[BasedOn] Exception finding source generation:`, error);
   128→    return null;
   129→  }
   130→}
   131→
   132→// ===== GENERATION/VARIANT CREATION =====
   133→
   134→/**
   135→ * Insert generation record
   136→ */
   137→export async function insertGeneration(supabase: SupabaseClient, record: unknown): Promise<unknown> {
   138→  const { data, error } = await supabase
   139→    .from('generations')
   140→    .insert(record)
   141→    .select()
   142→    .single();
   143→
   144→  if (error) {
   145→    throw new Error(`Failed to insert generation: ${error.message}`);
   146→  }
   147→
   148→  return data;
   149→}
   150→
   151→/**
   152→ * Create a generation variant
   153→ * @param viewedAt - Optional: if provided, marks the variant as already viewed (for single-segment cases)
   154→ */
   155→export async function createVariant(
   156→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   157→  generationId: string,
   158→  location: string,
   159→  thumbnailUrl: string | null,
   160→  params: unknown,
   161→  isPrimary: boolean,
   162→  variantType: string | null,
   163→  name?: string | null,
   164→  viewedAt?: string | null
   165→): Promise<unknown> {
   166→  const variantRecord: Record<string, unknown> = {
   167→    generation_id: generationId,
   168→    location,
   169→    thumbnail_url: thumbnailUrl,
   170→    params,
   171→    is_primary: isPrimary,
   172→    variant_type: variantType,
   173→    name: name || null,
   174→    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
   175→  };
   176→
   177→  // If viewedAt is provided, mark the variant as already viewed
   178→  if (viewedAt) {
   179→    variantRecord.viewed_at = viewedAt;
   180→  }
   181→
   182→  const { data, error } = await supabase
   183→    .from('generation_variants')
   184→    .insert(variantRecord)
   185→    .select()
   186→    .single();
   187→
   188→  if (error) {
   189→    throw new Error(`Failed to create variant: ${error.message}`);
   190→  }
   191→
   192→  return data;
   193→}
   194→
   195→/**
   196→ * Link generation to shot using the existing RPC
   197→ */
   198→export async function linkGenerationToShot(
   199→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   200→  shotId: string,
   201→  generationId: string,
   202→  addInPosition: boolean
   203→): Promise<void> {
   204→  try {
   205→    const { error } = await supabase.rpc('add_generation_to_shot', {
   206→      p_shot_id: shotId,
   207→      p_generation_id: generationId,
   208→      p_with_position: addInPosition
   209→    });
   210→
   211→    if (error) {
   212→      console.error(`[ShotLink] Failed to link generation ${generationId} to shot ${shotId}:`, error);
   213→    }
   214→  } catch (error) {
   215→    console.error(`[ShotLink] Exception linking generation to shot:`, error);
   216→  }
   217→}

    29→  invalidJsonShapeMessage?: string;
    30→  auth?: {
    31→    required?: boolean;
    32→    requireServiceRole?: boolean;
    33→    options?: AuthOptions;
    34→  };
    35→  runtimeOptions?: InitEdgeRuntimeOptions;
    36→}
    37→
    38→export interface EdgeRequestContext<TBody extends Record<string, unknown>> {
    39→  req: Request;
    40→  body: TBody;
    41→  supabaseAdmin: EdgeRuntime['supabaseAdmin'];
    42→  logger: EdgeRuntime['logger'];
    43→  auth: AuthResult | null;
    44→}
    45→
    46→type EdgeBootstrapResult<TBody extends Record<string, unknown>> =
    47→  | { ok: true; value: EdgeRequestContext<TBody> }
    48→  | { ok: false; response: Response };
    49→
    50→function deriveErrorCode(message: string, status: number): string {
    51→  const normalized = message.trim().toLowerCase();
    52→  if (normalized === 'method not allowed' || status === 405) {
    53→    return 'method_not_allowed';
    54→  }
    55→  if (normalized === 'authentication failed' || status === 401) {
    56→    return 'authentication_failed';
    57→  }
    58→  if (
    59→    normalized === 'unauthorized - service role required'
    60→    || (normalized.includes('unauthorized') && normalized.includes('service role'))
    61→  ) {
    62→    return 'service_role_required';
    63→  }
    64→  if (normalized === 'internal server error' || status >= 500) {
    65→    return 'internal_server_error';
    66→  }
    67→  if (status === 403) {
    68→    return 'forbidden';
    69→  }
    70→  return 'request_failed';
    71→}
    72→
    73→function isRecoverableStatus(status: number): boolean {
    74→  return status >= 500 || status === 429;
    75→}
    76→
    77→function buildErrorResponse(
    78→  message: string,
    79→  status: number,
    80→  format: ErrorResponseFormat,
    81→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
    82→): Response {
    83→  if (format === 'text') {
    84→    return new Response(message, {
    85→      status,
    86→      headers: extraHeaders,
    87→    });
    88→  }
    89→  return edgeErrorResponse(
    90→    {
    91→      errorCode: deriveErrorCode(message, status),
    92→      message,
    93→      recoverable: isRecoverableStatus(status),
    94→    },
    95→    status,
    96→    extraHeaders,
    97→  );
    98→}
    99→
   100→function parseMode(options: EdgeBootstrapOptions): BodyParseMode {
   101→  return options.parseBody ?? 'none';
   102→}
   103→
   104→function methodFor(options: EdgeBootstrapOptions): string {
   105→  return options.method ?? 'POST';
   106→}
   107→
   108→function authIsRequired(options: EdgeBootstrapOptions): boolean {
   109→  return options.auth?.required ?? true;
   110→}
   111→
   112→function errorFormat(options: EdgeBootstrapOptions): ErrorResponseFormat {
   113→  return options.errorResponseFormat ?? 'json';
   114→}
   115→
   116→/**
   117→ * Shared bootstrap for edge handlers:
   118→ * - OPTIONS short-circuit
   119→ * - method guard
   120→ * - runtime initialization
   121→ * - optional JSON body parsing
   122→ * - optional authentication + service-role policy
   123→ */
   124→export async function bootstrapEdgeHandler<TBody extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
   125→  req: Request,
   126→  options: EdgeBootstrapOptions,
   127→): Promise<EdgeBootstrapResult<TBody>> {
   128→  const method = methodFor(options);
   129→  const format = errorFormat(options);
   130→  const corsPreflight = options.corsPreflight ?? true;
   131→
   132→  if (corsPreflight && req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
   133→    return {
   134→      ok: false,
   135→      response: jsonResponse({ ok: true }),
   136→    };
   137→  }
   138→
   139→  const runtimeResult = initEdgeRuntime(
   140→    options.functionName,
   141→    options.logPrefix,
   142→    options.runtimeOptions,
   143→  );
   144→  if (!runtimeResult.ok) {
   145→    return {
   146→      ok: false,
   147→      response: operationFailureResponse(runtimeResult, 500),
   148→    };
   149→  }
   150→
   151→  const { supabaseAdmin, logger } = runtimeResult.value;
   152→
   153→  if (req.method !== method) {
   154→    logger.warn('Method not allowed', { method: req.method });
   155→    await logger.flush();
   156→    return {
   157→      ok: false,
   158→      response: buildErrorResponse('Method not allowed', 405, format, { Allow: method }),
   159→    };
   160→  }
   161→
   162→  let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   163→
   164→  if (parseMode(options) === 'strict') {
   165→    const parsedBody = await parseJsonBodyStrict(req, logger, {
   166→      message: options.invalidJsonMessage,
   167→      nonObjectMessage: options.invalidJsonShapeMessage,
   168→    });
   169→    if (!parsedBody.ok) {
   170→      return {
   171→        ok: false,
   172→        response: format === 'text'
   173→          ? buildErrorResponse(parsedBody.message, 400, 'text')
   174→          : parseJsonFailureResponse(parsedBody),
   175→      };
   176→    }
   177→    body = parsedBody.value;
   178→  } else if (parseMode(options) === 'loose') {
   179→    const parsedBody = await parseJsonBody(req, logger, {
   180→      mode: 'loose',
   181→      message: options.invalidJsonMessage,
   182→      nonObjectMessage: options.invalidJsonShapeMessage,
   183→    });
   184→    if (!parsedBody.ok) {
   185→      return {
   186→        ok: false,
   187→        response: format === 'text'
   188→          ? buildErrorResponse(parsedBody.message, 400, 'text')
   189→          : parseJsonFailureResponse(parsedBody),
   190→      };
   191→    }
   192→    body = parsedBody.value;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  let auth: AuthResult | null = null;
   196→  if (authIsRequired(options)) {
   197→    auth = await authenticateRequest(
   198→      req,
   199→      supabaseAdmin,
   200→      options.logPrefix,
   201→      options.auth?.options ?? {},
   202→    );
   203→    if (!auth.success) {
   204→      return {
   205→        ok: false,
   206→        response: buildErrorResponse(
   207→          auth.error || 'Authentication failed',
   208→          auth.statusCode || 401,
   209→          format,
   210→        ),
   211→      };
   212→    }
   213→
   214→    if (options.auth?.requireServiceRole && !auth.isServiceRole) {
   215→      return {
   216→        ok: false,
   217→        response: buildErrorResponse('Unauthorized - service role required', 403, format),
   218→      };
   219→    }
   220→  }
   221→
   222→  return {
   223→    ok: true,
   224→    value: {
   225→      req,
   226→      body: body as TBody,
   227→      supabaseAdmin,
   228→      logger,
   229→      auth,
   230→    },
   231→  };
   232→}
   233→
   234→function toErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
   235→  if (error instanceof Error) {
   236→    return error.message;
   237→  }
   238→  return String(error);
   239→}
   240→
   241→/**
   242→ * High-level request wrapper that standardizes edge endpoint choreography:
   243→ * bootstrap -> handler -> unified unexpected-error response -> guaranteed flush.
   244→ */
   245→export async function withEdgeRequest<TBody extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
   246→  req: Request,
   247→  options: EdgeBootstrapOptions,
   248→  handler: (context: EdgeRequestContext<TBody>) => Promise<Response>,
   249→): Promise<Response> {
   250→  const bootstrap = await bootstrapEdgeHandler<TBody>(req, options);
   251→  if (!bootstrap.ok) {
   252→    return bootstrap.response;
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  const context = bootstrap.value;
   256→  try {
   257→    return await handler(context);
   258→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   259→    context.logger.critical('Unexpected error', {
   260→      error: toErrorMessage(error),
   261→    });
   262→    return buildErrorResponse('Internal server error', 500, errorFormat(options));
   263→  } finally {
   264→    await context.logger.flush();
   265→  }
   266→}
   267→

   290→    // Wait a moment for state to update

   302→    if (internalPrompts.length === 0) { toast.info("No prompts to edit."); return; }

   304→    const promptsToUpdate = internalPrompts.map(p => ({ id: p.id, text: p.fullPrompt }));
   305→    const editRequests = promptsToUpdate.map(p => ({
   306→      originalPromptText: p.text,
   307→      editInstructions: params.editInstructions,
   308→      modelType: params.modelType,
   309→    }));
   310→
   311→    // We will update prompts one by one to show progress and handle partial failures
   312→    const originalPromptIds = promptsToUpdate.map(p => p.id);
   313→
   314→    for (let i = 0; i < editRequests.length; i++) {
   315→      const request = editRequests[i];
   316→      const promptIdToUpdate = originalPromptIds[i];
   317→      try {
   318→        const result = await aiEditPrompt(request);
   319→

   352→      if (JSON.stringify(prev) === JSON.stringify(values)) {

   360→  // Handle inside interactions to collapse active field without closing modal

   381→  const handleActiveTabChange = useCallback((mode: EditorMode) => {

   385→
   386→  const handleModalClose = useCallback((open: boolean) => {

   391→
   392→  return (

   461→}, (prevProps, nextProps) => {
   462→  // Custom comparison for React.memo to prevent unnecessary re-renders
   463→  const propsEqual = (

   465→    prevProps.prompts.length === nextProps.prompts.length &&

   468→

   470→});

1→/**
     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls
     7→ *  - Cost calculation HTTP trigger
     8→ *
     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import { buildOrchestratorRefOrFilter, extractOrchestratorRefFromParams } from './orchestratorReference.ts';
    13→import { readEdgeErrorCode } from './edgeRequest.ts';
    14→import {
    15→  operationFailure,
    16→  operationSuccess,
    17→  type OperationResult,
    18→} from './edgeOperation.ts';
    19→
    20→interface TaskQueryResponse {
    21→  data: unknown[] | null;
    22→  error: unknown;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface TaskQueryBuilder extends PromiseLike<TaskQueryResponse> {
    26→  eq(column: string, value: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    27→  or(filter: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    28→}
    29→
    30→interface TaskQueryClient {
    31→  from(table: string): {
    32→    select(columns: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    33→  };
    34→}
    35→
    36→// ===== Constants =====
    37→
    38→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    39→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    40→
    41→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    45→ *
    46→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    47→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    48→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    49→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    50→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    51→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    52→ *
    53→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    54→ */
    55→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: unknown): string | null {
    56→  const contractOrReferencePath = extractOrchestratorRefFromParams(params);
    57→  if (contractOrReferencePath) {
    58→    return contractOrReferencePath;
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    62→
    63→  const p = params as Record<string, unknown>;
    64→  const details = p.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    65→  const originalParams = p.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    66→  const originalDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    67→
    68→  return (
    69→    (p.orchestrator_task_id_ref as string) ||
    70→    (details?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    71→    (originalDetails?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    72→    (p.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    73→    null
    74→  );
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    79→ *
    80→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    81→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    82→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    83→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    84→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    85→ *
    86→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    87→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    88→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    89→ */
    90→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: unknown, taskId: string): string | null {
    91→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    92→  if (!ref) return null;
    93→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    94→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    95→  return ref;
    96→}
    97→
    98→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
   102→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
   103→ *
   104→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
   105→ *
   106→ * Usage:
   107→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
   108→ */
   109→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   110→  return [
   111→    buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   112→    buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   113→  ].join(',');
   114→}
   115→
   116→export function buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   117→  return buildOrchestratorRefOrFilter(orchestratorTaskId);
   118→}
   119→
   120→export function buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   121→  return [
   122→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   123→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   124→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   125→  ].join(',');
   126→}
   127→
   128→export interface CompletedSubTaskRow {
   129→  id: string;
   130→  generation_started_at: string | null;
   131→  generation_processed_at: string | null;
   132→  status: string;
   133→}
   134→
   135→export type SubTaskLookupStage = 'canonical' | 'legacy';
   136→
   137→export class SubTaskLookupError extends Error {
   138→  readonly code = 'subtask_lookup_failed';
   139→  readonly stage: SubTaskLookupStage;
   140→  readonly cause?: unknown;
   141→
   142→  constructor(stage: SubTaskLookupStage, cause: unknown) {
   143→    super(`[Billing] Failed to query ${stage} sub-task references`);
   144→    this.name = 'SubTaskLookupError';
   145→    this.stage = stage;
   146→    this.cause = cause;
   147→  }
   148→}
   149→
   150→export async function lookupCompletedSubTasksForOrchestrator(
   151→  supabaseAdmin: TaskQueryClient,
   152→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   153→): Promise<CompletedSubTaskRow[]> {
   154→  const canonicalResult = await supabaseAdmin
   155→    .from('tasks')
   156→    .select(`
   157→      id,
   158→      generation_started_at,
   159→      generation_processed_at,
   160→      status
   161→    `)
   162→    .or(buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   163→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   164→
   165→  if (canonicalResult.error) {
   166→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('canonical', canonicalResult.error);
   167→  }
   168→
   169→  const canonicalTasks = (canonicalResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   170→  if (canonicalTasks.length > 0) {
   171→    return canonicalTasks;
   172→  }
   173→
   174→  const legacyResult = await supabaseAdmin
   175→    .from('tasks')
   176→    .select(`
   177→      id,
   178→      generation_started_at,
   179→      generation_processed_at,
   180→      status
   181→    `)
   182→    .or(buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   183→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   184→
   185→  if (legacyResult.error) {
   186→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('legacy', legacyResult.error);
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  const legacyTasks = (legacyResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   190→  if (legacyTasks.length > 0) {
   191→    return legacyTasks;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  return [];
   195→}

   197→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====

   199→/**

   203→ *
   204→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL

   209→export interface CostCalculationTriggerValue {

   214→
   215→export type CostCalculationTriggerResult = OperationResult<CostCalculationTriggerValue>;
   216→
   217→function isObjectRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
   218→  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
   219→}
   220→
   221→function parseJsonRecord(text: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   222→  if (!text.trim()) {

   225→  try {
   226→    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
   227→    return isObjectRecord(parsed) ? parsed : null;

   232→
   233→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
   234→  params: {
   235→    supabaseUrl: string;
   236→    serviceKey: string;
   237→    taskId: string;
   238→    logTag?: string;
   239→  },
   240→): Promise<CostCalculationTriggerResult> {
   241→  const {

   243→    serviceKey,
   244→    taskId,
   245→    logTag = 'CostCalc',
   246→  } = params;
   247→  try {
   248→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   249→      method: "POST",
   250→      headers: {
   251→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   252→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   253→      },
   254→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   255→    });
   256→
   257→    if (costResp.ok) {
   258→      const bodyText = await costResp.text();
   259→      const costData = parseJsonRecord(bodyText);
   260→      if (!costData) {
   261→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`), {
   262→          policy: 'degrade',
   263→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   264→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`,
   265→          recoverable: true,
   266→          cause: { status: costResp.status },
   267→        });
   268→      }
   269→
   270→      const costErrorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(costData);
   271→      if (costErrorCode) {
   272→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`), {
   273→          policy: 'degrade',
   274→          errorCode: costErrorCode,
   275→          message: typeof costData.message === 'string'
   276→            ? costData.message
   277→            : `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`,
   278→          recoverable: true,
   279→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   280→        });
   281→      }
   282→
   283→      const skipped = costData.skipped === true;
   284→      const successFlag = costData.success;
   285→      if (!skipped && successFlag !== true) {
   286→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`), {
   287→          policy: 'degrade',
   288→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   289→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`,
   290→          recoverable: true,
   291→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   292→        });
   293→      }
   294→
   295→      const costValue = costData.cost;
   296→      if (!skipped && (typeof costValue !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(costValue))) {
   297→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`), {
   298→          policy: 'degrade',
   299→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   300→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`,
   301→          recoverable: true,
   302→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   303→        });
   304→      }
   305→
   306→      return operationSuccess(
   307→        {
   308→          status: costResp.status,
   309→          skipped,
   310→          cost: typeof costValue === 'number' && Number.isFinite(costValue)
   311→            ? costValue
   312→            : undefined,
   313→        },
   314→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
   315→      );
   316→    }
   317→
   318→    const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   319→    const errPayload = parseJsonRecord(errTxt);
   320→    const errorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(errPayload) ?? 'cost_calculation_failed';
   321→    const message = typeof errPayload?.message === 'string'
   322→      ? errPayload.message
   323→      : (errTxt || 'Cost calculation failed');
   324→    return operationFailure(new Error(message), {
   325→      policy: 'degrade',
   326→      errorCode,
   327→      message,
   328→      recoverable: costResp.status >= 500,
   329→      cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: errPayload ?? errTxt },
   330→    });
   331→  } catch (costErr) {
   332→    const message = costErr instanceof Error ? costErr.message : String(costErr);
   333→    return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] ${message}`), {
   334→      policy: 'degrade',
   335→      errorCode: 'cost_calculation_request_error',
   336→      message: `[${logTag}] ${message}`,
   337→      recoverable: true,
   338→      cause: costErr,
   339→    });
   340→  }
   341→}
   342→

    54→  defaultPrompt,
    55→  defaultNegativePrompt,
    56→  onClearEnhancedPrompt,
    57→  onImageDelete,
    58→  onImageDuplicate,
    59→  readOnly = false,
    60→  duplicatingImageId,
    61→  duplicateSuccessImageId,
    62→  projectAspectRatio,
    63→  handleDesktopDoubleClick,
    64→  handleMobileTap,
    65→  handleInpaintClick,
    66→  hasNoImages = false,
    67→  maxFrameLimit = 81,
    68→  selectedOutputId,
    69→  onSegmentFrameCountChange,
    70→  segmentSlots: parentSegmentSlots,
    71→  isSegmentsLoading,
    72→  hasPendingTask: parentHasPendingTask,
    73→  videoOutputs,
    74→  onNewShotFromSelection,
    75→  onShotChange,
    76→  onRegisterTrailingUpdater,
    77→}) => {
    78→  // Structure video + audio props from context (provided by ShotImagesEditor)
    79→  const {
    80→    primaryStructureVideoPath,
    81→    primaryStructureVideoMetadata,
    82→    primaryStructureVideoTreatment = 'adjust',
    83→    primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength = 1.0,
    84→    primaryStructureVideoType = 'flow',
    85→    onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange,
    86→    structureVideos,
    87→    isStructureVideoLoading,
    88→    cachedHasStructureVideo,
    89→    onAddStructureVideo,
    90→    onUpdateStructureVideo,
    91→    onRemoveStructureVideo,
    92→    audioUrl,
    93→    audioMetadata,
    94→    onAudioChange,
    95→  } = useTimelineMedia();
    96→
    97→  // ── Trailing segment detection ──────────────────────────────────────────
    98→  // Two-phase design:
    99→  //   PRE-ORCHESTRATOR  → "should the orchestrator reserve trailing space in fullMax?"
   100→  //                       Uses anyImageHasVideo (from segment slots) + readOnly paths.
   101→  //   POST-ORCHESTRATOR → "does the CURRENT live-last image have a video?"
   102→  //                       Uses hasLiveTrailingVideo (segment slots + live imagePositions).
   103→  //
   104→  // The split exists because the orchestrator computes fullMax before we have
   105→  // live drag positions. We tell it to reserve space proactively (small cost:
   106→  // 17 extra frames when any video exists), then do precise detection after.
   107→  // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   108→
   109→  const trailingEndFrame = framePositions.get(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   110→
   111→  const handleTrailingEndFrameChange = useCallback((endFrame: number | undefined) => {
   112→    const next = new Map(framePositions);
   113→    if (endFrame === undefined) {
   114→      next.delete(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY);
   115→    } else {
   116→      next.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, endFrame);
   117→    }
   118→    setFramePositions(next);
   119→  }, [framePositions, setFramePositions]);
   120→
   121→  useLayoutEffect(() => {
   122→    onRegisterTrailingUpdater?.(handleTrailingEndFrameChange);
   123→  }, [onRegisterTrailingUpdater, handleTrailingEndFrameChange]);
   124→
   125→  // ReadOnly path: detect trailing video synchronously from preloaded generations.
   126→  // In editing mode videoOutputs is undefined — this returns { false, null }.
   127→  const { hasTrailing: hasExistingTrailingVideo, videoUrl: computedTrailingVideoUrl } = useMemo(() => {
   128→    if (!videoOutputs || videoOutputs.length === 0 || images.length === 0) {
   129→      return { hasTrailing: false, videoUrl: null };
   130→    }
   131→    const sortedEntries = [...framePositions.entries()]
   132→      .filter(([id]) => id !== TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY)
   133→      .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   134→    const lastImageShotGenId = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1]?.[0] || null;
   135→    return findTrailingVideoInfo(videoOutputs, lastImageShotGenId);
   136→  }, [videoOutputs, framePositions, images.length]);
   137→
   138→  // Async path: strip reports trailing video URL via callback once the slot is visible.
   139→  // Safety net when parentSegmentSlots (React Query) hasn't refreshed yet.
   140→  const [callbackTrailingVideoUrl, setCallbackTrailingVideoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
   141→  const hasCallbackTrailingVideo = hasExistingTrailingVideo || !!callbackTrailingVideoUrl;
   142→
   143→  // PRE-ORCHESTRATOR: does ANY image have a completed video segment?
   144→  // Proactive reservation — small cost (17 frames padding) eliminates chicken-and-egg.
   145→  const anyImageHasVideo = useMemo(() => {
   146→    if (parentSegmentSlots?.length) {
   147→      return parentSegmentSlots.some(slot =>
   148→        slot.type === 'child' &&
   149→        slot.child.type?.includes('video') &&
   150→        slot.child.location
   151→      );
   152→    }
   153→    return false;
   154→  }, [parentSegmentSlots]);
   155→
   156→  // --- Orchestrator hook (grouped domain view-model) ---
   157→  const orchestrator = useTimelineOrchestrator({
   158→    shotId,
   159→    projectId,
   160→    images,
   161→    framePositions,
   162→    setFramePositions,
   163→    onImageReorder,
   164→    onFileDrop,
   165→    onGenerationDrop,
   166→    setIsDragInProgress,
   167→    onImageDuplicate,
   168→    readOnly,
   169→    isUploadingImage,
   170→    maxFrameLimit,
   171→    structureVideos,
   172→    primaryStructureVideoType,
   173→    primaryStructureVideoTreatment,
   174→    primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength,
   175→    onAddStructureVideo,
   176→    onUpdateStructureVideo,
   177→    onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange,
   178→    hasExistingTrailingVideo: hasCallbackTrailingVideo || anyImageHasVideo,
   179→  });
   180→  const { timelineRef, containerRef } = orchestrator.refs;
   181→  const {
   182→    fullMin,
   183→    fullMax,
   184→    fullRange,
   185→    containerWidth,
   186→    zoomLevel,
   187→    handleZoomInToCenter,
   188→    handleZoomOutFromCenter,
   189→    handleZoomReset,
   190→    handleZoomToStart,
   191→    handleTimelineDoubleClick,
   192→  } = orchestrator.viewport;
   193→  const {
   194→    state: dragState,
   195→    dragOffset,
   196→    currentDragFrame,
   197→    swapTargetId,
   198→    pushMode,
   199→    handleMouseDown,
   200→  } = orchestrator.drag;
   201→  const { selectedIds, showSelectionBar, isSelected, toggleSelection, clearSelection } = orchestrator.selection;
   202→  const {
   203→    pendingDropFrame,
   204→    pendingDuplicateFrame,
   205→    pendingExternalAddFrame,
   206→    activePendingFrame,
   207→    isInternalDropProcessing,
   208→  } = orchestrator.pending;
   209→  const {
   210→    isFileOver,
   211→    dropTargetFrame,
   212→    dragType,
   213→    handleDragEnter,
   214→    handleDragOver,
   215→    handleDragLeave,
   216→    handleDrop,
   217→  } = orchestrator.drop;
   218→  const { currentPositions, pairInfo, pairDataByIndex, localShotGenPositions, showPairLabels } = orchestrator.computed;
   219→  const { handleDuplicateInterceptor, handleTimelineTapToMove, handleVideoBrowserSelect, handleEndpointMouseDown } = orchestrator.actions;
   220→  const { endpointDragFrame, isEndpointDragging: isEndpointDraggingState } = orchestrator.endpoint;
   221→  const {
   222→    resetGap,
   223→    setResetGap,
   224→    maxGap,
   225→    showVideoBrowser,
   226→    setShowVideoBrowser,
   227→    isUploadingStructureVideo,
   228→    setIsUploadingStructureVideo,
   229→  } = orchestrator.uiState;
   230→  const { isMobile, isTablet, enableTapToMove, prefetchTaskData } = orchestrator.device;
   231→
   232→  // --- Post-orchestrator trailing endpoint (needs currentPositions) ---
   233→  const {
   234→    trailingVideoUrl,
   235→    handleExtractFinalFrame,
   236→    imagePositions,
   237→  } = useTrailingEndpoint({
   238→    currentPositions,
   239→    trailingEndFrame,
   240→    computedTrailingVideoUrl,
   241→    callbackTrailingVideoUrl,
   242→    setCallbackTrailingVideoUrl,
   243→    onFileDrop,
   244→  });
   245→
   246→  // Live trailing detection: check if any completed video is anchored to the current
   247→  // live last image. Auto-reveals trailing slot during drag without waiting for DB.
   248→  const liveLastImageShotGenId = useMemo(() => {
   249→    const sorted = [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   250→    return sorted[sorted.length - 1]?.[0] ?? null;
   251→  }, [imagePositions]);
   252→
   253→  const hasLiveTrailingVideo = useMemo(() => {
   254→    if (!liveLastImageShotGenId) return false;
   255→    // In editing mode, videoOutputs is undefined — use parentSegmentSlots instead.
   256→    // Segment slots know which image each video is anchored to (pairShotGenerationId).
   257→    if (parentSegmentSlots?.length) {
   258→      return parentSegmentSlots.some(slot =>
   259→        slot.type === 'child' &&
   260→        slot.pairShotGenerationId === liveLastImageShotGenId &&
   261→        slot.child.type?.includes('video') &&
   262→        slot.child.location
   263→      );
   264→    }
   265→    // Fallback for readOnly mode where videoOutputs is available
   266→    if (videoOutputs) {
   267→      return findTrailingVideoInfo(videoOutputs, liveLastImageShotGenId).hasTrailing;
   268→    }
   269→    return false;
   270→  }, [liveLastImageShotGenId, parentSegmentSlots, videoOutputs]);
   271→
   272→  // --- Derived pair data (augmented with pending items) ---
   273→  const imagePositionsWithPending = useMemo(() => {
   274→    if (activePendingFrame === null) return imagePositions;
   275→    const realItemAtFrame = [...imagePositions.values()].some(pos => pos === activePendingFrame);
   276→    if (realItemAtFrame) return imagePositions;
   277→    const augmented = new Map(imagePositions);
   278→    augmented.set(PENDING_POSITION_KEY, activePendingFrame);
   279→    return augmented;
   280→  }, [imagePositions, activePendingFrame]);
   281→
   282→  const pairInfoWithPending = useMemo(() => {
   283→    if (activePendingFrame === null) return pairInfo;
   284→    return getPairInfo(imagePositionsWithPending);
   285→  }, [pairInfo, activePendingFrame, imagePositionsWithPending]);
   286→
   287→  const numPairs = Math.max(0, images.length - 1);
   288→  const maxAllowedGap = 81;
   289→
   290→  // --- Pair settings handler ---
   291→  const { handleOpenPairSettings } = usePairSettingsHandler({
   292→    images,
   293→    imagePositions,
   294→    trailingEndFrame,
   295→    pairInfo,
   296→    pairDataByIndex,
   297→    onPairClick,
   298→  });
   299→
   300→  // --- Simple handlers ---
   301→  const handleReset = useCallback(() => {
   302→    if (images.length === 1) {
   303→      const newPositions = new Map<string, number>();
   304→      newPositions.set(images[0].id, 0);
   305→      newPositions.set(TRAILING_ENDPOINT_KEY, resetGap);
   306→      setFramePositions(newPositions);
   307→    } else {
   308→      onResetFrames(resetGap);
   309→    }
   310→  }, [onResetFrames, resetGap, images, setFramePositions]);
   311→
   312→  const handleDeleteSelected = useCallback(() => {
   313→    selectedIds.forEach(id => onImageDelete(id));
   314→    clearSelection();
   315→  }, [selectedIds, onImageDelete, clearSelection]);
   316→
   317→  const handleNewShotFromSelection = useCallback(async () => {
   318→    if (!onNewShotFromSelection) return;
   319→    const newShotId = await onNewShotFromSelection(selectedIds);
   320→    return newShotId;
   321→  }, [onNewShotFromSelection, selectedIds]);
   322→
   323→  // --- JSX ---
   324→  return (
   325→    <div className="w-full overflow-x-hidden relative">
   326→      <div className="relative">
   327→        <TimelineControls
   328→          timeline={{
   329→            shotId,
   330→            projectId,
   331→            readOnly,
   332→            hasNoImages,
   333→            zoomLevel,
   334→            fullMax,
   335→            showDragHint: !!(dragState.isDragging && dragState.activeId && !isMobile),
   336→          }}
   337→          audio={{
   338→            audioUrl,
   339→            onAudioChange,
   340→          }}
   341→          guidance={{
   342→            primaryStructureVideoPath,
   343→            primaryStructureVideoType,
   344→            primaryStructureVideoTreatment,
   345→            primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength,
   346→            structureVideos,
   347→            onAddStructureVideo,
   348→            onUpdateStructureVideo,
   349→            onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange,
   350→            onShowVideoBrowser: () => setShowVideoBrowser(true),
   351→            isUploadingStructureVideo,
   352→            setIsUploadingStructureVideo,
   353→          }}
   354→          zoom={{
   355→            onZoomIn: handleZoomInToCenter,
   356→            onZoomOut: handleZoomOutFromCenter,
   357→            onZoomReset: handleZoomReset,
   358→            onZoomToStart: handleZoomToStart,
   359→          }}
   360→          bottom={{
   361→            resetGap,
   362→            setResetGap,
   363→            maxGap,
   364→            onReset: handleReset,
   365→            onFileDrop,
   366→            isUploadingImage,
   367→            uploadProgress,
   368→            pushMode,
   369→          }}
   370→        />
   371→
   372→        <TimelineTrack
   373→          timelineRef={timelineRef}
   374→          containerRef={containerRef}
   375→          zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   376→          isFileOver={isFileOver}
   377→          hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   378→          enableTapToMove={enableTapToMove}
   379→          selectedCount={selectedIds.length}
   380→          onDragEnter={handleDragEnter}
   381→          onDragOver={handleDragOver}
   382→          onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
   383→          onDrop={handleDrop}
   384→          onContainerDoubleClick={handleTimelineDoubleClick}
   385→          onContainerClick={(e) => {
   386→            const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   387→            if (!target.closest('[data-item-id]') && !target.closest('button')) {
   388→              if (enableTapToMove && selectedIds.length > 0) {
   389→                e.preventDefault();
   390→                e.stopPropagation();
   391→                handleTimelineTapToMove(e.clientX);
   392→                return;
   393→              }
   394→              if (selectedIds.length > 0) clearSelection();
   395→            }
   396→          }}
   397→          containerWidth={containerWidth}
   398→          prelude={(
   399→            <>
   400→              {/* Segment output strip */}
   401→              {shotId && (projectId || (readOnly && videoOutputs)) && (() => {
   402→            const sortedEntries = imagePositions.size > 0
   403→              ? [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1])
   404→              : [];
   405→            const lastEntry = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1];
   406→            const isMultiImage = images.length > 1;
   407→            const realLastFrame = lastEntry ? lastEntry[1] : undefined;
   408→            const pendingIsLast = activePendingFrame !== null &&
   409→              realLastFrame !== undefined &&
   410→              activePendingFrame > realLastFrame;
   411→            const effectiveLastFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame : realLastFrame;
   412→
   413→            return (
   414→              <SegmentOutputStrip
   415→                shotId={shotId}
   416→                projectId={projectId}
   417→                readOnly={readOnly}
   418→                projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   419→                pairInfo={pairInfoWithPending}
   420→                fullMin={fullMin}
   421→                fullMax={fullMax}
   422→                fullRange={fullRange}
   423→                containerWidth={containerWidth}
   424→                zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   425→                segmentSlots={parentSegmentSlots ?? []}
   426→                isLoading={isSegmentsLoading}
   427→                localShotGenPositions={localShotGenPositions}
   428→                hasPendingTask={parentHasPendingTask}
   429→                pairDataByIndex={pairDataByIndex}
   430→                onOpenPairSettings={onPairClick ? handleOpenPairSettings : undefined}
   431→                selectedParentId={selectedOutputId}
   432→                onSegmentFrameCountChange={onSegmentFrameCountChange}
   433→                trailingSegmentMode={lastEntry && (trailingEndFrame !== undefined || hasCallbackTrailingVideo || hasLiveTrailingVideo) ? (() => {
   434→                  const [imageId, imageFrame] = lastEntry;
   435→                  const resolvedEndFrame = trailingEndFrame ?? (imageFrame + (isMultiImage ? 17 : 49));
   436→                  const trailingDuration = resolvedEndFrame - imageFrame;
   437→                  const effectiveImageId = pendingIsLast ? PENDING_POSITION_KEY : imageId;
   438→                  const effectiveImageFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame! : imageFrame;
   439→                  const effectiveEndFrame = pendingIsLast ? activePendingFrame! + trailingDuration : resolvedEndFrame;
   440→                  return { imageId: effectiveImageId, imageFrame: effectiveImageFrame, endFrame: effectiveEndFrame };
   441→                })() : undefined}
   442→                isMultiImage={isMultiImage}
   443→                lastImageFrame={effectiveLastFrame}
   444→                onAddTrailingSegment={realLastFrame !== undefined && lastEntry ? () => {
   445→                  handleTrailingEndFrameChange(realLastFrame + 17);
   446→                } : undefined}
   447→                onRemoveTrailingSegment={isMultiImage && trailingEndFrame !== undefined ? () => {
   448→                  handleTrailingEndFrameChange(undefined);
   449→                } : undefined}
   450→                onTrailingVideoInfo={setCallbackTrailingVideoUrl}
   451→              />
   452→                );
   453→              })()}
   454→
   455→              {/* Structure video strip(s) */}
   456→              {shotId && (projectId || readOnly) && (
   457→                structureVideos && onUpdateStructureVideo && onRemoveStructureVideo ? (
   458→                  <GuidanceVideosContainer
   459→                    structureVideos={structureVideos}
   460→                    isLoading={isStructureVideoLoading}
   461→                    cachedHasStructureVideo={cachedHasStructureVideo}
   462→                    shotId={shotId}
   463→                    onUpdateVideo={onUpdateStructureVideo}
   464→                    onRemoveVideo={onRemoveStructureVideo}
   465→                    fullMin={fullMin}
   466→                    fullMax={fullMax}
   467→                    fullRange={fullRange}
   468→                    containerWidth={containerWidth}
   469→                    zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   470→                    timelineFrameCount={images.length}
   471→                    readOnly={readOnly}
   472→                  />
   473→                ) : onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange && (
   474→                  primaryStructureVideoPath ? (
   475→                    <GuidanceVideoStrip
   476→                      videoUrl={primaryStructureVideoPath}
   477→                      videoMetadata={primaryStructureVideoMetadata || null}
   478→                      treatment={primaryStructureVideoTreatment}
   479→                      onTreatmentChange={(treatment) => onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(primaryStructureVideoPath, primaryStructureVideoMetadata ?? null, treatment, primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength, primaryStructureVideoType)}
   480→                      onRemove={() => onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(null, null, 'adjust', 1.0, 'flow')}
   481→                      onMetadataExtracted={(metadata) => onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(primaryStructureVideoPath, metadata, primaryStructureVideoTreatment, primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength, primaryStructureVideoType)}
   482→                      fullMin={fullMin}
   483→                      fullMax={fullMax}
   484→                      fullRange={fullRange}
   485→                      containerWidth={containerWidth}
   486→                      zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   487→                      timelineFrameCount={images.length}
   488→                      readOnly={readOnly}
   489→                    />
   490→                  ) : isUploadingStructureVideo ? (
   491→                    <div className="relative h-28 -mt-1 mb-3" style={{ width: zoomLevel > 1 ? `${zoomLevel * 100}%` : '100%', minWidth: '100%' }}>
   492→                      <div className="absolute left-4 right-4 top-6 bottom-2 flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/50 dark:bg-muted-foreground/15 border border-border/30 rounded-sm">
   493→                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">Uploading video...</span>
   494→                      </div>
   495→                    </div>
   496→                  ) : !readOnly ? (
   497→                    <GuidanceVideoUploader
   498→                      shotId={shotId}
   499→                      projectId={projectId ?? ''}
   500→                      onVideoUploaded={(videoUrl, metadata) => {
   501→                        if (videoUrl && metadata) onPrimaryStructureVideoInputChange(videoUrl, metadata, primaryStructureVideoTreatment, primaryStructureVideoMotionStrength, primaryStructureVideoType);
   502→                      }}
   503→                      currentVideoUrl={primaryStructureVideoPath ?? null}
   504→                      compact={false}
   505→                      zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   506→                      onZoomIn={handleZoomInToCenter}
   507→                      onZoomOut={handleZoomOutFromCenter}
   508→                      onZoomReset={handleZoomReset}
   509→                      onZoomToStart={handleZoomToStart}
   510→                      hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   511→                    />
   512→                  ) : null
   513→                )
   514→              )}
   515→
   516→              {/* Audio strip */}
   517→              {onAudioChange && audioUrl && (
   518→                <div className="mt-1 mb-2">
   519→                  <AudioStrip
   520→                    audioUrl={audioUrl}
   521→                    audioMetadata={audioMetadata || null}
   522→                    onRemove={() => onAudioChange(null, null)}
   523→                    fullMin={fullMin}
   524→                    fullMax={fullMax}
   525→                    fullRange={fullRange}
   526→                    containerWidth={containerWidth}
   527→                    zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   528→                    readOnly={readOnly}
   529→                    compact={!!primaryStructureVideoPath}
   530→                  />
   531→                </div>
   532→              )}
   533→            </>
   534→          )}
   535→        >
   536→            <DragLayer
   537→              isFileOver={isFileOver}
   538→              dropTargetFrame={dropTargetFrame}
   539→              fullMin={fullMin}
   540→              fullRange={fullRange}
   541→              containerWidth={containerWidth}
   542→              dragType={dragType}
   543→              activePendingFrame={activePendingFrame}
   544→              pendingDropFrame={pendingDropFrame}
   545→              pendingDuplicateFrame={pendingDuplicateFrame}
   546→              pendingExternalAddFrame={pendingExternalAddFrame}
   547→              isUploadingImage={isUploadingImage}
   548→              isInternalDropProcessing={isInternalDropProcessing}
   549→              projectAspectRatio={projectAspectRatio}
   550→              imagesLength={images.length}
   551→            />
   552→
   553→            <TimelineRuler
   554→              fullMin={fullMin}
   555→              fullMax={fullMax}
   556→              fullRange={fullRange}
   557→              zoomLevel={zoomLevel}
   558→              containerWidth={containerWidth}
   559→              hasNoImages={hasNoImages}
   560→            />
   561→
   562→            {/* Pair regions */}
   563→            {(() => {
   564→              const sortedDynamicPositions = [...imagePositionsWithPending.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   565→              return pairInfoWithPending.map((pair, index) => {
   566→              const [startEntry, endEntry] = [sortedDynamicPositions[index], sortedDynamicPositions[index + 1]];
   567→
   568→              const getPixel = (entry: [string, number] | undefined): number => {
   569→                if (!entry) return 0;
   570→                const [, framePos] = entry;
   571→                const effectiveWidth = containerWidth - (TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET * 2);
   572→                return TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((framePos - fullMin) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
   573→              };
   574→
   575→              const startPixel = getPixel(startEntry);
   576→              const endPixel = getPixel(endEntry);
   577→              const actualStartFrame = startEntry?.[1] ?? pair.startFrame;
   578→              const actualEndFrame = endEntry?.[1] ?? pair.endFrame;
   579→              const actualFrames = actualEndFrame - actualStartFrame;
   580→
   581→              const startPercent = (startPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   582→              const endPercent = (endPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   583→
   584→              const contextStartFrameUnclipped = actualEndFrame;
   585→              const contextStartFrame = Math.max(0, contextStartFrameUnclipped);
   586→              const visibleContextFrames = Math.max(0, actualEndFrame - contextStartFrame);
   587→
   588→              const effectiveWidth = containerWidth - (TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET * 2);
   589→              const contextStartPixel = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((contextStartFrame - fullMin) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
   590→              const contextStartPercent = (contextStartPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   591→
   592→              const generationStartPixel = TIMELINE_PADDING_OFFSET + ((pair.generationStart - fullMin) / fullRange) * effectiveWidth;
   593→              const generationStartPercent = (generationStartPixel / containerWidth) * 100;
   594→
   595→              const startImage = images.find(img => img.id === startEntry?.[0]);
   596→              const endImage = images.find(img => img.id === endEntry?.[0]);
   597→              const pairPromptData = pairPrompts?.[index];
   598→              const pairPromptFromMetadata = pairPromptData?.prompt || '';
   599→              const pairNegativePromptFromMetadata = pairPromptData?.negativePrompt || '';
   600→              const actualEnhancedPrompt = getEnhancedPromptFromMetadata(startImage?.metadata);
   601→
   602→              return (
   603→                <PairRegion
   604→                  key={`pair-${index}`}
   605→                  index={index}
   606→                  startPercent={startPercent}
   607→                  endPercent={endPercent}
   608→                  contextStartPercent={contextStartPercent}
   609→                  generationStartPercent={generationStartPercent}
   610→                  actualFrames={actualFrames}
   611→                  visibleContextFrames={visibleContextFrames}
   612→                  isDragging={dragState.isDragging}
   613→                  numPairs={numPairs}
   614→                  startFrame={pair.startFrame}

   616→                  onPairClick={onPairClick ? (pairIndex, pairData) => {

   654→
   655→            {/* Trailing endpoint - appears after last image */}
   656→            {imagePositions.size > 0 && (() => {
   657→              const sortedEntries = [...imagePositions.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
   658→              const lastEntry = sortedEntries[sortedEntries.length - 1];
   659→              if (!lastEntry) return null;

   663→              const hasTrailingSegment = trailingEndFrame !== undefined;

   666→                return null;
   667→              }

   670→              const effectiveEndFrame = trailingEndFrame ?? defaultEndFrame;
   671→              const gapToImage = effectiveEndFrame - imageFrame;
   672→              const lastImageIndex = sortedEntries.length - 1;

   718→            {images.map((image, idx) => {

   740→                    onDoubleClick: isMobile && !isTablet ? undefined : () => handleDesktopDoubleClick(idx),
   741→                    onMobileTap: isMobile ? () => handleMobileTap(idx) : undefined,
   742→                    currentDragFrame: isDragging ? currentDragFrame : null,

   744→                    onPrefetch: !isMobile ? () => {

   746→                      if (generationId) prefetchTaskData(generationId);

   754→                    duplicateSuccessImageId: duplicateSuccessImageId ?? undefined,

   769→      </div>
   770→
   771→      {/* Video Browser Modal */}
   772→      <ResourceBrowserModalBase
   773→        isOpen={showVideoBrowser}
   774→        onOpenChange={setShowVideoBrowser}
   775→        resourceType="structure-video"

   779→

1→import { useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import { getViewportLockRuntime } from '@/shared/runtime/viewportLockRuntime';
     3→import { acquireLightboxOpenState } from '@/features/lightbox/state/lightboxOpenState';
     4→
     5→interface UseLightboxViewportLockArgs {
     6→  isActuallyModal: boolean;
     7→}
     8→
     9→export function useLightboxViewportLock({ isActuallyModal }: UseLightboxViewportLockArgs): void {
    10→  useEffect(() => {
    11→    if (isActuallyModal) return;
    12→    const releaseLightboxOpen = acquireLightboxOpenState();
    13→    const unlockViewport = getViewportLockRuntime().lockLightboxViewport();
    14→
    15→    return () => {
    16→      unlockViewport();
    17→      releaseLightboxOpen();
    18→    };
    19→  }, [isActuallyModal]);
    20→}
    21→
