   126→            subjective_score = subjective_scores.get(
   127→                dim_key, subjective_scores.get(dim_name.lower(), 100.0)
   128→            )
   129→        item["subjective_score"] = subjective_score
   130→        supported_fixers = supported_fixers_for_item(state, item)
   131→        item["primary_command"] = primary_command_for_finding(
   132→            item,
   133→            supported_fixers=supported_fixers,
   134→        )
   135→
   136→        if not scope_matches(item, scope):
   137→            continue
   138→        out.append(item)
   139→
   140→    return out
   141→
   142→
   143→def item_sort_key(item: dict) -> tuple:
   144→    kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   145→
   146→    # Initial-review subjective items: highest priority (tier -3)
   147→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" and item.get("initial_review"):
   148→        return (-3, 0, subjective_score_value(item), item.get("id", ""))
   149→
   150→    # Triage stage items: tier -2, stage order, blocked after unblocked
   151→    if kind == "workflow_stage":
   152→        blocked_penalty = 1 if item.get("is_blocked") else 0
   153→        stage_index = int(item.get("stage_index", 0))
   154→        return (-2, blocked_penalty, stage_index, item.get("id", ""))
   155→
   156→    # Workflow action items (e.g. create-plan): tier -1
   157→    if kind == "workflow_action":
   158→        return (-1, 0, 0, item.get("id", ""))
   159→
   160→    if kind == "cluster":
   161→        # Clusters sort before individual findings, ordered by action type
   162→        action_pri = ACTION_TYPE_PRIORITY.get(
   163→            item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"), 3
   164→        )
   165→        return (
   166→            0,
   167→            action_pri,
   168→            -int(item.get("member_count", 0)),
   169→            item.get("id", ""),
   170→        )
   171→
   172→    impact = item.get("estimated_impact", 0.0)
   173→
   174→    if kind == "subjective_dimension" or item.get("is_subjective"):
   175→        return (
   176→            1,
   177→            -impact,
   178→            subjective_score_value(item),
   179→            item.get("id", ""),
   180→        )
   181→
   182→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   183→    review_weight = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   184→    return (
   185→        1,
   186→        -impact,
   187→        CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(item.get("confidence", "low"), 9),
   188→        -review_weight,
   189→        -int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   190→        item.get("id", ""),
   191→    )
   192→
   193→
   194→def item_explain(item: dict) -> dict:
   195→    kind = item.get("kind", "finding")
   196→    if kind == "workflow_stage":
   197→        return {
   198→            "kind": "workflow_stage",
   199→            "stage": item.get("stage_name"),
   200→            "is_blocked": item.get("is_blocked", False),
   201→            "blocked_by": item.get("blocked_by", []),
   202→            "policy": "Triage stages sort by dependency order; blocked stages follow unblocked.",
   203→            "ranking_factors": ["blocked_penalty asc", "stage_index asc"],
   204→        }
   205→
   206→    if kind == "workflow_action":
   207→        return {
   208→            "kind": "workflow_action",
   209→            "policy": "Workflow items sort after triage stages, before findings.",
   210→            "ranking_factors": ["id asc"],
   211→        }
   212→
   213→    if kind == "cluster":
   214→        return {
   215→            "kind": "cluster",
   216→            "estimated_impact": item.get("estimated_impact", 0.0),
   217→            "action_type": item.get("action_type", "manual_fix"),
   218→            "member_count": item.get("member_count", 0),
   219→            "policy": "Clusters sort before individual findings, ordered by action type then size.",
   220→            "ranking_factors": ["action_type asc", "member_count desc", "id asc"],
   221→        }
   222→
   223→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
   224→        initial = item.get("initial_review", False)
   225→        return {
   226→            "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   227→            "estimated_impact": item.get("estimated_impact", 0.0),
   228→            "subjective_score": subjective_score_value(item),
   229→            "initial_review": initial,
   230→            "policy": (
   231→                "Initial review items sort first (onboarding priority)."
   232→                if initial else
   233→                "Sorted by dimension impact (score headroom × weight), then subjective score."
   234→            ),
   235→            "ranking_factors": ["estimated_impact desc", "subjective_score asc", "id asc"],
   236→        }
   237→
   238→    detail = detail_dict(item)
   239→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "low")
   240→    is_subjective = bool(item.get("is_subjective"))
   241→    is_review = bool(item.get("is_review"))
   242→    ranking_factors: list[str]
   243→    if is_subjective:
   244→        ranking_factors = ["estimated_impact desc", "subjective_score asc", "id asc"]
   245→    elif is_review:
   246→        ranking_factors = [
   247→            "estimated_impact desc",
   248→            "confidence asc",
   249→            "review_weight desc",
   250→            "count desc",
   251→            "id asc",
   252→        ]
   253→    else:
   254→        ranking_factors = ["estimated_impact desc", "confidence asc", "count desc", "id asc"]
   255→    explain = {
   256→        "kind": "finding",
   257→        "estimated_impact": item.get("estimated_impact", 0.0),
   258→        "confidence": confidence,
   259→        "confidence_rank": CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(confidence, 9),
   260→        "count": int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0),
   261→        "id": item.get("id", ""),
   262→        "ranking_factors": ranking_factors,
   263→    }
   264→    if is_review:
   265→        explain["review_weight"] = float(item.get("review_weight", 0.0) or 0.0)
   266→    if is_subjective:
   267→        explain["policy"] = (
   268→            "Sorted by dimension impact (score headroom × weight), then subjective score."
   269→        )
   270→        explain["subjective_score"] = subjective_score_value(item)
   271→    return explain
   272→
   273→
   274→def group_queue_items(items: list[dict], group: str) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
   275→    """Group queue items for alternate output modes."""
   276→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   277→    for item in items:
   278→        if group == "file":
   279→            key = item.get("file", "")
   280→        elif group == "detector":
   281→            key = item.get("detector", "")
   282→        elif group == "cluster":
   283→            plan_cluster = item.get("plan_cluster")
   284→            key = plan_cluster["name"] if isinstance(plan_cluster, dict) else "(unclustered)"
   285→        else:
   286→            key = "items"
   287→        grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(item)
   288→    return grouped
   289→
   290→
   291→__all__ = [
   292→    "build_finding_items",
   293→    "enrich_with_impact",
   294→    "item_explain",
   295→    "item_sort_key",
   296→    "subjective_score_value",
   297→    "group_queue_items",
   298→]
   299→

1→"""Plan-order and cluster-collapse helpers for work queues."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.state import StateModel
     6→
     7→
     8→def new_item_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
     9→    """Return finding IDs added in the most recent scan."""
    10→    scan_history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    11→    if not scan_history:
    12→        return set()
    13→    threshold = scan_history[-1].get("timestamp", "")
    14→    if not threshold:
    15→        return set()
    16→    return {
    17→        finding_id
    18→        for finding_id, finding in state.get("findings", {}).items()
    19→        if finding.get("first_seen", "") >= threshold
    20→    }
    21→
    22→
    23→def apply_plan_order(
    24→    items: list[dict],
    25→    plan: dict,
    26→    *,
    27→    include_skipped: bool = False,
    28→    cluster: str | None = None,
    29→    new_ids: set[str] | None = None,
    30→) -> list[dict]:
    31→    """Reorder items according to the living plan."""
    32→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    33→    skipped_map: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
    34→    skipped_ids: set[str] = set(skipped_map.keys())
    35→    overrides: dict = plan.get("overrides", {})
    36→    clusters: dict = plan.get("clusters", {})
    37→    active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
    38→
    39→    by_id: dict[str, dict] = {}
    40→    for item in items:
    41→        by_id[item["id"]] = item
    42→
    43→    for item_id, item in by_id.items():
    44→        override = overrides.get(item_id, {})
    45→        if override.get("description"):
    46→            item["plan_description"] = override["description"]
    47→        if override.get("note"):
    48→            item["plan_note"] = override["note"]
    49→        if override.get("cluster"):
    50→            cluster_name = override["cluster"]
    51→            cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
    52→            item["plan_cluster"] = {
    53→                "name": cluster_name,
    54→                "description": cluster_data.get("description"),
    55→                "total_items": len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", [])),
    56→            }
    57→
    58→    ordered: list[dict] = []
    59→    ordered_ids: set[str] = set()
    60→    for finding_id in queue_order:
    61→        if finding_id in by_id and finding_id not in skipped_ids:
    62→            ordered.append(by_id[finding_id])
    63→            ordered_ids.add(finding_id)
    64→
    65→    skipped_items: list[dict] = []
    66→    remaining_existing: list[dict] = []
    67→    remaining_new: list[dict] = []
    68→    _new = new_ids or set()
    69→    for item in items:
    70→        item_id = item["id"]
    71→        if item_id in ordered_ids:
    72→            continue
    73→        if item_id in skipped_ids:
    74→            skipped_items.append(item)
    75→        elif item_id in _new:
    76→            remaining_new.append(item)
    77→        else:
    78→            remaining_existing.append(item)
    79→
    80→    result = ordered + remaining_existing + remaining_new
    81→
    82→    # Triage stage IDs can appear in queue_order, so plan ordering may
    83→    # scramble their dependency order.  Re-sort just the stage items
    84→    # in-place to restore unblocked-before-blocked invariant.
    85→    stage_entries = [
    86→        (i, item) for i, item in enumerate(result)
    87→        if item.get("kind") == "workflow_stage"
    88→    ]
    89→    if len(stage_entries) > 1:
    90→        sorted_stages = sorted(
    91→            [item for _, item in stage_entries],
    92→            key=lambda it: (
    93→                1 if it.get("is_blocked") else 0,
    94→                int(it.get("stage_index", 0)),
    95→            ),
    96→        )
    97→        for (idx, _), replacement in zip(stage_entries, sorted_stages):
    98→            result[idx] = replacement
    99→
   100→    if include_skipped:
   101→        result = result + skipped_items
   102→
   103→    for position, item in enumerate(result):
   104→        item["queue_position"] = position + 1
   105→        if item["id"] in skipped_ids:
   106→            item["plan_skipped"] = True
   107→            skip_entry = skipped_map.get(item["id"])
   108→            if skip_entry:
   109→                item["plan_skip_kind"] = skip_entry.get("kind", "temporary")
   110→                skip_reason = skip_entry.get("reason")
   111→                if skip_reason:
   112→                    item["plan_skip_reason"] = skip_reason
   113→
   114→    effective_cluster = cluster or active_cluster
   115→    if effective_cluster:
   116→        cluster_data = clusters.get(effective_cluster, {})
   117→        cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   118→        if cluster_member_ids:
   119→            result = [item for item in result if item["id"] in cluster_member_ids]
   120→    return result
   121→
   122→
   123→def action_type_for_detector(detector: str) -> str:
   124→    """Look up the action_type for a detector from the registry."""
   125→    try:
   126→        from desloppify.core.registry import DETECTORS
   127→
   128→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   129→        if meta:
   130→            return meta.action_type
   131→    except ImportError as exc:
   132→        _ = exc
   133→    return "manual_fix"
   134→
   135→
   136→def _build_cluster_meta(
   137→    cluster_name: str, members: list[dict], cluster_data: dict
   138→) -> dict:
   139→    """Build a cluster meta-item from its member items."""
   140→    detector = members[0].get("detector", "") if members else ""
   141→    action = cluster_data.get("action") or ""
   142→    if "desloppify fix" in action:
   143→        action_type = "auto_fix"
   144→    elif "desloppify move" in action:
   145→        action_type = "reorganize"
   146→    else:
   147→        action_type = action_type_for_detector(detector)
   148→        if action_type == "auto_fix" and "desloppify fix" not in action:
   149→            action_type = "refactor"
   150→
   151→    stored_desc = cluster_data.get("description") or ""
   152→    total_in_cluster = len(cluster_data.get("finding_ids", []))
   153→    if stored_desc and total_in_cluster != len(members):
   154→        summary = stored_desc.replace(str(total_in_cluster), str(len(members)))
   155→    else:
   156→        summary = stored_desc or f"{len(members)} findings"
   157→
   158→    primary_command = cluster_data.get("action")
   159→    if not primary_command:
   160→        primary_command = f"desloppify next --cluster {cluster_name} --count 10"
   161→
   162→    estimated_impact = max(
   163→        (m.get("estimated_impact", 0.0) for m in members), default=0.0
   164→    )
   165→
   166→    return {
   167→        "id": cluster_name,
   168→        "kind": "cluster",
   169→        "action_type": action_type,
   170→        "summary": summary,
   171→        "members": members,
   172→        "member_count": len(members),
   173→        "primary_command": primary_command,
   174→        "cluster_name": cluster_name,
   175→        "cluster_auto": True,
   176→        "cluster_optional": bool(cluster_data.get("optional")),
   177→        "confidence": "high",
   178→        "detector": detector,
   179→        "file": "",
   180→        "estimated_impact": estimated_impact,
   181→    }
   182→
   183→
   184→def collapse_clusters(items: list[dict], plan: dict) -> list[dict]:
   185→    """Replace cluster member items with single cluster meta-items.
   186→
   187→    Walks the list in order: the first member of each collapsed cluster is
   188→    replaced with its meta-item, subsequent members are skipped.  This
   189→    preserves the ordering established by sort + plan-order.
   190→    """
   191→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   192→    if not clusters:
   193→        return items
   194→
   195→    fid_to_cluster: dict[str, str] = {}
   196→    for name, cluster in clusters.items():
   197→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   198→            continue
   199→        for finding_id in cluster.get("finding_ids", []):
   200→            fid_to_cluster[finding_id] = name
   201→
   202→    if not fid_to_cluster:
   203→        return items
   204→
   205→    # Collect members per cluster (preserving encounter order)
   206→    cluster_members: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
   207→    for item in items:
   208→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   209→        if cname:
   210→            cluster_members.setdefault(cname, []).append(item)
   211→
   212→    # Build meta-items only for clusters with 2+ members in the queue
   213→    meta_items: dict[str, dict] = {}
   214→    for cname, members in cluster_members.items():
   215→        if len(members) < 2:
   216→            continue
   217→        meta_items[cname] = _build_cluster_meta(
   218→            cname, members, clusters.get(cname, {})
   219→        )
   220→
   221→    # Walk in order: replace first member of each collapsed cluster
   222→    # with its meta-item, skip subsequent members
   223→    seen_clusters: set[str] = set()
   224→    result: list[dict] = []
   225→    for item in items:
   226→        cname = fid_to_cluster.get(item.get("id", ""))
   227→        if cname and cname in meta_items:
   228→            if cname not in seen_clusters:
   229→                seen_clusters.add(cname)
   230→                result.append(meta_items[cname])
   231→            # skip individual member
   232→        else:
   233→            result.append(item)
   234→    return result
   235→
   236→
   237→__all__ = [
   238→    "apply_plan_order",
   239→    "collapse_clusters",
   240→    "new_item_ids",
   241→]
   242→

1→"""Unified work-queue selection for next/show/plan views."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass
     6→from typing import TypedDict
     7→
     8→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import (
     9→    ALL_STATUSES,
    10→    ATTEST_EXAMPLE,
    11→    build_create_plan_item,
    12→    build_subjective_items,
    13→    build_triage_stage_items,

    16→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.ranking import (

    22→)
    23→from desloppify.engine._work_queue.plan_order import (
    24→    apply_plan_order as _apply_plan_order,
    25→    collapse_clusters as _collapse_clusters,
    26→    new_item_ids as _new_item_ids,
    27→)
    28→from desloppify.state import StateModel
    29→
    30→
    31→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    32→class QueueBuildOptions:
    33→    """Configuration for queue construction."""
    34→
    35→    count: int | None = 1
    36→    scan_path: str | None = None
    37→    scope: str | None = None
    38→    status: str = "open"
    39→    include_subjective: bool = True
    40→    subjective_threshold: float = 100.0
    41→    chronic: bool = False
    42→    explain: bool = False
    43→    plan: dict | None = None
    44→    include_skipped: bool = False
    45→    cluster: str | None = None
    46→    collapse_clusters: bool = True
    47→
    48→
    49→class WorkQueueResult(TypedDict):
    50→    """Typed shape of the dict returned by :func:`build_work_queue`."""
    51→
    52→    items: list[dict]
    53→    total: int
    54→    grouped: dict[str, list[dict]]
    55→    new_ids: set[str]
    56→
    57→
    58→def build_work_queue(
    59→    state: StateModel,
    60→    *,
    61→    options: QueueBuildOptions | None = None,
    62→) -> WorkQueueResult:
    63→    """Build ranked queue items + tier metadata."""
    64→    resolved_options = options or QueueBuildOptions()
    65→
    66→    status = resolved_options.status
    67→    if status not in ALL_STATUSES:
    68→        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported status filter: {status}")
    69→    try:
    70→        subjective_threshold_value = float(resolved_options.subjective_threshold)
    71→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
    72→        subjective_threshold_value = 100.0
    73→    subjective_threshold_value = max(0.0, min(100.0, subjective_threshold_value))
    74→
    75→    finding_items = build_finding_items(
    76→        state,
    77→        scan_path=resolved_options.scan_path,
    78→        status_filter=status,
    79→        scope=resolved_options.scope,
    80→        chronic=resolved_options.chronic,
    81→    )
    82→
    83→    all_items = list(finding_items)
    84→    if (
    85→        resolved_options.include_subjective
    86→        and status in {"open", "all"}
    87→        and not resolved_options.chronic
    88→    ):
    89→        subjective_items = build_subjective_items(
    90→            state,
    91→            state.get("findings", {}),
    92→            threshold=subjective_threshold_value,
    93→        )
    94→        for item in subjective_items:
    95→            if not scope_matches(item, resolved_options.scope):
    96→                continue
    97→            all_items.append(item)
    98→
    99→    # Inject triage stage items and workflow items when plan requires it
   100→    if resolved_options.plan and status in {"open", "all"}:
   101→        synth_items = build_triage_stage_items(resolved_options.plan, state)
   102→        all_items.extend(synth_items)
   103→        plan_item = build_create_plan_item(resolved_options.plan)
   104→        if plan_item is not None:
   105→            all_items.append(plan_item)
   106→
   107→    enrich_with_impact(all_items, state.get("dimension_scores", {}))
   108→    all_items.sort(key=item_sort_key)
   109→
   110→    # Apply living plan ordering if provided
   111→    new_ids: set[str] = set()
   112→    if resolved_options.plan:
   113→        new_ids = _new_item_ids(state)
   114→        all_items = _apply_plan_order(
   115→            all_items,
   116→            resolved_options.plan,
   117→            include_skipped=resolved_options.include_skipped,
   118→            cluster=resolved_options.cluster,
   119→            new_ids=new_ids,
   120→        )
   121→
   122→    # Collapse auto-clusters into meta-items (unless drilling into a cluster)
   123→    should_collapse = (
   124→        resolved_options.collapse_clusters
   125→        and resolved_options.plan
   126→        and not resolved_options.cluster
   127→        and not resolved_options.plan.get("active_cluster")
   128→    )
   129→    if should_collapse:
   130→        all_items = _collapse_clusters(all_items, resolved_options.plan)
   131→
   132→    total = len(all_items)
   133→    if resolved_options.count is not None and resolved_options.count > 0:
   134→        all_items = all_items[: resolved_options.count]
   135→
   136→    if resolved_options.explain:
   137→        for item in all_items:
   138→            item["explain"] = item_explain(item)
   139→
   140→    return {
   141→        "items": all_items,
   142→        "total": total,
   143→        "grouped": group_queue_items(all_items, "item"),
   144→        "new_ids": new_ids,
   145→    }
   146→
   147→
   148→__all__ = [
   149→    "ATTEST_EXAMPLE",
   150→    "QueueBuildOptions",
   151→    "WorkQueueResult",
   152→    "build_work_queue",
   153→    "group_queue_items",
   154→]
   155→

    27→def detail_dict(item: dict) -> dict:
    28→    """Return finding detail as a dict; tolerate legacy/non-dict payloads."""
    29→    detail = item.get("detail")
    30→    return detail if isinstance(detail, dict) else {}

    33→def status_matches(item_status: str, status_filter: str) -> bool:
    34→    return status_filter == "all" or item_status == status_filter
    35→

    37→def is_subjective_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    38→    detector = item.get("detector")
    39→    if detector in {"subjective_assessment"}:
    40→        return True
    41→    if detector == "holistic_review":
    42→        return True
    43→    return False
    44→
    45→
    46→def is_review_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    47→    return item.get("detector") == "review"

    50→def review_finding_weight(item: dict) -> float:
    51→    """Return review issue weight aligned with issues list ordering."""
    52→    confidence = str(item.get("confidence", "low")).lower()
    53→    weight_by_confidence = {
    54→        "high": 1.0,
    55→        "medium": 0.7,
    56→        "low": 0.3,
    57→    }
    58→    weight = weight_by_confidence.get(confidence, 0.3)
    59→    if detail_dict(item).get("holistic"):
    60→        weight *= 10.0
    61→    return float(weight)

    64→def scope_matches(item: dict, scope: str | None) -> bool:
    65→    """Apply show-style pattern matching against a queue item."""
    66→    if not scope:
    67→        return True
    68→
    69→    item_id = item.get("id", "")
    70→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    71→    filepath = item.get("file", "")
    72→    summary = item.get("summary", "")
    73→    dimension = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    74→    kind = item.get("kind", "")
    75→
    76→    if "*" in scope:
    77→        return any(
    78→            fnmatch(candidate, scope)
    79→            for candidate in (item_id, filepath, detector, dimension, summary)
    80→        )
    81→
    82→    if "::" in scope:
    83→        return item_id.startswith(scope)
    84→
    85→    lowered = scope.lower()
    86→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
    87→        return (
    88→            lowered in item_id.lower()
    89→            or lowered in dimension.lower()
    90→            or lowered in summary.lower()
    91→        )
    92→
    93→    # Hash suffix: 8+ hex chars matches the tail segment of a finding ID.
    94→    if len(lowered) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+", lowered):
    95→        return item_id.lower().endswith("::" + lowered)
    96→
    97→    return (
    98→        detector == scope
    99→        or filepath == scope
   100→        or filepath.startswith(scope.rstrip("/") + "/")
   101→    )

   104→def slugify(text: str) -> str:
   105→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", text.lower()).strip("_")
   106→
   107→
   108→def _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(display_name: str) -> str:
   109→    """Map a display label (e.g. 'Mid elegance') to its canonical dimension key."""
   110→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   111→    target = cleaned.lower()
   112→
   113→    for dim_key, label in DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   114→        if str(label).lower() == target:
   115→            return str(dim_key)
   116→    return slugify(cleaned)
   117→
   118→
   119→def _subjective_dimension_aliases(display_name: str) -> set[str]:
   120→    """Return normalized aliases used to match display labels with finding dimension keys."""
   121→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   122→    canonical = _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(cleaned)
   123→    return {
   124→        cleaned.lower(),
   125→        cleaned.replace(" ", "_").lower(),
   126→        slugify(cleaned),
   127→        canonical.lower(),
   128→        slugify(canonical),
   129→    }

   132→def supported_fixers_for_item(state: dict, item: dict) -> set[str] | None:
   133→    """Return supported fixers for an item's language when known."""
   134→    lang = str(item.get("lang", "") or "").strip()
   135→    if not lang:
   136→        return None
   137→
   138→    caps = state.get("lang_capabilities", {})
   139→    if not isinstance(caps, dict):
   140→        return None
   141→
   142→    lang_caps = caps.get(lang, {})
   143→    if not isinstance(lang_caps, dict):
   144→        return None
   145→
   146→    fixers = lang_caps.get("fixers")
   147→    if not isinstance(fixers, list):
   148→        return None
   149→    return {fixer for fixer in fixers if isinstance(fixer, str)}
   150→
   151→
   152→def primary_command_for_finding(
   153→    item: dict, *, supported_fixers: set[str] | None = None
   154→) -> str:
   155→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   156→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   157→    if meta and meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers:
   158→        available_fixers = [
   159→            fixer
   160→            for fixer in meta.fixers
   161→            if supported_fixers is not None and fixer in supported_fixers
   162→        ]
   163→        if available_fixers:
   164→            return f"desloppify fix {available_fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   165→    if detector == "subjective_review":
   166→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):
   167→            return "desloppify review --prepare"
   168→        return "desloppify show subjective"
   169→    return f'desloppify plan done "{item.get("id", "")}" --note "<what you did>" --confirm'

   172→def build_triage_stage_items(plan: dict, state: dict) -> list[dict]:
   173→    """Build synthetic work items for each ``triage::*`` stage ID in the queue.
   174→
   175→    Returns an empty list when no triage stages are pending.
   176→    """
   177→    from desloppify.app.commands.plan.triage_playbook import (
   178→        TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES,
   179→        TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS,
   180→    )
   181→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   182→        TRIAGE_IDS,
   183→        TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS,
   184→    )
   185→
   186→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   187→    order_set = set(order)
   188→    present = order_set & TRIAGE_IDS
   189→    if not present:
   190→        return []
   191→
   192→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   193→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   194→
   195→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   196→    open_review_count = sum(
   197→        1 for f in findings.values()
   198→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   199→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   200→    )
   201→
   202→    label_map = dict(TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS)
   203→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   204→
   205→    items: list[dict] = []
   206→    for idx, (sid, name) in enumerate(zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)):
   207→        if sid not in present:
   208→            continue
   209→        if name in confirmed:
   210→            continue
   211→
   212→        # Compute blocked_by: dependency stages that are still in the queue
   213→        deps = TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   214→        blocked_by = sorted(
   215→            f"triage::{dep}" for dep in deps
   216→            if f"triage::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   217→        )
   218→
   219→        cmd = f"desloppify plan triage --stage {name}"
   220→        if name == "commit":
   221→            cmd = 'desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "..."'
   222→
   223→        items.append({
   224→            "id": sid,
   225→            "tier": 1,
   226→            "confidence": "high",
   227→            "detector": "triage",
   228→            "file": ".",
   229→            "kind": "workflow_stage",
   230→            "stage_name": name,
   231→            "stage_index": idx,
   232→            "summary": f"Triage: {label_map.get(name, name)}",
   233→            "detail": {
   234→                "total_review_findings": open_review_count,
   235→                "stage": name,
   236→                "stage_label": label_map.get(name, name),
   237→            },
   238→            "primary_command": cmd,
   239→            "blocked_by": blocked_by,
   240→            "is_blocked": bool(blocked_by),
   241→        })
   242→    return items
   243→

   270→def subjective_strict_scores(state: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
   271→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   272→    if not dim_scores:
   273→        return {}
   274→
   275→    entries = scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   276→    scores: dict[str, float] = {}
   277→    for entry in entries:
   278→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   279→        if not name:
   280→            continue
   281→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   282→        [REDACTED](name)
   283→        aliases = _subjective_dimension_aliases(name)
   284→        for cli_key in entry.get("cli_keys", []):
   285→            key = str(cli_key).strip().lower()
   286→            if not key:
   287→                continue
   288→            aliases.add(key)
   289→            aliases.add(slugify(key))
   290→        aliases.add(dim_key.lower())
   291→        aliases.add(slugify(dim_key))
   292→        for alias in aliases:
   293→            scores[alias] = strict_val
   294→    return scores

   297→def _unassessed_entries_from_dim_scores(dim_scores: dict) -> list[dict]:
   298→    """Build scorecard-like entries for unassessed placeholder dimensions.
   299→
   300→    ``scorecard_subjective_entries`` goes through the scorecard pipeline which
   301→    intentionally hides placeholders from display.  This function reads
   302→    ``dimension_scores`` directly so initial-review items are never lost.
   303→    """
   304→    entries: list[dict] = []
   305→    for name, data in dim_scores.items():
   306→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   307→            continue
   308→        detectors = data.get("detectors", {})
   309→        meta = detectors.get("subjective_assessment")
   310→        if not isinstance(meta, dict):
   311→            continue
   312→        if not meta.get("placeholder"):
   313→            continue
   314→        dim_key = meta.get("dimension_key", "")
   315→        entries.append(
   316→            {
   317→                "name": name,
   318→                "score": float(data.get("score", 0.0)),
   319→                "strict": float(data.get("strict", 0.0)),
   320→                "checks": int(data.get("checks", 0) or 0),
   321→                "issues": int(data.get("issues", 0) or 0),
   322→                "tier": int(data.get("tier", 4) or 4),
   323→                "placeholder": True,
   324→                "stale": False,
   325→                "dimension_key": dim_key,
   326→                "cli_keys": [dim_key] if dim_key else [],
   327→            }
   328→        )
   329→    return entries
   330→
   331→
   332→def build_subjective_items(
   333→    state: dict, findings: dict, *, threshold: float = 100.0
   334→) -> list[dict]:
   335→    """Create synthetic subjective work items."""
   336→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   337→    if not dim_scores:
   338→        return []
   339→    threshold = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(threshold)))
   340→
   341→    subjective_entries = scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores)
   342→
   343→    # The scorecard pipeline hides unassessed placeholders from display.
   344→    # Merge them in so initial-review items always appear in the queue.
   345→    seen_dims: set[str] = {
   346→        str(e.get("dimension_key", "")).lower()
   347→        for e in subjective_entries
   348→        if e.get("dimension_key")
   349→    }
   350→    for entry in _unassessed_entries_from_dim_scores(dim_scores):
   351→        dk = str(entry.get("dimension_key", "")).lower()
   352→        if dk and dk not in seen_dims:
   353→            subjective_entries.append(entry)
   354→            seen_dims.add(dk)
   355→
   356→    if not subjective_entries:
   357→        return []
   358→    unassessed_dims = {
   359→        str(name).strip()
   360→        for name in unassessed_subjective_dimensions(
   361→            dim_scores
   362→        )
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    # Review findings are keyed by raw dimension name (snake_case).
   366→    review_open_by_dim: dict[str, int] = {}
   367→    for finding in findings.values():
   368→        if finding.get("status") != "open" or finding.get("detector") != "review":
   369→            continue
   370→        dim_key = str(detail_dict(finding).get("dimension", "")).strip().lower()
   371→        if not dim_key:
   372→            continue
   373→        review_open_by_dim[dim_key] = review_open_by_dim.get(dim_key, 0) + 1
   374→
   375→    items: list[dict] = []
   376→    def _prepare_command(
   377→        cli_keys: list[str],
   378→        *,
   379→        force_review_rerun: bool = False,
   380→    ) -> str:
   381→        command = "desloppify review --prepare"
   382→        if cli_keys:
   383→            command += " --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   384→        if force_review_rerun:
   385→            command += " --force-review-rerun"
   386→        return command
   387→
   388→    for entry in subjective_entries:
   389→        name = str(entry.get("name", "")).strip()
   390→        if not name:
   391→            continue
   392→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   393→        if strict_val >= threshold:
   394→            continue
   395→
   396→        [REDACTED](name)
   397→        aliases = set(_subjective_dimension_aliases(name))
   398→        cli_keys = [
   399→            str(key).strip().lower()
   400→            for key in entry.get("cli_keys", [])
   401→            if str(key).strip()
   402→        ]
   403→        aliases.update(cli_keys)
   404→        aliases.update(slugify(key) for key in cli_keys)
   405→        open_review = sum(review_open_by_dim.get(alias, 0) for alias in aliases)
   406→        is_unassessed = bool(entry.get("placeholder")) or (
   407→            name in unassessed_dims
   408→            or (strict_val <= 0.0 and int(entry.get("issues", 0)) == 0)
   409→        )
   410→        is_stale = bool(entry.get("stale"))
   411→        # If review findings already exist for this dimension, triage/fix them
   412→        # before suggesting another review refresh pass.
   413→        if open_review > 0:
   414→            primary_command = "desloppify show review --status open"
   415→        elif is_unassessed:
   416→            primary_command = _prepare_command(cli_keys)
   417→        else:
   418→            primary_command = _prepare_command(
   419→                cli_keys,
   420→                force_review_rerun=True,
   421→            )
   422→        stale_tag = " [stale — re-review]" if is_stale else ""
   423→        summary = f"Subjective dimension below target: {name} ({strict_val:.1f}%){stale_tag}"
   424→        items.append(
   425→            {
   426→                "id": f"subjective::{slugify(dim_key)}",
   427→                "detector": "subjective_assessment",
   428→                "file": ".",
   429→                "confidence": "medium",
   430→                "summary": summary,
   431→                "detail": {
   432→                    "dimension_name": name,
   433→                    "dimension": dim_key,
   434→                    "issues": int(entry.get("issues", 0)),
   435→                    "strict_score": strict_val,
   436→                    "open_review_findings": open_review,
   437→                    "cli_keys": cli_keys,
   438→                },
   439→                "status": "open",
   440→                "kind": "subjective_dimension",
   441→                "primary_command": primary_command,
   442→                "initial_review": is_unassessed,
   443→                "stale_review": is_stale and not is_unassessed,
   444→            }
   445→        )
   446→    return items
   447→

   104→def _build_dimensions() -> list[Dimension]:
   105→    """Derive dimensions from DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.
   106→
   107→    Each unique (dimension, tier) pair becomes a Dimension, with its detectors
   108→    collected automatically. Order follows first-seen in the policies dict.
   109→    """
   110→    # Collect (dimension_name -> tier) preserving first-seen order,
   111→    # and group detectors by dimension.
   112→    dim_tiers: dict[str, int] = {}
   113→    grouped: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   114→    for detector, policy in DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.items():
   115→        if policy.dimension is None or policy.tier is None:
   116→            continue
   117→        if policy.dimension not in dim_tiers:
   118→            dim_tiers[policy.dimension] = policy.tier
   119→            grouped[policy.dimension] = []
   120→        grouped[policy.dimension].append(detector)
   121→    return [
   122→        Dimension(name=name, tier=tier, detectors=grouped[name])
   123→        for name, tier in dim_tiers.items()
   124→    ]
   125→

   127→DIMENSIONS = _build_dimensions()
   128→DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME = {d.name: d for d in DIMENSIONS}

   136→CONFIDENCE_WEIGHTS = {Confidence.HIGH: 1.0, Confidence.MEDIUM: 0.7, Confidence.LOW: 0.3}

   138→# Minimum checks for full dimension weight — below this, weight is dampened

   140→MIN_SAMPLE = 200

   142→# Holistic review weight: findings with file="." and detail.holistic=True

   146→HOLISTIC_MULTIPLIER = 10.0

   149→# Budget: subjective dimensions get this fraction of the overall score.

   191→
   192→# Tolerance for treating a subjective score as "on target" in integrity checks.

   195→
   196→
   197→def matches_target_score(
   198→    score: object,
   199→    target: object,
   200→    *,
   201→    tolerance: float = SUBJECTIVE_TARGET_MATCH_TOLERANCE,
   202→) -> bool:
   203→    """Return True when score is within tolerance of target."""
   204→    try:
   205→        score_value = float(score)
   206→        target_value = float(target)
   207→        tolerance_value = max(0.0, float(tolerance))
   208→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   209→        return False
   210→    return abs(score_value - target_value) <= tolerance_value

   213→def register_scoring_policy(policy: DetectorScoringPolicy) -> None:
   214→    """Register a scoring policy at runtime (used by generic plugins)."""
   215→    DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES[policy.detector] = policy
   216→    _rebuild_derived()
   217→
   218→
   219→def reset_registered_scoring_policies() -> None:
   220→    """Reset runtime-added scoring policies to built-in defaults."""
   221→    DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.clear()
   222→    DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.update(_BASE_DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES)
   223→    _rebuild_derived()

   226→def _rebuild_derived() -> None:
   227→    """Rebuild DIMENSIONS, DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME, FILE_BASED_DETECTORS from current state.
   228→
   229→    Mutates existing objects in-place so that all references (including imports
   230→    that bound the original objects) see the updates.
   231→    """
   232→    new_dims = _build_dimensions()
   233→    DIMENSIONS.clear()
   234→    DIMENSIONS.extend(new_dims)
   235→    DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME.clear()
   236→    DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME.update({d.name: d for d in DIMENSIONS})
   237→    FILE_BASED_DETECTORS.clear()
   238→    FILE_BASED_DETECTORS.update(

   240→    )

1→"""Health score aggregation helpers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.core._internal.text_utils import is_numeric
     6→from desloppify.engine._scoring.policy.core import (
     7→    MECHANICAL_DIMENSION_WEIGHTS,
     8→    MECHANICAL_WEIGHT_FRACTION,
     9→    MIN_SAMPLE,
    10→    SUBJECTIVE_DIMENSION_WEIGHTS,
    11→    SUBJECTIVE_WEIGHT_FRACTION,
    12→)
    13→
    14→
    15→def _normalize_dimension_name(name: str) -> str:
    16→    return " ".join(str(name).strip().lower().split())
    17→
    18→
    19→def _mechanical_dimension_weight(name: str) -> float:
    20→    return float(
    21→        MECHANICAL_DIMENSION_WEIGHTS.get(
    22→            _normalize_dimension_name(name),
    23→            1.0,
    24→        )
    25→    )
    26→
    27→
    28→def _subjective_dimension_weight(name: str, data: dict) -> float:
    29→    subjective_meta = (
    30→        data.get("detectors", {}).get("subjective_assessment", {})
    31→        if isinstance(data, dict)
    32→        else {}
    33→    )
    34→    configured = (
    35→        subjective_meta.get("configured_weight")
    36→        if isinstance(subjective_meta, dict)
    37→        else None
    38→    )
    39→    if is_numeric(configured):
    40→        return max(0.0, float(configured))
    41→
    42→    return float(
    43→        SUBJECTIVE_DIMENSION_WEIGHTS.get(
    44→            _normalize_dimension_name(name),
    45→            1.0,
    46→        )
    47→    )
    48→
    49→
    50→def compute_health_breakdown(
    51→    dimension_scores: dict,
    52→    *,
    53→    score_key: str = "score",
    54→) -> dict[str, object]:
    55→    """Return pool averages and weighted contribution breakdown for score transparency."""
    56→    if not dimension_scores:
    57→        return {
    58→            "overall_score": 100.0,
    59→            "mechanical_fraction": 1.0,
    60→            "subjective_fraction": 0.0,
    61→            "mechanical_avg": 100.0,
    62→            "subjective_avg": None,
    63→            "entries": [],
    64→        }
    65→
    66→    mech_sum = 0.0
    67→    mech_weight = 0.0
    68→    subj_sum = 0.0
    69→    subj_weight = 0.0
    70→    mechanical_rows: list[dict[str, float | str]] = []
    71→    subjective_rows: list[dict[str, float | str]] = []
    72→
    73→    for name, data in dimension_scores.items():
    74→        score = float(data.get(score_key, data.get("score", 0.0)))
    75→        is_subjective = "subjective_assessment" in data.get("detectors", {})
    76→        if is_subjective:
    77→            configured = max(0.0, _subjective_dimension_weight(name, data))
    78→            effective = configured
    79→            subj_sum += score * effective
    80→            subj_weight += effective
    81→            subjective_rows.append(
    82→                {
    83→                    "name": str(name),
    84→                    "score": score,
    85→                    "configured_weight": configured,
    86→                    "effective_weight": effective,
    87→                }
    88→            )
    89→            continue
    90→
    91→        checks = float(data.get("checks", 0) or 0)
    92→        sample_factor = min(1.0, checks / MIN_SAMPLE) if checks > 0 else 0.0
    93→        configured = max(0.0, _mechanical_dimension_weight(name))
    94→        effective = configured * sample_factor
    95→        mech_sum += score * effective
    96→        mech_weight += effective
    97→        mechanical_rows.append(
    98→            {
    99→                "name": str(name),
   100→                "score": score,
   101→                "checks": checks,
   102→                "sample_factor": sample_factor,
   103→                "configured_weight": configured,
   104→                "effective_weight": effective,
   105→            }
   106→        )
   107→
   108→    mech_avg = (mech_sum / mech_weight) if mech_weight > 0 else 100.0
   109→    subj_avg = (subj_sum / subj_weight) if subj_weight > 0 else None
   110→
   111→    if subj_avg is None:
   112→        mechanical_fraction = 1.0
   113→        subjective_fraction = 0.0
   114→        overall_score = round(mech_avg, 1)
   115→    elif mech_weight == 0:
   116→        mechanical_fraction = 0.0
   117→        subjective_fraction = 1.0
   118→        overall_score = round(subj_avg, 1)
   119→    else:
   120→        mechanical_fraction = MECHANICAL_WEIGHT_FRACTION
   121→        subjective_fraction = SUBJECTIVE_WEIGHT_FRACTION
   122→        overall_score = round(
   123→            mech_avg * mechanical_fraction + subj_avg * subjective_fraction,
   124→            1,
   125→        )
   126→
   127→    entries: list[dict[str, float | str]] = []
   128→    for row in mechanical_rows:
   129→        pool_share = (
   130→            float(row["effective_weight"]) / mech_weight if mech_weight > 0 else 0.0
   131→        )
   132→        per_point = mechanical_fraction * pool_share
   133→        score = float(row["score"])
   134→        entries.append(
   135→            {
   136→                "name": str(row["name"]),
   137→                "pool": "mechanical",
   138→                "score": score,
   139→                "checks": float(row["checks"]),
   140→                "sample_factor": float(row["sample_factor"]),
   141→                "configured_weight": float(row["configured_weight"]),
   142→                "effective_weight": float(row["effective_weight"]),
   143→                "pool_share": pool_share,
   144→                "overall_per_point": per_point,
   145→                "overall_contribution": per_point * score,
   146→                "overall_drag": per_point * (100.0 - score),
   147→            }
   148→        )
   149→
   150→    for row in subjective_rows:
   151→        pool_share = (
   152→            float(row["effective_weight"]) / subj_weight if subj_weight > 0 else 0.0
   153→        )
   154→        per_point = subjective_fraction * pool_share
   155→        score = float(row["score"])
   156→        entries.append(
   157→            {
   158→                "name": str(row["name"]),
   159→                "pool": "subjective",
   160→                "score": score,
   161→                "checks": 0.0,
   162→                "sample_factor": 1.0,
   163→                "configured_weight": float(row["configured_weight"]),
   164→                "effective_weight": float(row["effective_weight"]),
   165→                "pool_share": pool_share,
   166→                "overall_per_point": per_point,
   167→                "overall_contribution": per_point * score,
   168→                "overall_drag": per_point * (100.0 - score),
   169→            }
   170→        )
   171→
   172→    return {
   173→        "overall_score": overall_score,
   174→        "mechanical_fraction": mechanical_fraction,
   175→        "subjective_fraction": subjective_fraction,
   176→        "mechanical_avg": mech_avg,
   177→        "subjective_avg": subj_avg,
   178→        "entries": entries,
   179→    }
   180→
   181→
   182→def compute_health_score(
   183→    dimension_scores: dict,
   184→    *,
   185→    score_key: str = "score",
   186→) -> float:
   187→    """Budget-weighted blend of mechanical and subjective dimension scores."""
   188→    return float(
   189→        compute_health_breakdown(dimension_scores, score_key=score_key)[
   190→            "overall_score"
   191→        ]
   192→    )
   193→
   194→
   195→__all__ = ["compute_health_breakdown", "compute_health_score"]
   196→
   197→

     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.engine._scoring.policy.core import (
     6→    DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES,

    11→from desloppify.engine._scoring.results.health import compute_health_score
    12→
    13→
    14→def compute_score_impact(
    15→    dimension_scores: dict,
    16→    potentials: dict[str, int],
    17→    detector: str,
    18→    issues_to_fix: int,
    19→) -> float:
    20→    """Estimate score improvement from fixing N issues in a detector."""
    21→    target_dim = None
    22→    for dim in DIMENSIONS:
    23→        if detector in dim.detectors:
    24→            target_dim = dim
    25→            break
    26→    if target_dim is None or target_dim.name not in dimension_scores:
    27→        return 0.0
    28→
    29→    potential = potentials.get(detector, 0)
    30→    if potential <= 0:
    31→        return 0.0
    32→
    33→    dim_data = dimension_scores[target_dim.name]
    34→    old_score = compute_health_score(dimension_scores)
    35→
    36→    det_data = dim_data["detectors"].get(detector)
    37→    if not det_data:
    38→        return 0.0
    39→
    40→    old_weighted = det_data["weighted_failures"]
    41→    new_weighted = max(0.0, old_weighted - issues_to_fix * 1.0)
    42→
    43→    total_potential = 0
    44→    total_new_weighted_failures = 0.0
    45→    for det in target_dim.detectors:
    46→        det_values = dim_data["detectors"].get(det)
    47→        if not det_values:
    48→            continue
    49→        total_potential += det_values["potential"]
    50→        if det == detector:
    51→            total_new_weighted_failures += new_weighted
    52→        else:
    53→            total_new_weighted_failures += det_values["weighted_failures"]
    54→    if total_potential <= 0:
    55→        return 0.0
    56→
    57→    new_dim_score = (
    58→        max(
    59→            0.0,
    60→            (total_potential - total_new_weighted_failures) / total_potential,
    61→        )
    62→        * 100
    63→    )
    64→
    65→    simulated = {name: dict(data) for name, data in dimension_scores.items()}
    66→    simulated[target_dim.name] = {**dim_data, "score": round(new_dim_score, 1)}
    67→    new_score = compute_health_score(simulated)
    68→    return round(new_score - old_score, 1)
    69→
    70→
    71→def get_dimension_for_detector(detector: str) -> Dimension | None:
    72→    """Look up which dimension a detector belongs to."""
    73→    policy = DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.get(detector)
    74→    if not policy or policy.dimension is None:
    75→        return None
    76→    return DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME.get(policy.dimension)
    77→

   109→                )
   110→            return (

   114→
   115→    # Leverage point (lowest dimension with biggest impact)

   206→        "regression": "Recent regressions should be contained before new work.",
   207→        "stagnation": "Current approach is stalling; tackle a different high-impact lane.",
   208→        "maintenance": "Keep the codebase stable by resolving new risk quickly.",
   209→    }
   210→    return phase_default.get(phase, "Address the highest-impact open findings first.")
   211→
   212→
   213→def compute_verification_step(_command: str | None) -> VerificationStep:
   214→    """Verification step returned with every narrative plan."""
   215→    return {
   216→        "command": "desloppify scan",
   217→        "reason": "revalidate after changes",
   218→    }
   219→
   220→
   221→def compute_risk_flags(state: StateModel, debt: dict) -> list[RiskFlag]:
   222→    """Build ordered risk flags from suppression and wontfix debt signals."""
   223→    flags: list[RiskFlag] = []
   224→
   225→    ignore_integrity = state.get("ignore_integrity", {})
   226→    suppressed_pct = float(ignore_integrity.get("suppressed_pct", 0.0) or 0.0)
   227→    ignored_count = int(ignore_integrity.get("ignored", 0) or 0)
   228→    if suppressed_pct >= _HIGH_IGNORE_SUPPRESSION_THRESHOLD or ignored_count >= 100:
   229→        severity = "high" if suppressed_pct >= 40.0 or ignored_count >= 200 else "medium"
   230→        message = (
   231→            f"{suppressed_pct:.1f}% findings hidden by ignore patterns"
   232→            if suppressed_pct > 0
   233→            else f"{ignored_count} findings hidden by ignore patterns"
   234→        )
   235→        flags.append(
   236→            {
   237→                "type": "high_ignore_suppression",
   238→                "severity": severity,
   239→                "message": message,
   240→            }
   241→        )
   242→
   243→    wontfix_count = int(debt.get("wontfix_count", 0) or 0)
   244→    overall_gap = float(debt.get("overall_gap", 0.0) or 0.0)
   245→    if overall_gap >= _WONTFIX_GAP_THRESHOLD or wontfix_count > 0:
   246→        severity = "high" if overall_gap >= 5.0 or wontfix_count >= 50 else "medium"
   247→        flags.append(
   248→            {
   249→                "type": "wontfix_gap",
   250→                "severity": severity,
   251→                "message": (
   252→                    f"Strict/lenient gap is {overall_gap:.1f} pts with "
   253→                    f"{wontfix_count} wontfix findings"
   254→                ),
   255→            }
   256→        )
   257→
   258→    flags.sort(key=lambda flag: _RISK_SEVERITY_ORDER.get(flag.get("severity"), 99))
   259→    return flags
   260→
   261→
   262→def history_for_lang(raw_history: list[dict], lang: str | None) -> list[dict]:
   263→    if not lang:
   264→        return raw_history
   265→    return [entry for entry in raw_history if entry.get("lang") in (lang, None)]
   266→
   267→
   268→def scoped_findings(state: StateModel) -> dict[str, Finding]:
   269→    return path_scoped_findings(
   270→        state.get("findings", {}), state.get("scan_path")
   271→    )
   272→
   273→
   274→def score_snapshot(state: StateModel) -> tuple[float | None, float | None]:
   275→    return get_strict_score(state), get_overall_score(state)
   276→
   277→
   278→__all__ = [
   279→    "compute_badge_status",
   280→    "compute_primary_action",
   281→    "compute_risk_flags",
   282→    "compute_strict_target",
   283→    "compute_verification_step",
   284→    "compute_why_now",
   285→    "count_open_by_detector",
   286→    "history_for_lang",
   287→    "resolve_target_strict_score",
   288→    "score_snapshot",
   289→    "scoped_findings",
   290→]

1→"""Dimension analysis and debt computation."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.intelligence.narrative._constants import STRUCTURAL_MERGE
     6→from desloppify.scoring import (
     7→    DIMENSIONS,
     8→    TIER_WEIGHTS,
     9→    compute_score_impact,
    10→    merge_potentials,
    11→)
    12→from desloppify.state import StateModel, path_scoped_findings
    13→
    14→
    15→def _analyze_dimensions(dim_scores: dict, history: list[dict], state: StateModel) -> dict:
    16→    """Compute per-dimension structured analysis."""
    17→    if not dim_scores:
    18→        return {}
    19→
    20→    potentials = merge_potentials(state.get("potentials", {}))
    21→    return {
    22→        "lowest_dimensions": _lowest_dimensions(dim_scores, potentials),
    23→        "biggest_gap_dimensions": _biggest_gap_dimensions(dim_scores, state)[:3],
    24→        "stagnant_dimensions": _stagnant_dimensions(dim_scores, history),
    25→    }
    26→
    27→
    28→def _lowest_dimensions(dim_scores: dict, potentials: dict) -> list[dict]:
    29→    """Build summary entries for the lowest strict-scoring dimensions."""
    30→    sorted_dims = sorted(
    31→        (
    32→            (name, ds)
    33→            for name, ds in dim_scores.items()
    34→            if ds.get("strict", ds["score"]) < 100
    35→        ),
    36→        key=lambda item: item[1].get("strict", item[1]["score"]),
    37→    )
    38→
    39→    lowest = []
    40→    for name, ds in sorted_dims[:3]:
    41→        strict = ds.get("strict", ds["score"])
    42→        issues = ds.get("issues", 0)
    43→        impact = _dominant_detector_impact(
    44→            dim_scores=dim_scores,
    45→            detectors=ds.get("detectors", {}),
    46→            potentials=potentials,
    47→        )
    48→        is_subjective = "subjective_assessment" in ds.get("detectors", {})
    49→        entry = {
    50→            "name": name,
    51→            "strict": round(strict, 1),
    52→            "issues": issues,
    53→            "impact": round(impact, 1),
    54→        }
    55→        if is_subjective:
    56→            entry["subjective"] = True
    57→            entry["impact_description"] = "re-review to improve"
    58→        lowest.append(entry)
    59→    return lowest
    60→
    61→
    62→def _biggest_gap_dimensions(dim_scores: dict, state: StateModel) -> list[dict]:
    63→    """Build summary entries for dimensions with the biggest strict gap."""
    64→    biggest_gap = []
    65→    scoped = path_scoped_findings(
    66→        state.get("findings", {}), state.get("scan_path")
    67→    )
    68→    for name, ds in dim_scores.items():
    69→        lenient = ds["score"]
    70→        strict = ds.get("strict", lenient)
    71→        gap = lenient - strict
    72→        if gap > 1.0:
    73→            wontfix_count = sum(
    74→                1
    75→                for f in scoped.values()
    76→                if f["status"] == "wontfix"
    77→                and _finding_in_dimension(f, name, dim_scores)
    78→            )
    79→            biggest_gap.append(
    80→                {
    81→                    "name": name,
    82→                    "lenient": round(lenient, 1),
    83→                    "strict": round(strict, 1),
    84→                    "gap": round(gap, 1),
    85→                    "wontfix_count": wontfix_count,
    86→                }
    87→            )
    88→    biggest_gap.sort(key=lambda x: -x["gap"])
    89→    return biggest_gap
    90→
    91→
    92→def _stagnant_dimensions(dim_scores: dict, history: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    93→    """Build summary entries for dimensions that have not moved recently."""
    94→    if len(history) < 3:
    95→        return []
    96→
    97→    stagnant = []
    98→    for name in dim_scores:
    99→        scores = _recent_dimension_strict_scores(name, history)
   100→        if len(scores) < 3 or max(scores) - min(scores) > 0.5:
   101→            continue
   102→        stagnant.append(
   103→            {
   104→                "name": name,
   105→                "strict": round(dim_scores[name].get("strict", dim_scores[name]["score"]), 1),
   106→                "stuck_scans": len(scores),
   107→            }
   108→        )
   109→    return stagnant
   110→
   111→
   112→def _recent_dimension_strict_scores(name: str, history: list[dict]) -> list[float]:
   113→    """Collect recent strict score samples for one dimension."""
   114→    scores: list[float] = []
   115→    for history_entry in history[-5:]:
   116→        dim_entry = (history_entry.get("dimension_scores") or {}).get(name)
   117→        if not dim_entry:
   118→            continue
   119→        strict_value = dim_entry.get("strict", dim_entry.get("score"))
   120→        if strict_value is not None:
   121→            scores.append(float(strict_value))
   122→    return scores
   123→
   124→
   125→def _dominant_detector_impact(
   126→    *,
   127→    dim_scores: dict,
   128→    detectors: dict,
   129→    potentials: dict,
   130→) -> float:
   131→    """Estimate impact using the most consequential detector in a dimension."""
   132→    normalized_scores = {
   133→        key: {
   134→            "score": value["score"],
   135→            "tier": value.get("tier", 3),
   136→            "detectors": value.get("detectors", {}),
   137→        }
   138→        for key, value in dim_scores.items()
   139→    }
   140→    impact = 0.0
   141→    for detector_name, detector_data in detectors.items():
   142→        issue_count = int(detector_data.get("issues", 0) or 0)
   143→        if issue_count <= 0:
   144→            continue
   145→        detector_impact = compute_score_impact(
   146→            normalized_scores,
   147→            potentials,
   148→            detector_name,
   149→            issue_count,
   150→        )
   151→        impact = max(impact, detector_impact)
   152→    return impact
   153→
   154→
   155→def _finding_in_dimension(finding: dict, dim_name: str, dim_scores: dict) -> bool:
   156→    """Check if a finding's detector belongs to a dimension."""
   157→    detector = finding.get("detector", "")
   158→    if detector in STRUCTURAL_MERGE:
   159→        detector = "structural"
   160→    for dim in DIMENSIONS:
   161→        if dim.name == dim_name and detector in dim.detectors:
   162→            return True
   163→    return False
   164→
   165→
   166→def _analyze_debt(dim_scores: dict, findings: dict, history: list[dict]) -> dict:
   167→    """Compute wontfix debt analysis."""
   168→    # Count wontfix
   169→    wontfix_count = sum(1 for f in findings.values() if f["status"] == "wontfix")
   170→
   171→    # Compute gap per dimension
   172→    worst_dim = None
   173→    worst_gap = 0.0
   174→    overall_lenient = 0.0
   175→    overall_strict = 0.0
   176→    if dim_scores:
   177→        w_sum_l = 0.0
   178→        w_sum_s = 0.0
   179→        w_total = 0.0
   180→        for name, ds in dim_scores.items():
   181→            tier = ds.get("tier", 3)
   182→            w = TIER_WEIGHTS.get(tier, 2)
   183→            w_sum_l += ds["score"] * w
   184→            w_sum_s += ds.get("strict", ds["score"]) * w
   185→            w_total += w
   186→            gap = ds["score"] - ds.get("strict", ds["score"])
   187→            if gap > worst_gap:
   188→                worst_gap = gap
   189→                worst_dim = name
   190→        if w_total > 0:
   191→            overall_lenient = round(w_sum_l / w_total, 1)
   192→            overall_strict = round(w_sum_s / w_total, 1)
   193→
   194→    overall_gap = round(overall_lenient - overall_strict, 1)
   195→
   196→    # Trend from history
   197→    trend = "stable"
   198→    if len(history) >= 3:
   199→        gaps = []
   200→        for h in history[-5:]:
   201→            hs = h.get("strict_score")
   202→            hl = h.get("overall_score")
   203→            if hs is not None and hl is not None:
   204→                gaps.append(hl - hs)
   205→        if len(gaps) >= 2:
   206→            if gaps[-1] > gaps[0] + 0.5:
   207→                trend = "growing"
   208→            elif gaps[-1] < gaps[0] - 0.5:
   209→                trend = "shrinking"
   210→
   211→    return {
   212→        "overall_gap": overall_gap,
   213→        "wontfix_count": wontfix_count,
   214→        "worst_dimension": worst_dim,
   215→        "worst_gap": round(worst_gap, 1),
   216→        "trend": trend,
   217→    }
   218→

1→"""Action computation engine used by narrative query generation."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from collections.abc import Callable
     6→from typing import Any
     7→
     8→from desloppify.intelligence.narrative._constants import DETECTOR_TOOLS
     9→from desloppify.intelligence.narrative.action_models import ActionContext, ActionItem
    10→from desloppify.languages import get_lang
    11→from desloppify.scoring import (
    12→    compute_score_impact,
    13→    get_dimension_for_detector,
    14→    merge_potentials,
    15→)
    16→from desloppify.state import StateModel
    17→
    18→
    19→def supported_fixers(state: StateModel, lang: str | None) -> set[str] | None:
    20→    """Return supported fixers for the active language, or None when unknown."""
    21→    if not lang:
    22→        return None
    23→
    24→    capabilities = state.get("lang_capabilities", {}).get(lang, {})
    25→    fixers = capabilities.get("fixers")
    26→    if isinstance(fixers, list):
    27→        return {fixer for fixer in fixers if isinstance(fixer, str)}
    28→
    29→    try:
    30→        return set(get_lang(lang).fixers.keys())
    31→    except (ImportError, ValueError):
    32→        return None
    33→
    34→
    35→def _impact_calculator(
    36→    dimension_scores: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    37→    state: StateModel,
    38→) -> Callable[[str, int], float]:
    39→    """Build an impact estimator closure keyed by detector and count."""
    40→    merged_potentials = merge_potentials(state.get("potentials", {}))
    41→    if not merged_potentials or not dimension_scores:
    42→        return lambda _detector, _count: 0.0
    43→
    44→    scoring_view = {
    45→        name: {
    46→            "score": values["score"],
    47→            "tier": values.get("tier", 3),
    48→            "detectors": values.get("detectors", {}),
    49→        }
    50→        for name, values in dimension_scores.items()
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    def _impact(detector: str, count: int) -> float:
    54→        return compute_score_impact(
    55→            scoring_view, merged_potentials, detector, count
    56→        )
    57→
    58→    return _impact
    59→
    60→
    61→def _dimension_name(detector: str) -> str:
    62→    """Resolve user-facing dimension name for a detector."""
    63→    dimension = get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
    64→    return dimension.name if dimension else "Unknown"
    65→
    66→
    67→def _fixer_has_applicable_findings(
    68→    state: StateModel, detector: str, fixer_name: str
    69→) -> bool:
    70→    """For the smells detector, verify the fixer has matching open findings.
    71→
    72→    The smells detector aggregates many smell types but each fixer only handles
    73→    one sub-type (e.g. ``dead-useeffect`` only fixes ``dead_useeffect`` smells).
    74→    Without this check, a React-specific fixer can be suggested to projects that
    75→    have no React code at all, producing a confusing "Found 0 candidates" result.
    76→
    77→    For all other detectors the fixer is considered universally applicable.
    78→    """
    79→    if detector != "smells":
    80→        return True
    81→    smell_id = fixer_name.replace("-", "_")
    82→    return any(
    83→        f.get("status") == "open"
    84→        and not f.get("suppressed")
    85→        and f.get("detector") == "smells"
    86→        and f.get("detail", {}).get("smell_id") == smell_id
    87→        for f in state.get("findings", {}).values()
    88→    )
    89→
    90→
    91→def _append_auto_fix_actions(
    92→    actions: list[ActionItem],
    93→    by_detector: dict[str, int],
    94→    supported: set[str] | None,
    95→    impact_for: Callable[[str, int], float],
    96→    state: StateModel,
    97→) -> None:
    98→    """Append auto-fix/manual-fix actions for detectors with auto fixers."""
    99→    for detector, tool_info in DETECTOR_TOOLS.items():
   100→        if tool_info["action_type"] != "auto_fix":
   101→            continue
   102→        count = by_detector.get(detector, 0)
   103→        if count == 0:
   104→            continue
   105→
   106→        impact = round(impact_for(detector, count), 1)
   107→        available_fixers = [
   108→            fixer
   109→            for fixer in tool_info["fixers"]
   110→            if (supported is None or fixer in supported)
   111→            and _fixer_has_applicable_findings(state, detector, fixer)
   112→        ]
   113→        if not available_fixers:
   114→            actions.append(
   115→                {
   116→                    "type": "manual_fix",
   117→                    "detector": detector,
   118→                    "count": count,
   119→                    "description": (
   120→                        f"{count} {detector} findings — inspect with "
   121→                        f"`desloppify next` and fix manually"
   122→                    ),
   123→                    "command": f"desloppify show {detector} --status open",
   124→                    "impact": impact,
   125→                    "dimension": _dimension_name(detector),
   126→                }
   127→            )
   128→            continue
   129→
   130→        fixer = available_fixers[0]
   131→        actions.append(
   132→            {
   133→                "type": "auto_fix",
   134→                "detector": detector,
   135→                "count": count,
   136→                "description": (
   137→                    f"{count} {detector} findings — run "
   138→                    f"`desloppify fix {fixer} --dry-run` to preview, then apply"
   139→                ),
   140→                "command": f"desloppify fix {fixer} --dry-run",
   141→                "impact": impact,
   142→                "dimension": _dimension_name(detector),
   143→            }
   144→        )
   145→
   146→
   147→def _append_reorganize_actions(
   148→    actions: list[ActionItem],
   149→    by_detector: dict[str, int],
   150→    impact_for: Callable[[str, int], float],
   151→) -> None:
   152→    """Append structure/move oriented actions."""
   153→    for detector, tool_info in DETECTOR_TOOLS.items():
   154→        if tool_info["action_type"] != "reorganize":
   155→            continue
   156→        count = by_detector.get(detector, 0)
   157→        if count == 0:
   158→            continue
   159→
   160→        guidance = tool_info.get("guidance", "restructure with move")
   161→        actions.append(
   162→            {
   163→                "type": "reorganize",
   164→                "detector": detector,
   165→                "count": count,
   166→                "description": f"{count} {detector} findings — {guidance}",
   167→                "command": f"desloppify show {detector} --status open",
   168→                "impact": round(impact_for(detector, count), 1),
   169→                "dimension": _dimension_name(detector),
   170→            }
   171→        )
   172→
   173→
   174→def _build_refactor_entry(
   175→    detector: str,
   176→    tool_info: dict[str, Any],
   177→    count: int,
   178→    impact_for: Callable[[str, int], float],
   179→) -> ActionItem:
   180→    """Build one refactor/manual action row."""
   181→    guidance = tool_info.get("guidance", "manual fix")
   182→    adjusted_info = {**tool_info, "guidance": guidance}
   183→
   184→    if detector == "subjective_review":
   185→        command = "desloppify review --prepare"
   186→        description = f"{count} files need design review — run holistic review to refresh subjective scores"
   187→    elif detector == "review":
   188→        command = "desloppify show review --status open"
   189→        suffix = "s" if count != 1 else ""
   190→        description = (
   191→            f"{count} review finding{suffix} need investigation — "
   192→            "run `desloppify show review --status open` to see them"
   193→        )
   194→        adjusted_info = {**adjusted_info, "action_type": "refactor"}
   195→    else:
   196→        command = f"desloppify show {detector} --status open"
   197→        description = f"{count} {detector} findings — {guidance}"
   198→
   199→    return {
   200→        "type": adjusted_info["action_type"],
   201→        "detector": detector,
   202→        "count": count,
   203→        "description": description,
   204→        "command": command,
   205→        "impact": round(impact_for(detector, count), 1),
   206→        "dimension": _dimension_name(detector),
   207→    }
   208→
   209→
   210→def _append_refactor_actions(
   211→    actions: list[ActionItem],
   212→    by_detector: dict[str, int],
   213→    impact_for: Callable[[str, int], float],
   214→) -> None:
   215→    """Append refactor/manual actions after auto-fix/reorg buckets."""
   216→    for detector, tool_info in DETECTOR_TOOLS.items():
   217→        if tool_info["action_type"] not in {"refactor", "manual_fix"}:
   218→            continue
   219→        count = by_detector.get(detector, 0)
   220→        if count == 0:
   221→            continue
   222→        actions.append(_build_refactor_entry(detector, tool_info, count, impact_for))
   223→
   224→
   225→def _append_debt_action(actions: list[ActionItem], debt: dict[str, float]) -> None:
   226→    """Append wontfix-debt callout when gap is material."""
   227→    gap = float(debt.get("overall_gap", 0.0) or 0.0)
   228→    if gap <= 2.0:
   229→        return
   230→    actions.append(
   231→        {
   232→            "type": "debt_review",
   233→            "detector": None,
   234→            "description": f"{gap} pts of wontfix debt — review stale decisions",
   235→            "command": "desloppify show --status wontfix",
   236→            "gap": gap,
   237→        }
   238→    )
   239→
   240→
   241→def _assign_priorities(actions: list[ActionItem]) -> list[ActionItem]:
   242→    """Sort and assign sequential priorities."""
   243→    type_order = {
   244→        "issue_queue": 0,
   245→        "auto_fix": 1,
   246→        "reorganize": 2,
   247→        "refactor": 3,
   248→        "manual_fix": 4,
   249→        "debt_review": 5,
   250→    }
   251→    actions.sort(
   252→        key=lambda action: (type_order.get(action["type"], 9), -action.get("impact", 0))
   253→    )
   254→    for index, action in enumerate(actions, start=1):
   255→        action["priority"] = index
   256→    return actions
   257→
   258→
   259→def _cluster_detector(cluster: dict) -> str | None:
   260→    """Extract the primary detector from a cluster.
   261→
   262→    Uses the cluster_key prefix (e.g. "auto::unused" → "unused",
   263→    "typed::dict_keys::phantom_read" → "dict_keys") or falls back
   264→    to the first member's detector.
   265→    """
   266→    key = cluster.get("cluster_key", "")
   267→    if key:
   268→        parts = key.split("::")
   269→        if len(parts) >= 2:
   270→            return parts[1]
   271→    # Fallback: parse from cluster name (auto/detector-subtype)
   272→    name = cluster.get("name", "")
   273→    if name.startswith("auto/"):
   274→        rest = name[5:]
   275→        return rest.split("-", 1)[0] if "-" in rest else rest
   276→    return None
   277→
   278→
   279→def _annotate_with_clusters(
   280→    actions: list[ActionItem], clusters: dict | None
   281→) -> None:
   282→    """Annotate actions with matching cluster info when clusters exist."""
   283→    if not clusters:
   284→        return
   285→    for action in actions:
   286→        detector = action.get("detector")
   287→        if not detector:
   288→            continue
   289→        matching = [
   290→            name
   291→            for name, c in clusters.items()
   292→            if c.get("auto") and _cluster_detector(c) == detector
   293→        ]
   294→        if matching:
   295→            action["clusters"] = matching
   296→            action["cluster_count"] = len(matching)
   297→            action["command"] = "desloppify next"
   298→            count = action.get("count", 0)
   299→            display = action.get("detector", "unknown")
   300→            action["description"] = (
   301→                f"{count} {display} findings in {len(matching)} cluster(s) — "
   302→                f"run `desloppify next`"
   303→            )
   304→
   305→
   306→def compute_actions(ctx: ActionContext) -> list[ActionItem]:
   307→    """Compute prioritized action list with tool mapping."""
   308→    actions: list[ActionItem] = []
   309→    impact_for = _impact_calculator(ctx.dimension_scores, ctx.state)
   310→    supported = supported_fixers(ctx.state, ctx.lang)
   311→
   312→    _append_auto_fix_actions(actions, ctx.by_detector, supported, impact_for, ctx.state)
   313→    _append_reorganize_actions(actions, ctx.by_detector, impact_for)
   314→    _append_refactor_actions(actions, ctx.by_detector, impact_for)
   315→    _append_debt_action(actions, ctx.debt)
   316→
   317→    prioritized = _assign_priorities(actions)
   318→    _annotate_with_clusters(prioritized, ctx.clusters)
   319→    return prioritized
   320→

    14→def open_files_by_detector(findings: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
    15→    """Collect file sets of open findings by detector."""
    16→    by_detector: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    17→    for finding in findings.values():
    18→        if finding["status"] != "open" or finding.get("suppressed"):
    19→            continue
    20→        detector = finding.get("detector", "unknown")
    21→        if detector in STRUCTURAL_MERGE:
    22→            detector = "structural"
    23→        file_path = finding.get("file", "")
    24→        if not file_path:
    25→            by_detector.setdefault(detector, set())
    26→            continue
    27→        by_detector.setdefault(detector, set()).add(file_path)
    28→    return by_detector

    31→def compute_fixer_leverage(
    32→    by_detector: dict[str, int],
    33→    actions: list[dict[str, Any]],
    34→    phase: str,
    35→    _lang: str | None,
