   126→    dimension_scores: dict[str, Any]      # for context
   127→    new_since_last: set[str]             # finding IDs new since last triage
   128→    resolved_since_last: set[str]        # finding IDs resolved since last
   129→    previously_dismissed: list[str]      # IDs dismissed in prior triage
   130→    triage_version: int                  # next version number
   131→    resolved_findings: dict[str, dict]   # full finding objects for resolved IDs
   132→    completed_clusters: list[dict]       # clusters completed since last triage
   133→
   134→
   135→@dataclass
   136→class DismissedFinding:
   137→    """A finding the LLM says doesn't make sense."""
   138→
   139→    finding_id: str
   140→    reason: str
   141→
   142→
   143→@dataclass
   144→class ContradictionNote:
   145→    """Record of a resolved contradiction."""
   146→
   147→    kept: str
   148→    dismissed: str
   149→    reason: str
   150→
   151→
   152→@dataclass
   153→class TriageResult:
   154→    """Parsed and validated LLM triage output."""
   155→
   156→    strategy_summary: str
   157→    epics: list[dict]
   158→    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = field(default_factory=list)
   159→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = field(default_factory=list)
   160→    priority_rationale: str = ""
   161→
   162→
   163→@dataclass
   164→class TriageMutationResult:
   165→    """What changed when triage was applied to the plan."""
   166→
   167→    epics_created: int = 0
   168→    epics_updated: int = 0
   169→    epics_completed: int = 0
   170→    findings_dismissed: int = 0
   171→    findings_reassigned: int = 0
   172→    strategy_summary: str = ""
   173→    triage_version: int = 0
   174→    dry_run: bool = False
   175→
   176→
   177→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   178→# Input collection
   179→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   180→
   181→def collect_triage_input(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> TriageInput:
   182→    """Gather all data needed for the triage LLM prompt."""
   183→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   184→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   185→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   186→    epics = triage_clusters(plan)
   187→
   188→    open_review: dict[str, dict] = {}
   189→    open_mechanical: dict[str, dict] = {}
   190→    for fid, f in findings.items():
   191→        if f.get("status") != "open":
   192→            continue
   193→        if f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns"):
   194→            open_review[fid] = f
   195→        else:
   196→            open_mechanical[fid] = f
   197→
   198→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   199→    current_review_ids = set(open_review.keys())
   200→    new_since = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   201→    resolved_since = triaged_ids - current_review_ids
   202→    previously_dismissed = list(meta.get("dismissed_ids", []))
   203→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   204→
   205→    # Resolved finding objects (for REFLECT stage)
   206→    resolved_finding_objs = {
   207→        fid: findings[fid] for fid in resolved_since if fid in findings
   208→    }
   209→
   210→    # Completed clusters since last triage completion
   211→    last_completed = meta.get("last_completed_at", "")
   212→    all_completed: list[dict] = plan.get("completed_clusters", [])
   213→    if last_completed:
   214→        recent_completed = [
   215→            c for c in all_completed
   216→            if c.get("completed_at", "") > last_completed
   217→        ]
   218→    else:
   219→        recent_completed = list(all_completed)
   220→
   221→    return TriageInput(
   222→        open_findings=open_review,
   223→        mechanical_findings=open_mechanical,
   224→        existing_epics=dict(epics),
   225→        dimension_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   226→        new_since_last=new_since,
   227→        resolved_since_last=resolved_since,
   228→        previously_dismissed=previously_dismissed,
   229→        triage_version=version,
   230→        resolved_findings=resolved_finding_objs,
   231→        completed_clusters=recent_completed,
   232→    )
   233→
   234→
   235→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   236→# Prompt construction
   237→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   238→
   239→_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   240→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   241→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
   242→
   243→Your plan should:
   244→- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   245→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   246→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   247→- Dismiss findings that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   248→- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   249→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   250→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all findings coherently
   251→
   252→Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   253→
   254→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   255→- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   256→- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   257→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   258→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   259→- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   260→- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   261→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   262→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   263→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
   264→
   265→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic
   266→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed findings will be
   267→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   268→
   269→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   270→{
   271→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   272→  "epics": [
   273→    {
   274→      "name": "slug-name",
   275→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   276→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   277→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   278→      "finding_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   279→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   280→      "agent_safe": true,
   281→      "dependency_order": 1,
   282→      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   283→      "status": "pending"
   284→    }
   285→  ],
   286→  "dismissed_findings": [
   287→    {"finding_id": "id", "reason": "why this finding doesn't make sense"}
   288→  ],
   289→  "contradiction_notes": [
   290→    {"kept": "finding_id", "dismissed": "finding_id", "reason": "why"}
   291→  ],
   292→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   293→}
   294→"""
   295→
   296→
   297→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   298→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all finding data."""
   299→    parts: list[str] = []
   300→
   301→    # Section: existing epics
   302→    if si.existing_epics:
   303→        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   304→        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   305→            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   306→            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   307→            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   308→            fids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   309→            parts.append(
   310→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   311→                f"\n  Findings: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   312→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   313→            )
   314→        parts.append("")
   315→
   316→    # Section: what changed
   317→    if si.new_since_last:
   318→        parts.append(f"## New findings since last triage ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   319→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   320→            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
   321→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   322→        parts.append("")
   323→
   324→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   325→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last triage ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   326→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   327→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   328→        parts.append("")
   329→
   330→    # Section: all open review findings
   331→    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
   332→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
   333→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   334→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   335→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   336→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   337→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   338→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   339→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   340→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   341→        if dimension:
   342→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   343→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   344→        if suggestion:
   345→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   346→    parts.append("")
   347→
   348→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   349→    if si.dimension_scores:
   350→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   351→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   352→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   353→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   354→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   355→                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
   356→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   357→        parts.append("")
   358→
   359→    # Section: previously dismissed
   360→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   361→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   362→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   363→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   364→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   365→        parts.append("")
   366→
   367→    return "\n".join(parts)
   368→
   369→
   370→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   371→# Result parsing
   372→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   373→
   374→def parse_triage_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> TriageResult:
   375→    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a TriageResult.
   376→
   377→    Invalid finding IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
   378→    """
   379→    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
   380→
   381→    epics: list[dict] = []
   382→    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
   383→        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
   384→            continue
   385→        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
   386→        if not name:
   387→            continue
   388→        # Validate direction
   389→        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
   390→        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
   391→            direction = "simplify"
   392→        # Filter to valid finding IDs
   393→        finding_ids = [
   394→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   395→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   396→        ]
   397→        dismissed = [
   398→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
   399→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   400→        ]
   401→        action_steps = [
   402→            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
   403→            if isinstance(s, str)
   404→        ]
   405→
   406→        epics.append({
   407→            "name": name,
   408→            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
   409→            "direction": direction,
   410→            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
   411→            "finding_ids": finding_ids,
   412→            "dismissed": dismissed,
   413→            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
   414→            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
   415→            "action_steps": action_steps,
   416→            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
   417→        })
   418→
   419→    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = []
   420→    for d in raw.get("dismissed_findings", []):
   421→        if not isinstance(d, dict):
   422→            continue
   423→        fid = str(d.get("finding_id", ""))
   424→        if fid in valid_ids:
   425→            dismissed_findings.append(
   426→                DismissedFinding(finding_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
   427→            )
   428→
   429→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
   430→    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
   431→        if not isinstance(c, dict):
   432→            continue
   433→        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
   434→            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
   435→            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
   436→            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
   437→        ))
   438→
   439→    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
   440→
   441→    return TriageResult(
   442→        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   443→        epics=epics,
   444→        dismissed_findings=dismissed_findings,
   445→        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   446→        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   447→    )
   448→
   449→
   450→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   451→# Plan mutation
   452→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   453→
   454→def apply_triage_to_plan(
   455→    plan: PlanModel,
   456→    state: StateModel,
   457→    triage: TriageResult,
   458→    *,
   459→    trigger: str = "manual",
   460→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   461→    """Apply parsed triage result to the living plan.
   462→
   463→    1. Creates/updates triage-clusters in plan["clusters"]
   464→    2. Marks dismissed findings as triaged_out skips
   465→    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
   466→    4. Updates epic_triage_meta with snapshot hash
   467→    """
   468→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   469→    now = utc_now()
   470→    result = TriageMutationResult()
   471→    result.strategy_summary = triage.strategy_summary
   472→
   473→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   474→    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   475→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   476→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   477→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   478→    result.triage_version = version
   479→
   480→    # --- Update/create triage-clusters ------------------------------------
   481→    for epic_data in sorted(triage.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   482→        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   483→        epic_name = f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}" if not raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else raw_name
   484→
   485→        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
   486→        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
   487→            # Update existing triage-cluster
   488→            existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   489→            existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
   490→            existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
   491→            existing["finding_ids"] = epic_data["finding_ids"]
   492→            existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
   493→            existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
   494→            existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
   495→            existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
   496→            existing["updated_at"] = now
   497→            existing["triage_version"] = version
   498→            existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   499→            # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
   500→            if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
   501→                existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
   502→            result.epics_updated += 1
   503→        else:
   504→            # Create new triage-cluster
   505→            cluster: Cluster = {
   506→                "name": epic_name,
   507→                "description": epic_data["thesis"],
   508→                "finding_ids": epic_data["finding_ids"],
   509→                "auto": True,
   510→                "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
   511→                "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
   512→                "user_modified": False,
   513→                "created_at": now,
   514→                "updated_at": now,
   515→                # Epic fields
   516→                "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
   517→                "direction": epic_data["direction"],
   518→                "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
   519→                "supersedes": [],
   520→                "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
   521→                "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
   522→                "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
   523→                "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
   524→                "source_clusters": [],
   525→                "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
   526→                "triage_version": version,
   527→            }
   528→            clusters[epic_name] = cluster
   529→            result.epics_created += 1
   530→
   531→    # --- Dismiss findings ---------------------------------------------------
   532→    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
   533→    for df in triage.dismissed_findings:
   534→        fid = df.finding_id
   535→        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   536→        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as triaged_out
   537→        if fid in order:
   538→            order.remove(fid)
   539→        skipped[fid] = {
   540→            "finding_id": fid,
   541→            "kind": "triaged_out",
   542→            "reason": df.reason,
   543→            "note": f"Dismissed by epic triage v{version}",
   544→            "attestation": None,
   545→            "created_at": now,
   546→            "review_after": None,
   547→            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   548→        }
   549→        result.findings_dismissed += 1
   550→
   551→    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
   552→    for epic_data in triage.epics:
   553→        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
   554→            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
   555→                order.remove(fid)
   556→                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   557→                skipped[fid] = {
   558→                    "finding_id": fid,
   559→                    "kind": "triaged_out",
   560→                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic triage v{version}",
   561→                    "note": None,
   562→                    "attestation": None,
   563→                    "created_at": now,
   564→                    "review_after": None,
   565→                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   566→                }
   567→                result.findings_dismissed += 1
   568→
   569→    # --- Reorder queue: epic findings grouped by dependency_order -----------
   570→    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
   571→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   572→    for epic_data in sorted(triage.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   573→        for fid in epic_data["finding_ids"]:
   574→            if fid not in epic_finding_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
   575→                epic_finding_ids.add(fid)
   576→                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   577→
   578→    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
   579→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_finding_ids]
   580→    # Insert epic items at the front.
   581→    new_order: list[str] = []
   582→    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   583→    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
   584→    order.clear()
   585→    order.extend(new_order)
   586→
   587→    # --- Update triage meta -----------------------------------------------
   588→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   589→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   590→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   591→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   592→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   593→    )
   594→
   595→    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = {
   596→        "triaged_ids": open_review_ids,
   597→        "last_run": now,
   598→        "version": version,
   599→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   600→        "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   601→        "strategy_summary": triage.strategy_summary,
   602→        "trigger": trigger,
   603→    }
   604→    plan["updated"] = now
   605→
   606→    return result
   607→
   608→
   609→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   610→# Top-level orchestrator
   611→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   612→
   613→@dataclass
   614→class TriageDeps:
   615→    """Injectable dependencies for the triage engine."""
   616→
   617→    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
   618→
   619→
   620→def triage_epics(
   621→    plan: PlanModel,
   622→    state: StateModel,
   623→    *,
   624→    deps: TriageDeps | None = None,
   625→    dry_run: bool = False,
   626→    trigger: str = "manual",
   627→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   628→    """Run epic triage: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
   629→
   630→    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
   631→    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
   632→
   633→    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
   634→    """
   635→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   636→    si = collect_triage_input(plan, state)
   637→
   638→    prompt = build_triage_prompt(si)
   639→    valid_ids = set(si.open_findings.keys())
   640→
   641→    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
   642→        result = TriageMutationResult(dry_run=True)
   643→        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_findings)} findings"
   644→        return result
   645→
   646→    # Call LLM
   647→    try:
   648→        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
   649→        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
   650→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   651→        logger.error("Epic triage LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
   652→        result = TriageMutationResult()
   653→        result.strategy_summary = f"Triage failed: {exc}"
   654→        return result
   655→
   656→    triage = parse_triage_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
   657→    return apply_triage_to_plan(plan, state, triage, trigger=trigger)
   658→
   659→
   660→__all__ = [
   661→    "DismissedFinding",
   662→    "FINDING_ID_RE",
   663→    "TriageDeps",
   664→    "TriageInput",
   665→    "TriageMutationResult",
   666→    "TriageResult",
   667→    "apply_triage_to_plan",
   668→    "build_triage_prompt",
   669→    "collect_triage_input",

    31→def _cmd_plan_generate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:

    37→        save_plan(plan)

    41→def _cmd_plan_show(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    42→    """Show plan metadata summary."""
    43→    plan = load_plan()
    44→    ordered = len(plan.get("queue_order", []))
    45→    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
    46→    total_skipped = len(skipped)
    47→    temp_count = sum(1 for e in skipped.values() if e.get("kind") == "temporary")
    48→    perm_count = sum(1 for e in skipped.values() if e.get("kind") == "permanent")
    49→    fp_count = sum(1 for e in skipped.values() if e.get("kind") == "false_positive")
    50→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    51→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
    52→    active = plan.get("active_cluster")
    53→    superseded = len(plan.get("superseded", {}))
    54→
    55→    # Count meaningful annotations (descriptions and notes)
    56→    described = sum(1 for o in overrides.values() if o.get("description"))
    57→    noted = sum(1 for o in overrides.values() if o.get("note"))
    58→
    59→    print(colorize("  Living Plan Status", "bold"))
    60→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 40, "dim"))
    61→    print(f"  Queue:            {ordered} items prioritized")
    62→    if total_skipped:

    64→    else:

    66→    print(f"  Clusters:         {len(clusters)}")

   433→def _fixer_help_lines(langs: list[str]) -> list[str]:
   434→    fixer_help_lines: list[str] = []
   435→    for lang_name in langs:
   436→        try:
   437→            fixer_names = sorted(get_lang(lang_name).fixers.keys())
   438→        except (ImportError, ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
   439→            fixer_names = []
   440→        fixer_list = ", ".join(fixer_names) if fixer_names else "none yet"
   441→        fixer_help_lines.append(f"fixers ({lang_name}): {fixer_list}")
   442→    fixer_help_lines.append("special: review — prepare structured review data")
   443→    return fixer_help_lines

   117→def _observe_dimension_breakdown(si) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[str]]:
   118→    """Count findings per dimension from a TriageInput. Returns (by_dim, sorted_dim_names)."""
   119→    by_dim: dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)

   249→def _apply_completion(args: argparse.Namespace, plan: dict, strategy: str) -> None:
   250→    """Shared completion logic: update meta, remove triage::pending, save."""
   251→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   252→    state = runtime.state
   253→
   254→    organized, total, clusters = _triage_coverage(
   255→        plan, open_review_ids=_open_review_ids_from_state(state),
   256→    )
   257→
   258→    # Purge all triage stage IDs.
   259→    purge_ids(plan, list(TRIAGE_IDS))
   260→
   261→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   262→
   263→    meta = plan.setdefault("epic_triage_meta", {})
   264→    meta["finding_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   265→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   266→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   267→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   268→    )
   269→    meta["triaged_ids"] = open_review_ids
   270→    if strategy.strip().lower() != "same":
   271→        meta["strategy_summary"] = strategy
   272→    meta["trigger"] = "manual_triage"
   273→    meta["last_completed_at"] = utc_now()
   274→    # Archive stages before clearing so previous analysis is preserved
   275→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   276→    if stages:
   277→        meta["last_triage"] = {
   278→            "completed_at": utc_now(),
   279→            "stages": {k: dict(v) for k, v in stages.items()},
   280→            "strategy": strategy if strategy.strip().lower() != "same" else meta.get("strategy_summary", ""),
   281→        }
   282→    meta["triage_stages"] = {}  # clear stages on completion
   283→    meta.pop("stage_refresh_required", None)
   284→    meta.pop("stage_snapshot_hash", None)
   285→
   286→    save_plan(plan)
   287→
   288→    cluster_count = len([c for c in clusters.values() if c.get("finding_ids")])
   289→    print(colorize(f"  Triage complete: {organized}/{total} findings in {cluster_count} cluster(s).", "green"))
   290→    effective_strategy = strategy if strategy.strip().lower() != "same" else meta.get("strategy_summary", "")
   291→    if effective_strategy:
   292→        print(colorize(f"  Strategy: {effective_strategy}", "cyan"))
   293→    print(colorize("  Run `desloppify next` to start implementation.", "green"))

   593→        "dim",

   595→
   596→
   597→def _cmd_stage_organize(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   598→    """Record the ORGANIZE stage: validates cluster enrichment.
   599→
   600→    Instead of gating on a text report, validates that the plan data
   601→    itself has been enriched: each manual cluster needs description +
   602→    action_steps. This forces the agent to actually think about each
   603→    cluster's execution plan.
   604→    """
   605→    report: str | None = getattr(args, "report", None)
   606→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attestation", None)
   607→
   608→    plan = load_plan()
   609→
   610→    if not _has_triage_in_queue(plan):
   611→        print(colorize("  No planning stages in the queue \u2014 nothing to organize.", "yellow"))
   612→        return
   613→
   614→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   615→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   616→
   617→    # Jump-back: reuse existing report if no --report provided
   618→    existing_stage = stages.get("organize")
   619→    is_reuse = False
   620→    if not report and existing_stage and existing_stage.get("report"):
   621→        report = existing_stage["report"]
   622→        is_reuse = True
   623→
   624→    if "reflect" not in stages:
   625→        if "observe" not in stages:
   626→            print(colorize("  Cannot organize: observe stage not complete.", "red"))
   627→            print(colorize('  Run: desloppify plan triage --stage observe --report "..."', "dim"))
   628→        else:
   629→            print(colorize("  Cannot organize: reflect stage not complete.", "red"))
   630→            print(colorize('  Run: desloppify plan triage --stage reflect --report "..."', "dim"))
   631→        return
   632→
   633→    # Fold-confirm: auto-confirm reflect if attestation provided
   634→    if not stages["reflect"].get("confirmed_at"):
   635→        if attestation and len(attestation.strip()) >= _MIN_ATTESTATION_LEN:
   636→            runtime = command_runtime(args)
   637→            si = collect_triage_input(plan, runtime.state)
   638→            recurring = detect_recurring_patterns(si.open_findings, si.resolved_findings)
   639→            _by_dim, observe_dims = _observe_dimension_breakdown(si)
   640→            reflect_dims = sorted(set((list(recurring.keys()) if recurring else []) + observe_dims))
   641→            reflect_clusters = [n for n in plan.get("clusters", {}) if not plan["clusters"][n].get("auto")]
   642→            validation_err = _validate_attestation(
   643→                attestation.strip(), "reflect",
   644→                dimensions=reflect_dims, cluster_names=reflect_clusters,
   645→            )
   646→            if validation_err:
   647→                print(colorize(f"  {validation_err}", "red"))
   648→                return
   649→            stages["reflect"]["confirmed_at"] = utc_now()
   650→            stages["reflect"]["confirmed_text"] = attestation.strip()
   651→            save_plan(plan)
   652→            print(colorize("  \u2713 Reflect auto-confirmed via --attestation.", "green"))
   653→        else:
   654→            print(colorize("  Cannot organize: reflect stage not confirmed.", "red"))
   655→            print(colorize("  Run: desloppify plan triage --confirm reflect", "dim"))
   656→            print(colorize("  Or pass --attestation to auto-confirm reflect inline.", "dim"))
   657→            return
   658→
   659→    # Validate: at least 1 manual cluster with findings
   660→    manual_clusters = _manual_clusters_with_findings(plan)
   661→    if not manual_clusters:
   662→        # Check if there are ANY clusters with findings (including auto)
   663→        any_clusters = [
   664→            name for name, c in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   665→            if c.get("finding_ids")
   666→        ]
   667→        if any_clusters:
   668→            print(colorize("  Cannot organize: only auto-clusters exist.", "red"))
   669→            print(colorize("  Create manual clusters that group findings by root cause:", "dim"))
   670→        else:
   671→            print(colorize("  Cannot organize: no clusters with findings exist.", "red"))
   672→        print(colorize('    desloppify plan cluster create <name> --description "..."', "dim"))
   673→        print(colorize("    desloppify plan cluster add <name> <finding-patterns>", "dim"))
   674→        return
   675→
   676→    # Validate: all manual clusters are enriched
   677→    gaps = _unenriched_clusters(plan)
   678→    if gaps:
   679→        print(colorize(f"  Cannot organize: {len(gaps)} cluster(s) need enrichment.", "red"))
   680→        for name, missing in gaps:
   681→            print(colorize(f"    {name}: missing {', '.join(missing)}", "yellow"))
   682→        print()
   683→        print(colorize("  Each cluster needs a description and action steps:", "dim"))
   684→        print(colorize(
   685→            '    desloppify plan cluster update <name> --description "what this cluster addresses" '
   686→            '--steps "step 1" "step 2"',
   687→            "dim",
   688→        ))
   689→        return
   690→
   691→    # Require report
   692→    if not report:
   693→        print(colorize("  --report is required for --stage organize.", "red"))
   694→        print(colorize("  Summarize your prioritized organization:", "dim"))
   695→        print(colorize("  - Did you defer contradictory findings before clustering?", "dim"))
   696→        print(colorize("  - What clusters did you create and why?", "dim"))
   697→        print(colorize("  - Explicit priority ordering: which cluster 1st, 2nd, 3rd and why?", "dim"))
   698→        print(colorize("  - What depends on what? What unblocks the most?", "dim"))
   699→        return
   700→    if len(report) < 100:
   701→        print(colorize(f"  Report too short: {len(report)} chars (minimum 100).", "red"))
   702→        print(colorize("  Explain what you organized, your priorities, and focus order.", "dim"))
   703→        return
   704→
   705→    stages = meta.setdefault("triage_stages", {})
   706→    stages["organize"] = {
   707→        "stage": "organize",
   708→        "report": report,
   709→        "cited_ids": [],
   710→        "timestamp": utc_now(),
   711→        "finding_count": len(manual_clusters),
   712→    }
   713→
   714→    # Jump-back: preserve or clear confirmation
   715→    if is_reuse and existing_stage and existing_stage.get("confirmed_at"):
   716→        stages["organize"]["confirmed_at"] = existing_stage["confirmed_at"]
   717→        stages["organize"]["confirmed_text"] = existing_stage.get("confirmed_text", "")
   718→    cleared = _cascade_clear_later_confirmations(stages, "organize")
   719→
   720→    save_plan(plan)
   721→
   722→    append_log_entry(plan, "triage_organize", actor="user",
   723→                     detail={"cluster_count": len(manual_clusters), "reuse": is_reuse})
   724→    save_plan(plan)
   725→
   726→    print(colorize(
   727→        f"  Organize stage recorded: {len(manual_clusters)} enriched cluster(s).",
   728→        "green",
   729→    ))
   730→    if is_reuse:
   731→        print(colorize("  Organize data preserved (no changes).", "dim"))
   732→        if cleared:
   733→            _print_cascade_clear_feedback(cleared, stages)
   734→    else:
   735→        print(colorize("  Now confirm the plan.", "yellow"))
   736→        print(colorize("    desloppify plan triage --confirm organize", "dim"))
   737→    # Show cluster summary
   738→    for name in manual_clusters:
   739→        cluster = plan.get("clusters", {}).get(name, {})
   740→        steps = cluster.get("action_steps", [])
   741→        desc = cluster.get("description", "")
   742→        desc_str = f" \u2014 {desc}" if desc else ""
   743→        print(colorize(f"    {name}: {len(cluster.get('finding_ids', []))} findings, {len(steps)} steps{desc_str}", "dim"))
   744→
   745→    # Print the organize report prominently — this is the debrief
   746→    print()
   747→    print(colorize("  \u250c\u2500 Prioritized organization (share with user) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2510", "cyan"))
   748→    for line in report.strip().splitlines():
   749→        print(colorize(f"  \u2502 {line}", "cyan"))
   750→    print(colorize("  \u2514" + "\u2500" * 57 + "\u2518", "cyan"))
   751→    print()
   752→    print(colorize(
   753→        "  IMPORTANT: Present your prioritized organization to the user. Explain",
   754→        "yellow",
   755→    ))
   756→    print(colorize(
   757→        "  each cluster, why it exists, and your explicit priority ordering \u2014",
   758→        "yellow",
   759→    ))
   760→    print(colorize(
   761→        "  which cluster comes first, second, third, what depends on what,",
   762→        "yellow",
   763→    ))
   764→    print(colorize(
   765→        "  and why that ordering matters.",
   766→        "yellow",
   767→    ))
   768→
   769→
   770→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   771→# Completion
   772→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   773→
   774→def _cmd_triage_complete(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   775→    """Complete triage \u2014 requires organize stage (or confirm-existing path)."""
   776→    strategy: str | None = getattr(args, "strategy", None)
   777→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attestation", None)
   778→    plan = load_plan()
   779→
   780→    if not _has_triage_in_queue(plan):
   781→        print(colorize("  No planning stages in the queue \u2014 nothing to complete.", "yellow"))
   782→        return
   783→
   784→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   785→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   786→
   787→    state = command_runtime(args).state
   788→    review_ids = _open_review_ids_from_state(state)
   789→
   790→    # Require organize stage confirmed
   791→    if "organize" not in stages:
   792→        if "observe" not in stages:
   793→            print(colorize("  Cannot complete: no stages done yet.", "red"))
   794→            print(colorize('  Start with: desloppify plan triage --stage observe --report "..."', "dim"))
   795→        else:
   796→            print(colorize("  Cannot complete: organize stage not done.", "red"))
   797→            gaps = _unenriched_clusters(plan)
   798→            if gaps:
   799→                print(colorize(f"  {len(gaps)} cluster(s) still need enrichment:", "yellow"))

## Desloppify Feedback & Triage System - Complete Guide

I've thoroughly searched the desloppify codebase and found the comprehensive feedback and triage system. Here's how to communicate with the bot and make it reprioritize:

---

### **1. Primary Feedback Mechanism: Staged Triage Workflow**

The triage system is **the** way to give feedback and make the bot rethink its plan. It's a **four-stage workflow** with explicit user input at each stage:

#### **The Four Stages (in order):**

```
OBSERVE → REFLECT → ORGANIZE → COMMIT
```

Each stage requires explicit data/action before moving to the next.

---

### **2. Specific Commands to Give Feedback**

#### **Stage 1: OBSERVE - Analyze & Spot Contradictions**
```bash
desloppify plan triage --stage observe --report "your analysis of themes and root causes..."
```
- **Minimum length:** 100 characters (50 if ≤3 findings)
- **Purpose:** Bot writes analysis of what it sees—themes, root causes, contradictions
- **You do:** Read the analysis, spot if it misses something
- **Then confirm:** 
  ```bash
  desloppify plan triage --confirm observe
  ```

**To jump back and revise observation:**
```bash
desloppify plan triage --stage observe --report "completely revised observation..."
```

---

#### **Stage 2: REFLECT - Compare Against Completed Work & Form Strategy**
```bash
desloppify plan triage --stage reflect --report "comparison against previously resolved work, what's recurring, what contradictions you found..."
```
- **Minimum length:** 100 characters (50 if ≤3 findings)
- **Requirement:** Must mention dimension names IF recurring patterns exist
- **Purpose:** Bot forms holistic strategy by reflecting on what was fixed before vs what's open now
- **Then confirm:**
  ```bash
  desloppify plan triage --confirm reflect
  ```

**To jump back and revise strategy:**
```bash
desloppify plan triage --stage reflect --report "new strategic view based on user feedback..."
```

---

#### **Stage 3: ORGANIZE - Create Clusters & Enrich Them**

After reflect is confirmed, you create actual plan clusters:

```bash
# Create a cluster
desloppify plan cluster create <cluster-name> --description "what this cluster addresses"

# Add findings to it (by pattern: detector, file, ID prefix, glob, or cluster name)
desloppify plan cluster add <cluster-name> <patterns...>

# Enrich it with action steps
desloppify plan cluster update <cluster-name> \
  --description "detailed description" \
  --steps "step 1" "step 2" "step 3"
```

Then record the organize stage:
```bash
desloppify plan triage --stage organize --report "summary of your prioritized organization, which cluster comes first and why..."
```
- **Minimum length:** 100 characters
- **Must have:** At least 1 manual cluster with findings, each with description + action_steps
- **Then confirm:**
  ```bash
  desloppify plan triage --confirm organize
  ```

**To jump back and reorganize:**
```bash
desloppify plan triage --stage organize --report "revised organization after user feedback..."
```

---

#### **Stage 4: COMMIT - Write Strategy & Complete Triage**

```bash
desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "your executive strategy summary for implementation"
```
- **Minimum length:** 200 characters (or "same" to keep existing)
- **This marks triage complete:** All triage stage IDs are removed from queue; plan is ready for `desloppify next`

---

### **3. Fast-Track Path: Confirm Existing Plan**

If the bot has already built a plan you agree with, skip the full workflow:

```bash
desloppify plan triage --confirm-existing \
  --note "rationale for confirming this plan" \
  --strategy "strategy summary"
```

---

### **4. Plan Modification Commands (Feedback Tools)**

These let you reshape the plan **outside** of triage stages:

```bash
# Move findings in priority order
desloppify plan move <patterns> top|bottom|before|after [--target <target>]

# Skip findings (temporary or permanent)
desloppify plan skip <patterns> --permanent --note "why" --attest "attestation"

# Mark findings as done
desloppify plan done <patterns> --note "what you did" --attest "attestation"

# Mark findings as fixed and move to next
desloppify plan done <patterns> --confirm --note "explanation"

# Create/enrich clusters (group related findings)
desloppify plan cluster create <name> --description "..."
desloppify plan cluster add <name> <patterns>
desloppify plan cluster update <name> --description "..." --steps "step1" "step2"

# Focus on a specific cluster
desloppify plan focus <cluster-name>

# Set notes/descriptions on findings
desloppify plan note <patterns> "my analysis note"
desloppify plan describe <patterns> "augmented description"
```

---

### **5. Key Files & Architecture**

**Plan Operations** (what you can actually do):
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/operations.py` — All mutation functions
  - `move_items()` — reorder queue
  - `skip_items()` / `unskip_items()` — skip/restore findings
  - `describe_finding()` / `annotate_finding()` — add metadata
  - `create_cluster()` / `add_to_cluster()` — group findings
  - `reset_plan()` — nuke plan and start over

**Triage System**:
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/epic_triage.py` — LLM-driven triage orchestration
  - `collect_triage_input()` — gathers open findings, completed work, recurring patterns
  - `build_triage_prompt()` — constructs the triage briefing
  - `apply_triage_to_plan()` — mutates plan with triage results

**Triage Workflow Handlers**:
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/plan/triage_handlers.py` — Full 4-stage workflow implementation
  - `_cmd_stage_observe()` — Observe stage handler
  - `_cmd_stage_reflect()` — Reflect stage handler  
  - `_cmd_stage_organize()` — Organize stage handler
  - `_cmd_triage_complete()` — Completion handler

**CLI Parser**:
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/cli_support/parser_groups_admin.py` lines 462–809 — All plan subcommand definitions

**Command Registry**:
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/registry.py` — Entry points

---

### **6. How the Bot Receives & Acts on Feedback**

1. **During triage stages**: Each `--stage` command is an **interactive checkpoint**. The bot writes analysis, you read it and can:
   - Confirm it by running `--confirm <stage>`
   - Revise it by running `--stage <stage>` again with new `--report`
   - Jump back to an earlier stage, which cascades clear confirmations on later stages

2. **Cascade clearing**: If you revise OBSERVE after confirming it, REFLECT and ORGANIZE confirmations are automatically cleared (forcing re-review).

3. **Plan state**: The living plan is stored in `.desloppify/plan.json`; it contains:
   - `queue_order` — prioritized finding IDs
   - `clusters` — named groups of findings
   - `skipped` — skipped findings with reason/attestation
   - `overrides` — per-finding descriptions/notes
   - `epic_triage_meta` — triage state (stages, strategy, etc.)

4. **Execution**: After triage completes, `desloppify next` uses the finalized queue order and clusters.

---

### **7. Write Feedback That Makes It Rethink**

**Example workflow:**

```bash
# Bot's initial observe stage
desloppify plan triage --stage observe --report "I see 5 findings mostly about X and Y dimensions..."

# You read it, want to revise focus
desloppify plan triage --stage observe --report "Actually, the core issue is Z, not X. X findings are symptoms of Z. Y is separate. Root causes: Z (refactor), Y (simplify), isolated fixes (5 findings)"

# Confirm
desloppify plan triage --confirm observe --attestation "I have reviewed the analysis..."

# Reflect stage
desloppify plan triage --stage reflect --report "Z was addressed in commit abc123. Y is recurring (resolved 2x before, open again). Strategy: fix root Z first, then tackle Y, defer the isolated fixes."

# Confirm
desloppify plan triage --confirm reflect --attestation "I reviewed the strategy..."

# Organize: create clusters by root cause
desloppify plan cluster create fix-z --description "Refactor X module to fix root cause Z"
desloppify plan cluster add fix-z review::z-related-findings...
desloppify plan cluster update fix-z --steps "extract logic" "add tests" "validate"

desloppify plan cluster create recurring-y --description "Address recurring Y issue"
desloppify plan cluster add recurring-y review::y-findings...

# Move to top (reprioritize)
desloppify plan move fix-z top

# Organize
desloppify plan triage --stage organize --report "Prioritized: 1) Fix Z root cause (unblocks later work), 2) Recurring Y (prevents loops), 3) Isolated fixes"

# Complete
desloppify plan triage --complete --strategy "Root-cause-first strategy: fix Z, address Y recurrence, isolated cleanup."
```

---

### **8. No "Directives" File Needed**

There's **no `.desloppify/directives/` mechanism** to write feedback to. Feedback is **interactive**: you run commands, read output, and run next commands. The triage system is specifically designed for human-in-the-loop control.

---

### **9. Summary: How to Make the Bot Reprioritize**

1. **Run triage stages** with `--stage observe|reflect|organize` and provide your own analysis/strategy
2. **Jump back** by running the same `--stage` command again with revised `--report`
3. **Create clusters** manually with `desloppify plan cluster create/add/update`
4. **Move items** with `desloppify plan move <patterns> top|bottom|before|after`
5. **Skip items** with `desloppify plan skip <patterns> --permanent --note "..."`
6. **Complete triage** with `--complete --strategy "..."`

The key: **You're not writing directives to a file.** You're actively managing the plan via CLI commands, with the triage workflow as your structured interface for major reprioriti­zations.

1→"""Post-scan plan reconciliation — handle finding churn."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass, field

     8→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import EPIC_PREFIX, PlanModel, SupersededEntry, ensure_plan_defaults

    10→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel, utc_now
    11→
    12→SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS = 90

    15→@dataclass
    16→class ReconcileResult:
    17→    """Summary of changes made during reconciliation."""
    18→

    25→def _find_candidates(
    26→    state: StateModel, detector: str, file: str
    27→) -> list[str]:
    28→    """Find open findings that could be remaps for a disappeared finding."""
    29→    candidates: list[str] = []
    30→    for fid, finding in state.get("findings", {}).items():
    31→        if finding.get("status") != "open":
    32→            continue
    33→        if finding.get("detector") == detector and finding.get("file") == file:
    34→            candidates.append(fid)
    35→    return candidates
    36→
    37→
    38→def _is_finding_alive(state: StateModel, finding_id: str) -> bool:
    39→    """Return True if the finding exists and is open."""
    40→    finding = state.get("findings", {}).get(finding_id)
    41→    if finding is None:
    42→        return False
    43→    return finding.get("status") == "open"
    44→
    45→
    46→def _supersede_id(
    47→    plan: PlanModel,
    48→    state: StateModel,
    49→    finding_id: str,
    50→    now: str,
    51→) -> bool:
    52→    """Move a disappeared finding to superseded. Returns True if changed."""
    53→    finding = state.get("findings", {}).get(finding_id)
    54→    detector = ""
    55→    file = ""
    56→    summary = ""
    57→    if finding:
    58→        detector = finding.get("detector", "")
    59→        file = finding.get("file", "")
    60→        summary = finding.get("summary", "")
    61→
    62→    candidates = _find_candidates(state, detector, file) if detector else []
    63→    # Don't include the original in candidates
    64→    candidates = [c for c in candidates if c != finding_id]
    65→
    66→    entry: SupersededEntry = {

    68→        "original_detector": detector,
    69→        "original_file": file,

    71→        "status": "superseded",
    72→        "superseded_at": now,
    73→        "remapped_to": None,
    74→        "candidates": candidates[:5],
    75→    }
    76→

    78→    override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(finding_id)
    79→    if override and override.get("note"):
    80→        entry["note"] = override["note"]
    81→
    82→    plan["superseded"][finding_id] = entry
    83→
    84→    # Remove from queue_order, skipped, promoted_ids, cluster finding_ids

   107→def _prune_old_superseded(plan: PlanModel, now_dt: datetime) -> list[str]:
   108→    """Remove superseded entries older than TTL. Returns pruned IDs."""
   109→    superseded = plan.get("superseded", {})
   110→    cutoff = now_dt - timedelta(days=SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS)
   111→    to_prune: list[str] = []
   112→
   113→    for fid, entry in superseded.items():
   114→        ts = entry.get("superseded_at", "")
   115→        try:
   116→            entry_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
   117→            if entry_dt.tzinfo is None:
   118→                entry_dt = entry_dt.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
   119→            if entry_dt < cutoff:
   120→                to_prune.append(fid)
   121→        except (ValueError, TypeError):
   122→            to_prune.append(fid)
   123→
   124→    for fid in to_prune:
   125→        superseded.pop(fid, None)
   126→        # Also clean up stale overrides
   127→        plan.get("overrides", {}).pop(fid, None)
   128→
   129→    return to_prune
   130→
   131→
   132→def reconcile_plan_after_scan(
   133→    plan: PlanModel,
   134→    state: StateModel,
   135→) -> ReconcileResult:
   136→    """Reconcile plan against current state after a scan.
   137→
   138→    Finds IDs referenced in the plan that no longer exist or are no longer
   139→    open, moves them to superseded, and prunes old superseded entries.
   140→    """
   141→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   142→    result = ReconcileResult()
   143→    now = utc_now()
   144→    now_dt = datetime.now(UTC)
   145→
   146→    # Collect all finding IDs referenced by the plan
   147→    referenced_ids: set[str] = set()
   148→    referenced_ids.update(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   149→    referenced_ids.update(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   150→    for override_id in plan.get("overrides", {}):
   151→        referenced_ids.add(override_id)
   152→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   153→        referenced_ids.update(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   154→
   155→    # Exclude already-superseded IDs and synthetic IDs (managed by stale_dimensions)
   156→    already_superseded = set(plan.get("superseded", {}).keys())
   157→    referenced_ids -= already_superseded
   158→    referenced_ids = {
   159→        fid for fid in referenced_ids
   160→        if not any(fid.startswith(prefix) for prefix in SYNTHETIC_PREFIXES)
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    # Check each referenced ID
   164→    for fid in sorted(referenced_ids):
   165→        if not _is_finding_alive(state, fid):
   166→            if _supersede_id(plan, state, fid, now):
   167→                result.superseded.append(fid)
   168→                result.changes += 1
   169→
   170→    # Reconcile epic clusters: remove dead findings, delete empty epics
   171→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   172→    epic_names_to_delete: list[str] = []
   173→    for name, cluster in list(clusters.items()):
   174→        if not name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX):
   175→            continue
   176→        finding_ids = cluster.get("finding_ids", [])
   177→        alive_ids = [fid for fid in finding_ids if _is_finding_alive(state, fid)]
   178→        if alive_ids != finding_ids:
   179→            cluster["finding_ids"] = alive_ids
   180→            result.changes += 1
   181→        if not alive_ids:
   182→            epic_names_to_delete.append(name)
   183→    for name in epic_names_to_delete:
   184→        clusters.pop(name, None)
   185→        result.changes += 1
   186→
   187→    # Resurface stale temporary skips
   188→    scan_count = state.get("scan_count", 0)
   189→    from desloppify.engine._plan.operations import resurface_stale_skips
   190→
   191→    resurfaced = resurface_stale_skips(plan, scan_count)
   192→    if resurfaced:
   193→        result.resurfaced = resurfaced
   194→        result.changes += len(resurfaced)
   195→
   196→    # Prune old superseded entries
   197→    pruned = _prune_old_superseded(plan, now_dt)
   198→    result.pruned = pruned
   199→    result.changes += len(pruned)
   200→
   201→    # Log reconciliation if any changes were made
   202→    if result.changes > 0:
   203→        from desloppify.engine._plan.operations import append_log_entry
   204→
   205→        append_log_entry(
   206→            plan,
   207→            "reconcile",
   208→            finding_ids=result.superseded,
   209→            actor="system",
   210→            detail={
   211→                "superseded_count": len(result.superseded),
   212→                "pruned_count": len(result.pruned),
   213→                "resurfaced_count": len(result.resurfaced),
   214→            },
   215→        )
   216→
   217→    return result

   220→@dataclass
   221→class ReviewImportSyncResult:
   222→    """Summary of plan changes after a review import."""
   223→
   224→    new_ids: set[str]
   225→    added_to_queue: list[str]
   226→    triage_injected: bool
   227→
   228→
   229→def sync_plan_after_review_import(
   230→    plan: PlanModel,
   231→    state: StateModel,
   232→) -> ReviewImportSyncResult | None:
   233→    """Sync plan queue after review import. Pure engine function — no I/O.
   234→
   235→    Appends new finding IDs to queue_order and injects triage stages
   236→    if needed. Returns None when there are no new findings to sync.
   237→    """
   238→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_dimensions import (
   239→        compute_new_finding_ids,
   240→        sync_triage_needed,
   241→    )
   242→
   243→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   244→    new_ids = compute_new_finding_ids(plan, state)
   245→    if not new_ids:
   246→        return None
   247→
   248→    # Add new finding IDs to end of queue_order so they have position
   249→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   250→    existing = set(order)
   251→    added: list[str] = []
   252→    for fid in sorted(new_ids):
   253→        if fid not in existing:
   254→            order.append(fid)
   255→            added.append(fid)
   256→
   257→    # Inject triage stages if needed
   258→    triage_result = sync_triage_needed(plan, state)
   259→    triage_injected = bool(
   260→        triage_result and getattr(triage_result, "injected", False)
   261→    )
   262→
   263→    return ReviewImportSyncResult(
   264→        new_ids=new_ids,
   265→        added_to_queue=added,
   266→        triage_injected=triage_injected,
   267→    )
   268→
